About Us

Ascent has recently been acquired by Acuity Analytics . This is both a significant milestone for us and a tremendous opportunity for you.

Acuity Analytics is a business with a strong global reputation, an impressive client base, and ambitious growth plans. We deliver deep insights and domain-led digital transformation to high-growth and heavily regulated organisations. To our customers, we bring a partnership that provides the talent, technology, and capability to enhance performance and operational efficiency.

As part of our continued growth, we are looking for an Enterprise Architect
to help shape the future of our engineering organisation and drive technical excellence across our modernization practice.

About the Role

This role is responsible for architecture assessment, target-state definition, and modernization alignment for complex enterprise application landscapes undergoing legacy transformation. You will focus on shaping scalable, resilient, secure, and governable architectures that progressively move monolithic, tightly coupled, batch-oriented systems toward modular, event-driven, cloud-enabled and operationally observable platforms.

The role requires strong hands-on architecture depth across application modernization, integration architecture, microservices, APIs, event streaming, container platforms, database modernization, DevSecOps, observability, resiliency, and governance. You will collaborate with business, application, data, infrastructure, security, DevOps, operations, and delivery teams to define transition roadmaps, manage architectural risks, establish guardrails, validate implementation choices, and ensure modernization is delivered through controlled, incremental, and enterprise-grade transformation practices.

Skills and Experience Required

Core Skills (must-have):

Enterprise Architecture
Legacy Modernization
Application Architecture
Microservices Architecture
Event-Driven Architecture
API & Integration Architecture
Cloud-Agnostic Architecture
Domain-Driven Design
Strangler Pattern Migration
DevSecOps
CI/CD & IaC
Observability
DataBricks
Data Governance & Lineage
Cloud Portability
Kubernetes
Kafka
.NET
MSSQL / PostgreSQL

Nice to Have:

Financial Services / Banking Domain experience

Key Competencies:

Proven enterprise architecture experience across large-scale legacy modernization, distributed systems, integration platforms, database ecosystems, cloud-enabled platforms, and regulated enterprise environments.
Strong ability to assess monolithic, tightly coupled, database-centric and batch-driven estates and translate findings into practical target-state architecture and migration roadmaps.
Deep understanding of microservices architecture, domain-driven design, service decomposition, database-per-service patterns, distributed workflows, sagas, APIs, and contract-first design.
Strong knowledge of event-driven architecture, Kafka-based event streaming, schema management, asynchronous processing, replayability, idempotency, dead-letter handling, and integration resilience patterns.
Hands-on architecture experience with Microsoft .NET ecosystems, REST / gRPC APIs, middleware platforms, enterprise messaging, MSSQL, PostgreSQL, and application modernization technologies.
Strong understanding of cloud-agnostic and hybrid architecture principles including Kubernetes, Docker, containerized deployment, cloud portability, platform engineering, and workload isolation.
Experience with DevSecOps, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, automated quality gates, release orchestration, environment promotion, vulnerability scanning, and audit-ready change management.
Ability to define resilience and operational readiness requirements including high availability, disaster recovery, failover, observability, monitoring, logging, tracing, SLOs, incident handling, and support transition.
Good appreciation of enterprise data platforms like Databricks , governed reporting, data lineage, data quality, auditability, regulatory evidence, and interaction between operational systems and analytical data platforms.
Excellent stakeholder management, architecture governance, decision facilitation, risk articulation, technical communication, and cross-functional coordination skills.
Ability to balance target-state architecture ambition with delivery pragmatism, coexistence constraints, incremental migration, business continuity, operational stability, and regulatory expectations.
Strong documentation discipline across architecture blueprints, transition states, decision records, integration contracts, dependency maps, runbooks, governance artifacts, and executive-level architecture narratives.

Certifications (Preferred):

TOGAF® Enterprise Architecture Practitioner / TOGAF® 9 Certified
AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, or Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)

What You Will Do

Own enterprise architecture assessment and target-state definition for large-scale legacy modernization initiatives across application, integration, data, infrastructure, security, and operations domains.
Assess current-state monolithic applications, shared database dependencies, batch processing models, middleware integrations, reporting dependencies, operational constraints, and resiliency gaps to define pragmatic modernization pathways.
Define future-state architecture aligned to separation of concerns, microservices, database-per-service, API-led integration, event-driven processing, cloud portability, automated delivery, observability, and enterprise governance principles.
Establish architecture guardrails, reference patterns, decision records, integration standards, data ownership principles, service boundary guidance, and non-functional requirements for scalable and resilient modernization delivery.
Guide decomposition of tightly coupled legacy capabilities into domain-aligned services, reusable platform components, controlled interfaces, independently deployable modules, and governed operational workflows.
Support migration strategy using incremental modernization patterns such as strangler migration, parallel run, coexistence, controlled cutover, rollback planning, reconciliation, and phased capability transition.
Provide architecture direction for integration modernization across messaging, APIs, file-based interfaces, event streaming, schema governance, idempotent processing, error handling, retry mechanisms, and dead-letter handling.
Partner with data architecture teams to align application modernization with governed data platforms, lineage, auditability, data quality, reporting readiness, and operational data consumption patterns.
Drive architecture alignment across cloud, on-premise, and hybrid deployment models including Kubernetes, containerization, platform engineering, DevSecOps, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, secrets management, and environment readiness.
Define and validate resilience, high availability, disaster recovery, failover, monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, operational readiness, and supportability requirements for business-critical enterprise platforms.
Facilitate architecture governance forums, technical design reviews, solution walkthroughs, migration readiness assessments, risk reviews, and cross-team decision-making across delivery workstreams.
Support implementation oversight during build, test, deployment, cutover, stabilization, and hyper-care phases to ensure solutions remain aligned with enterprise architecture guardrails and modernization objectives.
Create and maintain architecture documentation including current-state assessments, target-state blueprints, transition architectures, integration views, dependency maps, decision logs, operational runbooks, and modernization roadmaps.

Why Join Us

At Acuity Analytics, you'll have the opportunity to work across complex enterprise Azure environments while helping shape and improve our Managed Services capability.

You'll solve challenging technical problems, influence standards and automation, mentor other engineers, and work closely with customers and technical teams.

People are at the Heart of our Business. By investing in people, we achieve exceptional results for our clients and create new opportunities for our teams to thrive.

🔵 Project Description:

The project is part of the Credit, Asset-backed & Securitized Products (CASP) division of an investment bank, focusing on platforms that support securitization and structured finance products. The current primary objective is migrating existing on-premise systems to a modern Microsoft Azure cloud environment, transforming legacy architecture into scalable, cloud-native solutions. It involves rebuilding and adapting systems used for structuring, processing, and distributing securities such as ABS, MBS, and CLOs. The platform integrates with trading, risk, and regulatory systems to support both real-time and batch data processing. The target architecture follows a microservices-based approach with containerized services deployed on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). Infrastructure provisioning and configuration are managed using Terraform as Infrastructure as Code. The system leverages REST APIs and event-driven communication to ensure scalability and flexibility during and after migration. Special focus is placed on maintaining data consistency, performance, and regulatory compliance throughout the transition. The project emphasizes high availability, resilience, and observability in a complex financial ecosystem. AI-assisted development tools like GitHub Copilot are integrated to enhance engineering productivity. The environment promotes modern engineering practices, automation, and continuous improvement.

🔵 Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and maintain backend services using Java 11+ and Spring Boot within a microservices architecture.
Build and enhance RESTful APIs and message-driven services supporting securitization and credit workflows.
Develop and deploy cloud-native applications on Microsoft Azure, including AKS-based container orchestration.
Use Terraform to define and manage infrastructure as code.
Work with containerization technologies (Docker) and contribute to CI/CD pipelines using GitLab or GitHub.
Implement integrations using messaging systems such as Kafka, IBM MQ, or Tibco EMS.
Collaborate on system design, ensuring scalability, resilience, and alignment with distributed architecture principles.
Develop and optimize database interactions using Azure SQL, Oracle, or Sybase.
Write and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to ensure code quality and reliability.
Implement monitoring, logging, and observability practices to support production systems.
Utilize Linux/Unix skills for troubleshooting and scripting.
Leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve efficiency while maintaining high coding standards.

🔵 Mandatory Skills Description:

• Strong object-oriented programming skills with Java 11+
• Extensive experience with Spring Boot / Spring ecosystem
• Hands-on development of Web and/or REST APIs and message-driven services
• Experience building and running containerized applications
• Strong experience with Azure cloud, including:
• Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform

jobs.description:
🔵 Project Description:

Development of monitoring and diagnostics system. It fulfils both local and remote data access and analytics requirement, as well as local and remote troubleshooting purpose.
The work responsibilities contain L2 support + manual testing.
Most of the L1 support team is in Asian tmezone, but we still have preferred EU zone.

🔵 Responsibilities:

Responsible for ensuring the reliability and quality of telemetry‑driven IIoT systems through advanced troubleshooting, manual testing, and protocol‑level diagnostics across edge and cloud environments.
The L2 Support Engineer / Manual QA Engineer is responsible for second‑line support and quality validation of IoT and IIoT systems handling real‑time telemetry data. The role investigates complex issues escalated from L1, performing root‑cause analysis using logs, metrics, telemetry streams, and monitoring tools. It involves diagnosing problems across edge and cloud environments, often running on Linux‑based systems. The engineer validates fixes and configuration changes before production release and collaborates closely with development, DevOps, and L3 teams.
In parallel, the role performs manual functional, integration, and regression testing across UI, API, and backend layers. A key responsibility is validating end‑to‑end data flows from devices and gateways through brokers and backend services to dashboards and reports. The engineer ensures data accuracy, correct aggregation, timestamp alignment, and proper resolution in time‑series data.
The role requires hands‑on work with industrial and IoT protocols such as Modbus and MQTT, including validation of payloads, connectivity, and reconnection behavior. It also involves using monitoring and diagnostic systems to detect latency, data loss, or anomalies in real‑time systems. Overall, the role ensures system reliability, data quality, and observability while supporting continuous improvement across support and QA processes.

🔵 Mandatory Skills Description:

Preferrably IT education
Experience as a Manual QA Engineer and L2 Support Engineer
Strong experience with:
Telemetry data and time‑series data
Industry Monitoring and diagnostic platforms or Control systems
Edge and Cloud service experiences
Hands‑on knowledge of Modbus, MQTT or similar IIoT/industrial protocols
Strong manual testing experience (UI, API, backend)
Strong troubleshoot experiences to analyze logs, metrics, and protocol‑level issues

Linux knowledge

jobs.description:
Jobba hos oss här får du frihet, passion, kunskap och work-life balance.

Hos oss är det ena projektet inte det andra likt. Just nu söker vi efter seniora utvecklare som gillar att ta ansvar, samarbeta och driva utvecklingen framåt. Våra kunder ligger ofta i teknikframkanten och du kommer att få uppdrag där din insats gör skillnad för människor lång tid framöver, kanske till och med ändra på vad vi idag ser som normalt till något nytt.

Du kommer att arbeta i tvärfunktionella team tillsammans med andra utvecklare, UX, Product Managers och andra kompetenser. Uppdragen kan se olika ut, men gemensamt är att du får möjlighet att vara med hela vägen – från behov och idé till färdig lösning i produktion.

Vi tycker att det är bra ifall du känner till några av följande teknologier:

God erfarenhet av modern mjukvaruutveckling, frontend och/eller backend.
TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, Java, Kotlin eller liknande.
React, Angular eller motsvarande moderna frontendramverk.
Molnplattformar som AWS, Azure eller Google Cloud Platform.
Docker och/eller Kubernetes.
Terraform eller motsvarande verktyg för infrastructure as code.
RESTful services och API-utveckling.
CI/CD, exempelvis GitHub Actions eller motsvarande.
Testning, observability och arbete med kvalitet och hållbar arkitektur.

Vi söker
dig som är senior och självgående och som kan bidra från första dagen.

Du har en stabil grund inom mjukvaruutveckling och känner dig hemma i moderna utvecklingsmiljöer. Du kan ta ansvar för dina tekniska beslut, samarbeta med andra och omsätta behov till lösningar som skapar värde.

Du är nyfiken på ny teknik och tycker att det är spännande att utvecklas tillsammans med tekniken. Erfarenhet av AI-assisterad och agentisk utveckling, exempelvis med Claude Code eller Codex, är meriterande och kan vara en naturlig del av ditt utvecklingsarbete.

Framför allt söker vi dig som vill vara med och utveckla både våra kunders lösningar och oss som team.

Vi söker efter personer som behärskar svenska i tal och skrift.

Att vara konsult på Sylog

Att vara konsult hos oss innebär att du arbetar under ett varumärke som står för kvalitet, teknisk kompetens och långsiktiga samarbeten. Med vår långa erfarenhet inom inbyggda system och systemutveckling är vi ett namn som våra kunder litar på.

Vi brukar säga att vår anställningsform kombinerar det bästa av två världar och så har det varit sedan starten av Sylog 2002. Självständigheten och friheten som många förknippar med att vara egen, tillsammans med tryggheten och förmånerna som kommer med en anställning.

Vi behandlar ansökningar löpande, så varmt välkommen att skicka in din ansökan redan idag! Just nu söker vi efter personer som behärskar svenska i tal och skrift.

jobs.description:
About The Job

We are looking for two Forward Deployed AI Engineering Interns to join our tech development team. You will get the opportunity to build software used by financial institutions and gain hands-on experience working with real products, client data and users.

We are building the next generation of financial intelligence on Palantir Foundry, working side by side with Advisense’s regulatory specialists. You will work alongside experienced engineers, product owners and regulatory specialists, contributing across data, backend and frontend and taking on more complex work as you grow.

AI is an integral part of how we work. Claude Code, Codex and Foundry’s AI tooling are part of our working day, while AI is also embedded in the products we build. During the internship, you will learn how to use AI effectively and responsibly while understanding, validating and testing the code you produce.

As Part Of Our Tech Development Team, You Will

Contribute to production modules across data, backend and frontend.
Build and improve APIs, data pipelines, integrations and user interfaces.
Help turn financial and regulatory requirements into useful and correct product features.
Explore and implement AI-enabled workflows with guidance from experienced engineers.
Take part in client implementations together with a senior engineer.
Learn to test, deploy, monitor and maintain production software.
Take part in code reviews, technical discussions and product development from discovery through release.

Background And Experience

Programming experience in both Python and TypeScript, from academic, professional, personal or open-source work.
At least one application or substantial software project you have built.
Interest in working across frontend, backend, data and AI.
An eye for clear and useful user experiences.
Curiosity about AI-enabled applications and AI-assisted development.
Willingness to understand, test and take responsibility for the code you produce.
A collaborative approach and openness to feedback.
Professional proficiency in English. Swedish is appreciated but not required.

Experience with Palantir Foundry, cloud platforms, AI tools, financial services or regulated data is beneficial but not required.

Who You Are

We are looking for someone at the beginning of their engineering career with strong foundations, curiosity and a genuine interest in building software. We do not expect you to arrive as a complete engineer – what matters is that you enjoy solving problems, learn quickly and are motivated to develop across different parts of the technology stack.

You are curious about AI and want to learn how to use it effectively and responsibly in software development. You enjoy collaborating with others, are open to feedback and are motivated to take on more ownership as your experience grows.

You will join a small, collaborative development team where experienced engineers provide technical guidance and support. During the internship, you will gain hands-on experience across the full product stack, work with software used by real financial institutions and gradually take on more ownership as your experience grows.

Additional Information

This is a 12-month paid internship based in Stockholm, with two positions available.

We review applications continuously, so don’t wait—apply as soon as you’re ready! As long as the job posting is live, the position is still available.

Our selection process is designed to highlight your strengths through interviews and a technical case. We focus on competencies throughout the process and strive to make your experience as smooth as possible by keeping you informed along the way.

To comply with GDPR regulations, we do not accept applications via email. Please submit your application through the official application portal.

Company Description

Advisense has grown to become a market-leading expert company in governance, risk, and compliance (GRC). Through the acquisition of Transcendent Group in 2022, we are now the largest independent consulting firm in the Nordics in this area, helping our clients with advisory, services, technology, and fund solutions. We strive to be the best workplace for GRC experts and have more than 450 employees at our offices in Sweden, Belgium, Denmark, Finland, Germany, Lithuania and Norway. Read more about us here.

jobs.title: .NET Developer- Specialist- Energy & Commodities
jobs.description:
Job Description

Tremend is looking for a .NET Developer to join our team of bright thinkers and doers. You’ll use your problem-solving creativity to figure out our client’s most complex and challenging problems across different industries. We are on a mission to transform the world, and you will be instrumental in shaping how we do it with your ideas, thoughts, and solutions.

Your Impact:

Build state-of-the-art, enterprise-ready solutions for customers all over the world with clients from all business areas such as Banking, Telecom, & Advertising, or Manufacturing
Groom, develop, test, and see the value brought by your code to the end user
Build applications of all sizes from the ground up and see them delivered to production successfully
Interact with a team of amazing software engineers that are always focused on the quality of the product and the happiness of the end-user
Be Agile, breathe Agile, and discover the fun in Agile.

Your Skills & Experience:

Hands-on experience working with .NET Core, Oracle databases in production environments
Hands-on experience in creating and consuming Microservices using .NET Core APIs
Sound understanding of concepts like Exception handling, Serialization/Deserialization Immutability concepts, etc.
Good fundamental knowledge in Enums, Collections, Annotations, Generics, Autoboxing, etc.
Thorough understanding of OOPS concepts, Design principles, and implementation of different types of Design patterns
Familiarity with REST and RPC APIs
Understanding of Clean Code approaches and SOLID principles
Understanding of CQRS / DDD concepts
Experience in RDBMS or NO SQL databases, Oracle database and writing SQL queries (Joins, group by, aggregate functions, etc.).

Set Yourself Apart With:

Experience with Multithreading, Async-await/TPL/Reactive programming, and Concurrent collections
Good understanding of .NET resource management including garbage collection concepts
Skilled in database programming (stored procedures, triggers, functions) and a good understanding of ADO.NET/ORM frameworks
Hands-on experience with messaging/data streaming platforms like RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, Kafka
Strong experience designing and working with N-tier architecture (UI, Business Logic Layer, Data Access Layer) along with some experience with service-oriented architectures (SOA)
Hands-on experience in Microservices architecture with a good understanding of key Microservices based patterns
Experience in security, transaction, Idempotency, log tracing, distributed caching, monitoring, and containerization requirements of Microservices
Experience implementing automated testing platforms and unit tests (MSTest, xUnit, NUnit)
Experience in working with large-scale applications and frameworks
Good understanding of code build, test, quality check, and release tools like Git, MSTest, TFS, MSBuild, Jenkin/Bamboo/Octopus, cloud DevOps tools, etc.
Experience in working with JavaScript (Angular, React, or other frameworks)
Working experience in Docker & Kubernetes based solutions
Experience in developing/migrating on-prem applications on cloud platforms.

Additional Information

Besides an exciting job in a tremendous team, here s what you can expect:

A fast-paced tech environment
Continuous growth & learning
Open feedback culture
Room for own initiative & ideas
Transparency about results & strategy
Recognition & reward for hard work
Working with a flexible schedule
Medical subscription
Meal tickets
Extra vacation days - starting with 25 vacation days
Many others perks

Company Description

Tremend is the newest global software engineering hub for Publicis Sapient. For over 20 years, the company has been infusing its advanced technical expertise into complex and innovative solutions that meet today s digital transformation needs and pave the way for a better and smarter future. By joining forces with Publicis Sapient we re accelerating the impact, providing a good mix of talented engineers, technology, continuous improvement, innovation, and R&D. Here, you ll have the opportunity to unleash your potential, powering up advanced software solutions for some of the world s most iconic brands. Embrace your passion for technology, creativity, and continuous improvement, and join us in making a difference through engineering.

jobs.description:
This is a position suitable for passionate professionals who want to work for a leading European Insurance Group on a very flexible work schedule.

You will work as part of a multinational group with true, large, enterprise-wide systems, complex architectures and real life constraints (speed, performance, non-stop systems availability) and are going to be part of an agile team aimed at designing and implementing enterprise level solutions.

Contract duration
: permanent
Schedule
: full-time (8 hrs/day, Monday to Friday)

Your responsibilities

Build and evolve the enterprise integration layer of the Agentic AI Platform.
Develop and operate MCP servers and connectors that provide standardized, governed access from agents to enterprise systems and tools.
Design API contracts, schemas, runtime interfaces, and versioning approaches for agent-to-system and platform-to-platform integration.
Configure and integrate API management capabilities, including authentication, authorization, quotas, policies, logging, and lifecycle governance.
Build source connectors and ingestion pipelines for knowledge and document processing, including country-specific adapters.
Implement event-driven and asynchronous integration patterns where required by scale, freshness, and resilience needs.
Ensure integrations are secure, observable, reusable, decoupled, and aligned with central architecture standards.
Collaborate with source system owners, local platform teams, use case teams, security, data, architecture, and operations.

Required skills

Several years of experience in enterprise integration engineering, API development, middleware, or integration platform development.
Strong hands-on experience with REST APIs, asynchronous messaging, event-driven architecture, schema design, interface contracts, and integration testing.
Experience with API gateways and API management, preferably Azure API Management, including security policies, throttling, logging, and lifecycle management.
Practical experience building connectors, adapters, or service integration components in Python, Java, .NET, or comparable enterprise technologies.
Understanding of MCP and agent tool integration patterns; hands-on MCP server development is a strong advantage.
Experience with RAG ingestion, document pipelines, ETL or CDC patterns, and enterprise data sources is an advantage.
Good knowledge of OAuth2/OIDC, managed identities, secrets, network security, observability, and resilient integration design.
Ability to work across central and local teams in English; experience in heterogeneous international IT landscapes is beneficial.

Compensation & benefits

Very stable work environment, as part of a large Insurance Multinational Group
Flexible work program, respecting your own private time
Attractive remuneration package

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Backend)
jobs.description:
We are Kaizen Gaming

Kaizen Gaming, the team powering Betano, is one of the biggest GameTech companies in the world, operating in 20 markets. We always aim to leverage cutting-edge technology, providing the best experience to our millions of customers who trust us for their entertainment.

We are a diverse team of more than 2.700 Kaizeners, from 40+ nationalities spreading across 3 continents.

Our #oneteam is proud to be among the Best Workplaces in Europe and certified Great Place to Work across our offices. Here, there’ll be no average day for you. Ready to Press Play on Potential?

Let's start with the role

You will join an autonomous Agile team and work closely with the Product Owner, Agile Delivery Lead, Automation Testers and other Software Engineers to create a competitive advantage for Kaizen and offer a unique online experience to our customers.

Software engineers in Kaizen are responsible for a multitude of projects, from our customer-facing websites and mobile applications to our admin and internal tools and backend services, most of them withstanding high volume / traffic.

As a Software Engineer you will:

Create new solutions and see them through, from conception to production;
Turn requirements into simple and sophisticated technological systems. Our large scale, highly available infrastructure is at the core of that challenge;
Design, build, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable code;
Research new technologies to find new and efficient ways to solve day to day challenges;
Ship high-value features quickly;
Challenge the status quo and improve the team and product.

Tech stack

Most of our sites and services are written in C# / ASP.NET and new services are written in .NET Core. New applications use vue.js in the front-end while older ones use server-rendered (Razor) views in combination with jQuery & Knockout.js. MS SQL Server is used for most of our storage needs, but also uses Redis and ElasticSearch when it makes sense to do so. RabbitMQ is our go-to message broker. We use Gitlab for code versioning and CI, and the Atlassian stack for tickets and documentation.

What you'll bring

At least 3 years of experience developing production-level software using Microsoft .NET (full framework or .NET Core);
Proficient in C# and MVC;
Good understanding of basic web technologies, such as HTTP, REST, etc.;
Practical understanding of algorithms and design patterns;
Passionate about delivering high-quality code;
Fluent in English, both oral and written.
Strong work ethics and eagerness to take initiatives with a can-do attitude.
Demonstrated AI-first mindset, actively leveraging AI tools and assistants to improve productivity, problem-solving and decision-making. Continuously explores new AI capabilities and champions their practical adoption within teams, using AI as a natural part of day-to-day work rather than a supplementary tool.

Nice to have:

Expertise in concurrency, multi-threading, and event-driven architecture;
Exposure to distributed applications that are secure, can scale and are highly available.

Kaizen Gaming Perks

🕑 Hybrid way of working & remote options
🏃 A buddy will support you with your onboarding
💸 Competitive pay and bonus scheme
👩‍⚕️ Private health insurance for you and your family
💰 Monthly meal allowance
⭐Developmental 360° feedback framework
📚 Unlimited access to Udemy & continuous training

jobs.title: Senior .NET Developer (Aftermarket Applications)
jobs.description:
Your role

We are looking for a passionate and committed Senior Backend .NET Developer.

You will be part of our internal software development team working in the Aftermarket domain. This surrounds applications for providing technical support, processing warranty, tools for our Field Service Engineer, our back office (planning and order processing), spare part list applications and Serialized Information Management.

As such you will be responsible for technical application ownership and developments. Next to this you will be involved in the full redesign of our existing applications and creation of new applications as business needs arise in our Customer Centers.

You will have the opportunity to work with a highly motivated international business and software developer team in a challenging and very dynamic environment.

You build the back-end behind our operational applications, not the screens in front of it. Your initial focus is the system that links as-built documentation, bills of material and product definitions to serialized equipment and the installed base which is used by internal teams, by Customer Centers and by dealers, with a growing number of applications depending on its APIs. From there you work across the rest of our backend landscape: warranty automation and order evaluation, engineering change bulletins, maintenance engines and the shared services the whole portfolio runs on.

Your working level is domain models, APIs, events and data: what a service owns, what its contract promises, which events it publishes, and how its data is shaped so that it still answers the questions we will ask of it in three years. You work in an agile team with developers, architects and a product owner, shaping design decisions rather than only implementing them.

The work here is engineering, not configuration. We build on C# and .NET (8 or later) on Azure: Function Apps and App Services for compute, Kafka and Azure Service Bus for the event streams that feed us, and a deliberately mixed data layer SQL for the queryable subset, a graph store for the relationships between equipment, components and product definitions. Services run behind private endpoints with managed identity and RBAC, ship through Azure DevOps pipelines with infrastructure as code, and are instrumented with Application Insights.

To succeed, you will need

You have built back-end systems that other teams and other applications depend on, ideally in an operational or business-critical context where downtime is measured in stopped work rather than a slow page. You think in trade-offs rather than absolutes, and you keep digging until you know why something failed, not just that it did. You work comfortably in an agile team, have the confidence to say in refinement that something cannot be built the way it is specified, and use AI tooling with the judgement to verify what it produces. This is a senior role: we expect you to own a domain end to end and make decisions the rest of the team builds on.

You will not have every item on the list below. Cover most of the must-haves and be genuinely curious about the rest.

Must-have

C# / .NET (8 or later, moving to .NET 10): recent, hands-on experience building production-grade applications, not prototypes, at a level where you own a service end to end.
Azure: practical experience with several of: Function Apps, App Services, Service Bus, Event Hubs, Blob Storage, Azure SQL, Key Vault, API Management, Application Insights.
REST API design and implementation: designing and consuming well-structured, versioned APIs, and thinking about the contract before the code.
SQL databases: data modelling, query performance, and integrating relational data into cloud applications.
Testing as part of development: unit and integration testing as a habit, not a separate phase handed to someone else.
Experience migrating .NET Framework systems to modern .NET and retiring what they replaced.

Strong plus

Apache Kafka: consuming event streams from systems you do not control, and living with what they send you.
Graph databases: Neo4j or equivalent, and the modelling instinct for when a relationship belongs in a graph rather than a join table.
Secure-by-default cloud development: managed identity, private endpoints, RBAC and secret management as normal practice.
Observability: structured logging, tracing, alerting, and being on the hook for a system you built.
Domain-driven design: bounded contexts and aggregates applied to a real domain rather than a textbook one.
Microservice architecture: service boundaries, inter-service contracts, and the operational cost of getting them wrong.
Event-driven and message-based architecture: queues, topics, event streams, and the practical problems that come with them: ordering, idempotency, at-least-once delivery, replay, poison messages.
CI/CD with Azure DevOps: YAML pipelines, release management, and infrastructure as code (Bicep, Terraform or ARM).

In return, we offer

At Atlas Copco Group you will join an international and diverse environment with specialists from different disciplines. Our culture is rooted in Swedish values, which includes a family feeling, respect and diversity. We invest in our employees' development and well-being, and we provide a flexible work-life balance. With our inclusive and caring environment, you get the support and inspiration you need to grow. Here, your ideas are embraced, and you never stop learning.

You will have a comprehensive onboarding program, including guidance by a personal godmother/godfather. You will also have access to global job opportunities, as part of the Atlas Copco Group. We offer an interesting compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, paid leave and retirement benefits.

Job location

This role offers a hybrid working arrangement, allowing you to split your time between working remotely and being on-site at Airpower in Antwerp, Belgium (BE).

Uniting curious minds

Behind every innovative solution, there are people working together to transform the future. With careers sparked by initiative and lifelong learning, we unite curious minds, and you could be one of them.

Du analysierst Kundenanforderungen und entwickelst daraus tragfähige Konzepte und digitale Lösungsansätze.

Du verfügst über rund 3–5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Beratung und/oder Entwicklung im Umfeld von Microsoft-Dynamics-Technologien.

Du verstehst sowohl technische Zusammenhänge als auch fachliche Geschäftsprozesse und kannst zwischen beiden Perspektiven vermitteln.

Moderne Arbeitsweise: Flexible Arbeitsmodelle und ein hohes Maß an Vertrauen ermöglichen dir, deine Arbeit eigenverantwortlich und zeitgemäß zu gestalten.
Wertschätzung und Perspektiven: Deine Leistungen und Ideen werden gesehen und bieten dir die Möglichkeit, dich fachlich sowie langfristig weiterzuentwickeln.
Attraktive Zusatzleistungen: Je nach Engagement und Beitrag stehen verschiedene Bonus- und Vergünstigungsmöglichkeiten zur Verfügung.

jobs.title: Software Engineer L1
jobs.description:
We are hiring an early-career Software Engineer for the Connectivity team in our Amsterdam hub.

Full-time · Hybrid · Amsterdam · €45,000-€60,000 per year + Stock Options

About Katanox

Katanox is building the infrastructure layer for hospitality: software that connects hotels and travel buyers and moves money between them. Our platform brings distribution and payments into one workflow (contracting, connectivity, reconciliation, and settlement), so partners can operate with less fragmentation and fewer manual handoffs.

For engineers, this means building reliable systems that handle complex B2B workflows and real financial constraints, with a focus on data integrity, auditability, security, and operational excellence. We're headquartered in Amsterdam with hubs in London and New York.
About the role
You'll join the Connectivity team, which owns the Katanox marketplace end-to-end. On the supply side, hotels connect through their property management systems and channel managers. On the demand side, travel buyers integrate through our public API. In between sits the contracting flow, which decides which buyer can sell which hotel on which terms. 

Availability, rates, and inventory enter the platform on one side, reservations leave on the other, and contracts in the middle decide what each buyer sees. If a rate update from a hotel is dropped, a buyer sells the wrong price. If a reservation is not delivered, a guest arrives to no room.
This is an L1 role. We expect you to arrive with solid fundamentals and real curiosity, not years of production experience. You will pair with senior engineers, own small pieces end-to-end from your first weeks, and grow into owning an integration yourself.

What you will work on
Build and extend integrations with hotel systems: map a partner's availability, rates, and reservation models onto ours, in Kotlin, with tests and code review.
Ship changes to the public API that travel buyers use to search and book.
Work with real third-party APIs, with their retries, rate limits, and odd edge cases, and keep that mess out of the rest of the platform.
Own your services in production: when a rate update or a booking fails somewhere between a hotel and a buyer, you find out why, fix it at the source, and add the monitoring that catches it next time.

What you will grow into
Owning a whole integration or API area end to end, from design to rollout.
The contracting flow: the rules that decide which buyer can sell which hotel on which terms.
Keeping availability and pricing correct at scale. Millions of searches a day depend on the data your services ingest.
Weighing in on architecture decisions with the senior engineers you pair with.

What we are looking for
Around zero to two years of professional experience, or a strong internship and side-project record. A degree is welcome but not required.
Solid fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, testing, and enough system design to reason about a service boundary.
Working knowledge of Kotlin or Java, or another typed language and a clear interest in Kotlin.
Comfort reading other people's API documentation and code, and patience for edge cases. Connectivity is a domain of exceptions.
Curiosity about how travel distribution and payments work, and the ownership to pick up a problem rather than wait for someone else.
Fluent in English, and based in or around Amsterdam.

How we work

A cornerstone of our culture is in-person collaboration. We follow a "hub" model with unique hubs in Amsterdam, London, and New York, where we regularly collaborate face-to-face, onboard customers and colleagues, hold design sessions, and host events.

We do not hire for strictly remote roles. We expect people to spend meaningful time in our hubs because this is how we maintain our culture, build trust, and move quickly together.

We're also a financially regulated
company. That means high standards for security, auditability, and decision-making. This means your work ships with the rigor and reliability you'd expect from systems that move real money.

Our values
At Katanox, our values are the blueprint for how we work together and build our product.
Team over the individual, no ego
: We prioritize the success of the whole team over individual agendas. We win together, share credit, and leave egos at the door.
Data beats excitement
: We welcome bold ideas, but we commit based on evidence. We use data, experimentation, and clear hypotheses to decide what to build.
Dare to do
: We are proactive, take smart risks, and move from talking to doing. We learn by shipping and improve through iteration.
See it, own it, and close it
: When we spot a problem or opportunity, we take responsibility to drive it to completion instead of assuming someone else will.
We apply radical candor
: We care personally and challenge directly. We give and receive honest feedback so we can grow faster as individuals and as a team.
In person first, call second
: We prioritize in-person collaboration in our hubs to build trust, move quickly, and solve hard problems together.
Build collaboratively
: We actively involve the right people, share context early, and co-create solutions across teams and disciplines.
Iterate fast and pragmatically
: We ship small, learn quickly, and avoid over-engineering. We focus on solutions that work in reality, not just in theory.

Interview process
Introductory call
Live Technical Assessment
System Design
Meeting with the CEO
Offer

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Backend Engineer (C#/.Net) to join our innovative product team at our Berlin location, with hybrid working options available. In this role, you will be at the forefront of developing and maintaining our cutting-edge financial technology solutions that facilitate flexible, customer-centric payment options. Our mission is to empower consumers with convenient payment choices while ensuring a steady cash flow for merchants. As part of our dynamic and rapidly growing tech organization, you will have the opportunity to influence the development of new products and enhance existing solutions, shaping the future of FinTech with a human-centric and sustainable approach.

Your daily responsibilities will include designing, developing, testing, and deploying robust software applications, APIs, and workflows. You will participate in technical architecture discussions, contribute to agile ceremonies, analyze business requirements, and ensure comprehensive documentation. Your expertise will help us adopt industry best practices, continually improve our codebase, and foster a positive engineering culture. This role offers a unique chance to work on innovative projects that have a meaningful impact on millions of users worldwide.

Qualifications

What you bring to the role:

Hands-on experience with C# and the .NET framework, with at least 5 years of professional experience.
Proven track record in developing, deploying, and maintaining cloud-based applications, preferably in Azure.
Strong knowledge of microservices architecture and distributed systems.
Deep understanding of RESTful API design and implementation.
Extensive experience working with relational databases, especially SQL Server, and familiarity with ORMs like Entity Framework.
Experience with cloud development and deployment, with bonus points for Azure expertise.
Practical knowledge of messaging platforms such as RabbitMQ or Kafka within distributed architectures.

Experience with AI-assisted development tools like GitHub Copilot, with sound judgment in testing and reviewing AI-generated code.

Designing, developing, testing, and deploying maintainable and scalable software solutions, including applications, APIs, and workflows.

Applying industry standards and best practices to enhance code quality and system architecture.
Contributing to a positive engineering culture by adopting and promoting organizational and industry standards.

Competitive salary packages aligned with industry standards.

Opportunity to work within a diverse, international team committed to innovation.
Access to cutting-edge technologies and tools, fostering continuous learning and development.
Participation in shaping future FinTech products that impact millions of users worldwide.
Supportive environment that encourages professional growth and career advancement.
Comprehensive health and wellness programs, along with other employee benefits.

Riverty is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. There is substantial architectural work ahead. We are evolving how our product integrates with hospital systems, and this role contributes directly to shaping that, not just implementing it. You will work across client-facing APIs, healthcare integrations, imaging workflows, and both cloud and on-premise deployments, within a team where your engineering judgement has a genuine impact.

Design, build, and operate production backend services
Design APIs consumed by mobile and web clients
Work with clinical data and healthcare interoperability standards
Own service quality end to end: automated testing, CI/CD, observability, diagnosability in production
Produce the technical documentation and evidence required in a regulated development process
Contribute to architecture decisions across on-premise and cloud deployment models

What We're Looking For

Several years of professional experience building and operating backend systems in production backend services
Strong understanding of API design, data modelling, and distributed system architecture
Hands-on experience with containers, relational databases, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines
Proficiency in at least one modern backend language and an openness to work across different technologies. We currently work with Python, Go, .NET, and Rust
An AI-native mindset. You actively leverage modern AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity and software quality, while understanding their strengths and limitations
A structured and quality-focused way of working, particularly in regulated environments
Professional English communication skills; German is a strong advantage

Experience with healthcare interoperability standards such as FHIR, HL7, or interface engines like Mirth or Rhapsody
Knowledge of DICOM and medical imaging workflows
Experience developing regulated medical software or working in other safety-critical industries
Experience deploying software in customer-managed or on-premise infrastructures
AWS experience
Interest in taking on greater technical ownership as the team grows

A supportive, international team connected by shared values and a culture of trust
Meaningful responsibilities with a lasting impact on global healthtech, improving medical decisions and patient outcomes

Centrally located, modern workspace with a 212 m² rooftop terrace

Tatjana von Freyberg

Beyond our Munich headquarters, we have core teams in Chicago, Heidelberg, San Diego and Tel Aviv. About the Company

At IMSERV, we're proud to be one of the UK's leading energy data and metering specialists. We deliver award-winning services to customers across the country, providing specialist metering technology for electricity, gas and water, alongside highly accurate energy data collection services.

About the Role

The role will own the architecture of the Astral platform, including the governed data foundation, orchestration, rules and entitlement engine, integration layer, API tier, portal and partner front ends, and the AI layer. The role will also act as the design authority for all significant technical decisions across the product squads and own the technical roadmap from the current estate to the target state, working closely with the Head of Development. A key focus of this roadmap will be the transition from a single-tenant to a multi-tenant architecture.

Responsibilities

Keep the current and target architecture documented, validated and understood across the department.
Review and approve significant technical decisions: patterns, technology choices, integration approaches and third-party services.
Define the API strategy: portal, analytics and data-feed APIs treated as products, with entitlement (who sees what, down to meter point, site and channel) enforced once at the tier.
Design the multi-utility data architecture: how metering, consumption, carbon, asset and CRM data flows from replaceable source systems through the integration layer (Microsoft Fabric and middleware) and is productised for operational and commercial use.
Design the rules and orchestration layer: an event backbone, an orchestration engine for job lifecycles, a decision engine driven by business-editable decision tables, and read models served through the APIs. Adopt proven engines rather than building bespoke ones and run advisory-only before automating actions.
Design the AI layer: retrieval over the data foundation, guardrails, and model and service selection, respecting entitlement throughout.
Lead build-versus-buy evaluations on total cost, time to value and lock-in risk.

What you'll need

Knowledge & Qualifications
Significant experience as a technical or solutions architect on customer-facing SaaS platforms, spanning web applications, API tiers and data platforms.
Direct experience of multi-tenant SaaS architecture, ideally including a single-tenant to multi-tenant migration.
An engineering background on or near our stack: C#/.NET, Angular and Azure.
Experience of event-driven architecture and workflow or rules tooling: orchestration engines (Azure Durable Functions, Temporal, Camunda or similar), decision tables (DMN), message backbones and CQRS-style read models.
Practical, current knowledge of AI: LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation, agent patterns, and what it takes to run them safely over commercial customer data.
Knowledge of the wider Microsoft estate, ideally including Microsoft Fabric; hands-on Azure AI services desirable.
Energy or utilities domain knowledge desirable: metering, half-hourly settlement, MHHS, carbon reporting.

Skills
Data architecture depth for high-volume time-series and reference data.
Able to work pragmatically in a smaller or scaling organisation, where sequencing matters more than frameworks.
Able to explain a trade-off to a non-technical executive as clearly as to an engineering team.
Sound commercial judgement on build-versus-buy and technology selection.

Benefits

28 days' holiday plus Bank Holidays
Buy & sell annual leave scheme
Up to a 10% bonus
Enhanced salary sacrifice pension
Life assurance (up to 6x salary*)
Simply Health plan (with upgrade options)
Car salary sacrifice scheme*

Some foundational work is already in place. The next phase needs someone who can take this from "good start" to "real platform."

The Role

You'll be the Business and technical voice at Atrom — owning the architecture, leading the build, and shaping where the platform goes next. This isn't a job where someone hands you a detailed spec. It's a role where you help define what we're building, then make it real.

Your work will include:
•       Architecture and direction — making the strategic technical decisions that determine what's possible
•       Hands-on delivery — you'll build significant components yourself, not just direct others
•       Quality and standards — establishing how we build, test, secure, and ship
•       Healthcare context — understanding what makes clinical software different from generic SaaS
•       Working with founders — directly with the CEO (operational strategy) and Clinical Director (medical reality)

You'll inherit some good foundations: existing infrastructure, a working prototype, clear strategic direction. What you bring is the experience to make this into a platform that genuinely changes how mental healthcare is delivered.

What we are looking for

You're probably right for this if:
•       You've delivered platform-scale software before (not just features within someone else's platform)
•       You're comfortable with Microsoft Power Platform, Azure services, and modern integration architectures — or you've built equivalent capability on adjacent stacks and are happy moving into ours
•       You understand AI as a tool you've actually deployed in production, not a buzzword
•       You have an instinct for security, privacy, and audit — particularly in regulated contexts
•       You write code well and lead other engineers well
•       You communicate clearly in writing (we're remote-async-first)
•       You're drawn to mission-driven work — mental healthcare isn't an industry you stumble into

You're probably not right for this if:
•       You're looking for a defined task list and step-by-step directions
•       You want to be insulated from the business or clinical context
•       Healthcare regulation feels like a hassle rather than something to engineer around respectfully
•       You'd rather work on consumer apps or enterprise SaaS where the stakes are lower

What we offer

•       Competitive salary — we'll match the market for the right person at this level
•       Real ownership — of the technical direction, not just the codebase
•       Direct work with the founders — no layers, no committees
•       Genuine impact — what you build affects real patients and clinicians
•       Remote-first flexibility — work when and where you work best
•       Modern stack — Azure, Power Platform, OpenAI, current tooling
•       Growth opportunity — as Atrom grows, this role grows with it

About Atrom Mindcare

We were founded in 2023 by Amrish Gupta (CEO) and Dr Aarohee Desai-Gupta (Clinical Director, Consultant Psychiatrist). We specialise in outpatient mental health, including ADHD and ASD assessment and treatment, delivered through both NHS Right to Choose and private channels. We're growing rapidly, operating in a market where demand vastly outstrips quality supply, and we're investing in our platform because we believe technology done right is how mental healthcare moves forward.
We're small enough that you'll see your work matter, structured enough that you'll have what you need to do your best work, and ambitious enough that this is a meaningful career move for the right person.

How to apply

If this resonates, we'd love to hear from you. Send us:
•       A brief note about why this opportunity interests you
•       Your background — link to LinkedIn, GitHub, portfolio, or a CV
•       Examples of platform-scale work you've led
•       A few questions you'd ask us (this tells us more than most CVs do)

Apply via

•       Email: recruitment@atrommindcare.com

Strong fits will be invited to a conversation rather than a structured interview — we want to understand each other before deciding.

Atrom Mindcare Limited is an equal opportunities organisation. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and particularly encourage those underrepresented in healthcare technology to apply.

Vi söker nu en .NET-utvecklare till Skandias DevSecOps-team som utvecklar interna plattformar, verktyg och integrationer som används av utvecklingsteam i hela Skandia.

Att jobba som .NET-utvecklare

Som .NET-utvecklare blir du en del av ett tvärfunktionellt DevSecOps-team med ansvar för interna plattformar och verktyg. Tillsammans utvecklar och förvaltar ni lösningar som används av utvecklare i hela Skandia. Genom ett nära samarbete med andra team bidrar ni till effektiva, säkra och moderna utvecklingsflöden.

I Rollen Kommer Du Bland Annat Att

utveckla och vidareutveckla interna portaler och egenutvecklade lösningar
bygga integrationer mellan olika system, exempelvis Azure DevOps och ServiceNow
automatisera processer och arbetsflöden enligt principen Everything as Code
vidareutveckla och förbättra bygg-, test- och deployprocesser i Azure DevOps och Octopus Deploy
bidra till säkra och effektiva utvecklingsprocesser med fokus på kodkvalitet, säkerhet och automation

Vi arbetar agilt enligt SAFe och i nära samarbete med andra utvecklingsteam, där du bidrar till den fortsatta utvecklingen och förvaltningen av plattformen.

För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:

flera års erfarenhet av utveckling i C# och .NET
erfarenhet av backendutveckling och systemintegrationer
goda kunskaper i Git, YAML och PowerShell
erfarenhet av agila arbetssätt, exempelvis SAFe
goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av Azure DevOps, Octopus Deploy, CI/CD eller testautomation.

Vem är du?

Vi tror att du är en nyfiken och lösningsorienterad person som trivs med att ta dig an tekniska utmaningar och hitta smarta lösningar. Du trivs med att samarbeta med andra, delar gärna med dig av din kunskap och bidrar till ett öppet och hjälpsamt teamklimat.

Du är nyfiken på ny teknik och har en vilja att kontinuerligt utveckla både dig själv och de lösningar du arbetar med.

Vad händer nu? 

I ansökan kommer vi att ställa ett antal urvalsfrågor som ligger till grund för första urvalet.

Läs mer om hela vår rekryteringsprocess här.

Om du har frågor kring rollen, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef Izabella Rolnik på izabella.rolnik@skandia.se.

Om du har frågor kopplat till rekryteringsprocess, vänligen ta kontakt med Nina Fazeli på nina.fazeli@skandia.se.

Vi kommer att ta ett sommaruppehåll i rekryteringsprocessen och återupptar intervjuerna i augusti.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan, och trevlig sommar!

Mer om IT

Vi på Skandia IT är stolta över att vara en kundorienterad enhet som levererar effektiva och säkra lösningar för våra kunder. Med cirka 600 engagerade medarbetare är vi mitt i en spännande transformationsresa, där vi utvecklas tillsammans och har kul på vägen. Framåt tillsammans är vårt motto! 

Vi arbetar agilt och har sedan 2017 använt oss av SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) ramverket, där leverans och kundvärde alltid står i centrum. Våra tågledningar och team, jobbar verksamhetsbaserat med aktiviteter som sprintplanering, daily stand-ups, team-synk, code reviews och retrospektiv. 

Var 12:e vecka samlas vi alla i vår ljusa och inspirerande Ljusgård på kontoret i Stockholm för 2 planeringsdagar. Planeringsperioden består av 6 tvåveckorssprintar, där den sista sprinten är en innovationssprint. Här får du chansen att, själv eller tillsammans med ditt team, utveckla och förfina våra system.

You own the architecture conversation, drive platform adoption, and act as a trusted advisor to customer architects and engineering leaders, then transition the momentum you've built to the core account team.

You bring technical depth and the judgment to apply it fast, in situations that require strong ownership
and are highly visible
. Where a specialisation helps you contribute quickly, great — but on this team, breadth, adaptability, and a bias for impact matter just as much as your area of depth.

The impact you will have

Accelerate what matters most: parachute into strategic, high-profile opportunities and own a clearly defined technical area, moving critical workloads and use cases from evaluation toward production and consumption.
Lead the architecture: design scalable, production-grade solutions across data engineering, ML/AI, and real-time analytics, and lead the whiteboarding, design reviews, and trade-off decisions with senior customer stakeholders.
Win the technical decision: demonstrate Databricks' differentiation through custom-built solutions in competitive, must-win scenarios.
Move fast while maintaining the bar: establish momentum quickly in ambiguous situations and compress timelines without cutting corners.
Hand off, don't hold on: package your progress into a clean transition to core SAs, DSAs, specialists, or partners so wins are sustained and expanded after you move to the next engagement.
Scale: bring back patterns, plays, and product feedback that make every engagement after yours faster.

What We Look For

We care more about how you think and the impact you've had than about a specific checklist. You'll likely bring most of the following, and if you're missing one or two but bring something we haven't thought of, we still want to hear from you!

Several years of experience (typically ~6+) in solutions architecture, data engineering, technical pre-sales, or a senior hands-on technical role, or a track record that demonstrates equivalent depth.
Hands-on coding ability in Python and SQL, with the ability to build, debug, and demonstrate working solutions live.
Depth in distributed data systems and production cloud deployments (AWS, Azure, or GCP), scalable pipelines, streaming, and lakehouse patterns, plus the infrastructure, security, and governance to run them.
Proficiency on the Databricks Platform, or a demonstrated ability to ramp on new technology quickly. A strong "spike" in an area such as real-time/streaming, ML/AI, data governance, or migrations helps you add value fast.
Experience leading architecture discussions with senior technical stakeholders, design reviews, trade-off analysis, clear recommendations, and translating complex architecture into business value for both engineers and executives.
The temperament this team runs on: comfort with ambiguity and time-boxed engagements, strong prioritisation, and a genuine preference for variety and high-impact work.

Nice to haves

Given our role in the Field Engineering organisation, we are always looking to expand the depth our team can offer with your areas of specialisation. Any of the following would be a valuable addition to the team!

Databricks certifications (Data Engineer, ML, or Platform).
Familiarity with competitive platforms (Snowflake, AWS native services, Azure Synapse) and how to position against them.
Background in a data/AI company or cloud provider.
Depth in an industry vertical (Financial Services, Healthcare, Retail, Media, and others).

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer to Sergel Group
jobs.description:
Sergel Group is one of the leading providers of credit management services in the Nordic region. We offer services within credit scoring, debt collection, debt purchasing, as well as messaging and payment solutions. Sergel is part of Marginalen Group and has just over 150 employees across Sweden, Denmark, Norway, and Finland.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Sergel is on an exciting journey to strengthen its in-house capabilities, bringing more competence and ownership closer to the business. This means several ongoing development areas and new projects where data plays a central role, and the people who work with it are central to Sergel's ability to compete and grow across the Nordic market.

In this role, you will drive the development of scalable, efficient and compliant data solutions, with a strong focus on operational excellence and exploring new opportunities for innovation. You will have significant autonomy and a broad mandate to influence technical direction, make key decisions and ensure they are executed with real impact.

We are looking for someone who combines strong technical expertise with a natural drive to take ownership and move things forward. Over time, you are motivated by the opportunity to take on greater responsibility and a more leading position within the area.

Your responsibilities will include:
• Defining and enforcing data modeling standards, best practices and governance policies.
• Designing and maintaining scalable data pipelines and optimizing ETL processes.
• Building and maintaining applications and integrations for data ingestion, transformation and delivery.
• Driving the shift from external-dependent delivery toward strong in-house capability.
• Setting the technical direction and owning key architectural decisions.
• Ensuring that BI is an integral part of the data platform, enabling trusted reporting, analytics and data-driven decision-making across the organization.

QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

You are someone who combines deep technical expertise with a natural drive to take ownership. You communicate clearly across technical and non-technical stakeholders and thrive in environments where you can shape and improve things rather than just maintain them.
You enjoy working closely with others, sharing knowledge and helping the team grow through collaboration, curiosity and mutual respect. You are humble enough to listen and confident enough to challenge when needed.

You also bring:
• Solid experience as a Data Engineer and experience with designing, modeling and implementing data-intensive systems.
• Strong proficiency in SQL and C# .NET/Python.
• Experience with ETL tools, data pipeline frameworks and orchestration tools.
• Understanding of CI/CD principles.
• Knowledge of data governance, GDPR compliance and security best practices.
• The ability to drive technical decisions and set standards.
• Fluency in English.
• Valid work permit.

You don't need to be senior in every area listed above. If you bring strong fundamentals and the right mindset, there is room to develop and grow into the full scope of the role.

Meriting experience:
• Experience from financial services, credit or similar data-intensive industries.
• Knowledge of one of the Nordic languages.
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

In Sergel, we care about the people we meet. We are a company with a culture based on trust and learning, where we work towards strengthening individuals through competence, compassion and a high level of engagement.
Together, we work with clear ownership and shared responsibility towards our stakeholders, which creates long-term and loyal business relations. We always try to find new ways of working and challenging the market. We want our employees to develop with the company and have fun with their colleagues on the way.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

• Start: By agreement
• Location: Central Stockholm
• Extent: Full-time
• Salary: By agreement

We recruit and provide consultants within sales, marketing, HR, customer service, finance, administration, IT, and tech – both specialists and generalists. With a strong focus on quality, long-term partnerships, and smart solutions, we support both companies and candidates in taking the next step.

jobs.title: 1 Systemutvecklare Backend
jobs.description:
Vill du arbeta med den senaste teknologin och som del av ett scrum-team, med stöd av kompetenta och trevliga kollegor i en kreativ och internationell miljö? Vill du ha en arbetsgivare som satsar på ett hållbart medarbetarskap och erbjuder trygga, förmånliga arbetsvillkor? Välkommen att söka anställning som systemutvecklare på Uppsala universitet.

National Bioinformatics Infrastructure Sweden (NBIS) söker nu ytterligare 1 systemutvecklare. Vi är en nationell infrastruktur vars syfte är att tillhandahålla support för bioinformatiker och forskare inom livsvetenskaperna. Systemutvecklingsgruppen består av två scrumteam som utvecklar verktyg för storskalig datahantering och webbapplikationer för forskargrupper och EU-finansierade projekt, allt inom området bioinformatik.

Att vara en del av ett av våra team ger dig möjlighet att göra skillnad, genom att arbeta i projekt vars mål är att göra forskningsdata säker och delbar. Du kommer att vara anställd vid Uppsala universitet, på Institutionen för cell- och molekylärbiologi (ICM), och vara knuten till NBIS och Science for Life Laboratory (SciLifeLab). Mer information om NBIS finns på https://nbis.se. 

Arbetsuppgifter

Som systemutvecklare kommer du att vara ansvarig för utveckling och underhåll av en delningsplattform för mänsklig genomikdata från forskningsprojekt, i samarbete med våra partners i andra europeiska länder. Målet med dessa projekt, som Genomic Data Infrastructure (GDI), är att hjälpa forskare att kunna dela sin data på ett säkert vis, och att på så sätt underlätta deras samarbeten runt mänsklig hälsa och medicin.

Projektet GDI handlar om att möjliggöra säker tillgång till genomiska och kliniska data inom EU, för att kunna förbättra klinisk diagnostik, behandlingar och prediktiv medicin. Bigpicture är ett annat europeiskt flaggskepp som syftar till att bygga en Petabyte plattform för AI inom digital patologi. Våra samarbetspartner kommer från akademin såväl som sjukvården och industrin.

Du kommer arbeta tätt tillsammans med andra utvecklare i ett av våra scrum-team och bidra till de ovan nämnda projekten. Scrum-teamet är ansvarig för produkternas hela livscykel, från planering och utveckling, till driftsättning och underhåll. Du kommer vara del av ett team som värdesätter kreativitet och ser gärna att du är med och påverkar alla beslut inom gruppen. 

Kvalifikationskrav

Du som sökande skall minst ha kandidatexamen inom informationsteknik, datateknik, datavetenskap, systemvetenskap eller bioinformatik, alternativt motsvarande dokumenterad kompetens inom ett eller flera av dessa områden.

Vidare krävs:

Minst fem års dokumenterad erfarenhet i systemutveckling med Python och Java
Minst fem års dokumenterad erfarenhet i Kubernetes med Helm och Hashicorp Vault eller OpenBao
Minst fem års erfarenhet av databaser, t. ex. PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB
Minst fem års dokumenterad erfarenhet av virtualiseringslösningar och mjukvaru-containrar (t.ex. Docker eller Podman)
Minst fem års erfarenhet av versionshantering med Git och CI/CD (t. ex. GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Bitbucket Pipelines)
Minst fem års erfarenhet av att arbeta agilt enligt scrum och scrum-rollerna certifikat (scrummaster eller produktägare)
Minst fem års dokumenterad erfarenhet i Infrastructure as Code med Terraform och Ansible och ett eller flera molnleverantörer (t. ex. Azure, AWS, Google Cloud)
Minst fem års erfarenhet och god förståelse av nätverk (TLS, TCP/UDP, HTTPS, routing) 
Att du kan uttrycka dig obehindrat på svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.

Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet, den sökande ska ha mycket god samarbetsförmåga, initiativförmåga och goda kommunikativa kvaliteter.

Önskvärt/meriterande i övrigt

Följande räknas som meriterande:

Vana att arbeta i fysiskt distribuerade team med kommunikation och koordination via elektroniska verktyg som videomöten och liknande.
Erfarenhet av att arbeta med informationssäkerhet är starkt meriterande
God förståelse av mekanismer för autentisering och auktorisation (t. ex. OAuth, JWT)
Kunskap om bioinformatik, i synnerhet är erfarenhet av verktyg och metoder för analys av human genomikdata särskilt efterfrågat.
Erfarenhet av verktyg för projektmanagement, t. ex. Zenhub, Jira.
Erfarenhet av arbete med infrastruktursystem för känsliga data, speciellt inom den offentliga sektorn eller akademin.

Om anställningen

Anställningen är tillsvidare (provanställning om 6 månader kan tillämpas). Omfattningen är heltid. Tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Placeringsort: Uppsala

Upplysningar om anställningen lämnas av:
Chef för systemutveckling Dimitris Bampalikis, dimitrios.bampalikis@nbis.se, +46 72 231 48 19, Vice Chef och Systemutvecklare, Malin Klang, malin.klang@nbis.se, +46 76 249 93 41 eller Avdelningsföreståndare Bengt Persson, bengt.persson@nbis.se.

Välkommen med din ansökan senast den 2026-09-28, UFV-PA 2026/2709. 

Uppsala universitet är ett brett forskningsuniversitet med stark internationell ställning. Det yttersta målet är att bedriva utbildning och forskning av högsta kvalitet och relevans för att göra skillnad i samhället. Vår viktigaste tillgång är alla 7 500 anställda och 53 000 studenter som med nyfikenhet och engagemang gör Uppsala universitet till en av landets mest spännande arbetsplatser.

Läs mer om våra förmåner och hur det är att jobba inom Uppsala universitet

https://uu.se/om-uu/jobba-hos-oss/

Anställningen kan komma att säkerhetsprövas. Vid säkerhetsprövning är en förutsättning för anställning att sökande blir godkänd.

Vi undanber oss erbjudanden om rekryterings- och annonseringshjälp.

Ansökan tas emot i Uppsala universitets rekryteringssystem.

Saco-S - saco-s@uu.se, Seko - seko@uadm.uu.se, ST (OFR/S) - ofr@uu.se

In this position, you will act as the primary technical point of contact for product rollouts and integrations, taking charge of technically scoping requirements, troubleshooting complex issues, and closely collaborating with engineering teams to enhance implementation flows.

Serve as the primary technical lead for customer integrations, ensuring smooth product rollouts and the scalable deployment of identity solutions.
Assess and scope technical requirements at the beginning of the client lifecycle to guarantee a seamless onboarding process.
Analyze and resolve complex technical problems, delivering quick and dependable support to clients.
Collaborate closely with internal engineering and product teams to refine implementation workflows and enhance core tooling.

Strong analytical skills and the ability to stay focused and resilient under pressure in dynamic, fast-evolving situations.

jobs.title: Software Developer Intern 2027 (6 or 9 months Placement)
jobs.description:
Introduction

At IBM Software, we transform client challenges into solutions. Building the world’s leading AI-powered, cloud-native products that shape the future of business and society. Our legacy of innovation creates endless opportunities for IBMers to learn, grow, and make an impact on a global scale. Working in Software means joining a team fueled by curiosity and collaboration. You’ll work with diverse technologies, partners, and industries to design, develop, and deliver solutions that power digital transformation. With a culture that values innovation, growth, and continuous learning, IBM Software places you at the heart of IBM’s product and technology landscape. Here, you’ll have the tools and opportunities to advance your career while creating software that changes the world.

Why IBM Ireland?

🔹 Innovate with Impact: Be at the forefront of technological innovation, developing backend services and APIs that power our world-class AI-infused management features.

🔹 Collaborate & Thrive: Work alongside industry-leading Architects, AI Experts, Product Managers, DevOps Engineers, and Test Automation Engineers in a dynamic, multi-disciplinary environment that fosters creativity and teamwork.

🔹 Endless Growth Opportunities: With our global reach and commitment to innovation, IBM Ireland is the perfect place to advance your career and explore new possibilities. Our doors are always open for those eager to learn and grow!

🔹 Developer Academy: Created to provide a foundation for new hires starting their journey as an enterprise developer at IBM Software. Over one-week intensive journey, developers are introduced to the devops mindset, Agile philosophy, cloud deployment models and basic Git concepts

Your Role And Responsibilities

This is a 6- or 9-month placement opportunity designed for students completing a placement year as part of their degree.

Start date: January - March 2027
Duration: 6 or 9 months
Working model: Hybrid

As part of our hybrid working model, you'll be expected to work from our Mulhuddart Campus three days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely in line with team requirements.

What Makes You a Great Fit

Tech Savvy

You have a basic understanding of one or more programming languages or technologies such as Java, Python, JavaScript, Rust, C/C++, Go, or similar, along with an interest in AI, Cloud Engineering, CI/CD, Test Automation, and software development methodologies.

This placement is designed to help you develop your technical skills, gain hands-on experience, and learn from experienced IBM professionals.

Growth Minded

You thrive in environments where learning never stops. You enjoy learning from others, sharing knowledge, and continuously developing new skills and technologies alongside your colleagues.

Self-Starter

You're a proactive problem-solver who takes initiative, embraces new challenges, and thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

What Are the Opportunities in IBM Ireland?

As An Intern Developer At IBM Ireland, You'll Have The Opportunity To Learn, Grow, And Contribute Across a Variety Of Areas, Including

Backend Development

Design and build robust microservices and APIs while helping shape the next generation of hybrid cloud management solutions.

Frontend Development

Create engaging user experiences and help solve design and usability challenges through creative problem-solving.
