jobs.title: Utvikler – SRE Cloude Engineer
jobs.description:
Oppdragsbeskrivelse:

Digitaliseringsavdelingen (DIGA) er UDI sin IT-avdeling. Avdelingen har en teamorganisering, fordelt på tekniske team, digitaliseringsteam og muliggjørende team. DIGA har ansvaret for UDI og utlendingsforvaltningen sine Digitale løsninger. I tillegg til å ansvaret for drift, forvaltning og utvikling av løsningene har UDI ved DIGA fått i oppdrag å gjennomføre et moderniseringsprogram, modernisering av utlendingsforvaltningen (ModUlf), som skal gjennomføre frem til 2031.

Team Datalagring har behov for en SRE Cloude Engineer. Teamet moderniserer sentrale og kritiske databaser og flytter dem fra on-prem til sky. Teamet trenger å styrke midlertidig med en SRE Engineer som skal bidra med å automatisere, overvåke og videreutvikle UDIs databaseplattform i skyen, og som bidrar til å sette premissene for hvordan vi former fremtidens driftsprosesser.

Arbeidsoppgaver:

Automatisert deployment og drift i sky
Automatisere og standardisere Database plattformdrift ved bruk av Infrastructure as Code (IaC), GitOps og CI/CD
Samarbeide tett med skyutviklingsteamene rundt deploy og runtime-miljø
Etablere og videreutvikle observability (monitoring, logging og alerting) i. Utarbeide en Proof-of-concept for UDI sin Cloud Monitoring med SRE KI agent.
Feilsøke hendelser og gjennomføre strukturerte rotårsak analyser
Administrere storage-, backup- og gjenopprettingsløsninger
Kravstille og lede skymigrasjon
Være kravstiller for nye databaser og lede migreringsprosesser til sky der database er en sentral komponent b. Være en pådriver for å identifisere nye muligheter, holde deg oppdatert på teknologi og trender innen skybaserte databaseplattformer
Vurdere skymigrasjon det dette er hensiktsmessig og forsvarlig
Sikkerhet og støtte til team
Sammen med arkitekter bidra til databasestruktur med fokus på personvern og sikkerhet.
Gjennomføre og bidra til ROS-analyser (risiko- og sårbarhetsvurderinger) for databaseplattform
Støtte team og prosjekter der det er naturlig

Kompetansekrav
:

Ressursen må ha minimum 8 års relevant erfaring innenfor arbeidsoppgavene som er angitt
Ressursen må ha minimum formell kompetanse på bachelorgradsnivå eller tilsvarende innenfor IKT relaterte områder. Lang og relevant dokumentert erfaring (mer enn 12 års erfaring) kan oppveie for kravet om formell utdannelse.
Ressursen må ha dokumentert erfaring med drift og administrasjon av skybaserte databaser, for eksempel Azure SQL, PostgreSQL eller Cosmos DB
Ressursen må har erfaring med å utarbeide POC for Cloude Monitoring med SRE KI-agent eller tilsvarende
Ressursen må ha erfaring med Microsoft Azure (App Services, nettverk, sikkerhet og lagring)
Ressursen må ha erfaring med plattformdrift, observability og livssyklushåndtering
Ressursen må ha kjennskap til Infrastructure as Code og DevOps-prinsipper

Ressursen må ha god skriftlig og muntlig fremstillingsevne på norsk

Ressursen må kunne sikkerhetsklareres og autoriseres for nivå BEGRENSET i henhold til sikkerhetsloven

Team Datalagring er på utkikk etter en SRE spesialist som har erfaring med plattformdrift av databasemiljøer i sky, utvikling av overvåkningsløsninger og automatiseringsløsninger ved hjelp av KI i drift og utvikling. Ressursen må ha lang erfaring med skybaserte databaser, gjerne fra miljøer med høye krav til stabilitet, ytelse, sikkerhet og automatisering. Ressursen må ha god forståelse for Infrastructure as Code, automatisering av overvåkning og varsling, trives med å ta i bruk moderne AI-verktøy i driftsarbeidet. Teamet har behov for en senior ressurs med lang og variert bakgrunn innen databaseutvikling. Ressursen må kunne dokumentere erfaring med drift og utvikling av database i sky.

Det er en fordel om ressursen har erfaring med:

Azure og Postgres SQL
API-desgin (OpenAPI/REST)
Infrastructure as Code og automatisering med GitOps, Terraform og CI/CD
Erfaring med å gjennomføre ROS-analyser (Risiko og sårbarhetsvurderinger)
Erfaring med KI/ML-plattformer eller høytytende arbeidsbelastninger er en fordel

Tydelig som kravstiller.
God til å samarbeide med andre.
Omstillingsdyktig og fleksibel
Gode kommunikasjons- og formidlingsegenskaper.
En god prosessdriver.
Kunne være bindeledd mellom teamet og andre applikasjonsteam
Pedagogisk
Ha godt humør.

Arbeidssted: UDI sine lokaler på Valle, men etter avtale kan noe hjemmekontor benyttes

jobs.title: Fullstack-kehittäjä (pääpaino backend)
jobs.description:
Haluatko tehdä koodia, jolla ratkaistaan oikeita asiakkaiden ongelmia, ja nähdä konkreettisesti oman työsi vaikutuksen?

Etsimme Koho Sales Oy:lle fullstack-kehittäjää osaksi ohjelmistokehitystiimiämme Helsingin Kalasatamaan. Roolin pääpaino on backend-kehityksessä, mutta meillä kehittäjät työskentelevät tarvittaessa myös frontendin parissa.

Koho on suomalainen SaaS-toiminnanohjausjärjestelmä, joka auttaa asiantuntijayrityksiä hallitsemaan muun muassa asiakkuuksia, projekteja, työaikaa, laskutusta, resursointia ja raportointia.

Millaista työ meillä on?

Meillä ohjelmistokehitys on hyvin käytännönläheistä ja lähellä asiakasta. Emme rakenna tuotetta tyhjältä pöydältä tai jahtaa uusimpia teknologiatrendejä, vaan kehitämme yli kymmenen vuotta rakennettua, laajasti käytössä olevaa järjestelmää, jonka pitää toimia luotettavasti asiakkaidemme arjessa. 

Tehtävässä ratkot asiakkaiden käytössä vastaan tulevia ongelmia, toteutat heidän tarpeistaan syntyviä muutoksia ja räätälöintejä sekä kehität samalla Kohoa jatkuvasti paremmaksi. Työssä pääset näkemään konkreettisesti, miten tekemäsi ratkaisut vaikuttavat asiakkaidemme päivittäiseen työhön.

Mitä pääset tekemään?

Fullstack-kehittäjänä työskentelet ennen kaikkea Kohon taustajärjestelmän kehittämisen ja ylläpidon parissa, mutta tehtävään kuuluu myös frontend-kehitystä. Kehitystyömme nojaa vahvasti Ruby on Rails -ohjelmistokehykseen ja MySQL-tietokantoihin. 

Työpöydälläsi voi olla esimerkiksi asiakkaalta noussut ongelma, olemassa olevan toiminnallisuuden parantaminen, integraatio tai uusi ominaisuus.

Työhösi kuuluu esimerkiksi:

Kohon backendin kehittäminen ja ylläpito
asiakkaiden tarpeista ja tiketeistä syntyvien muutosten ja räätälöintien toteuttaminen
bugien ja teknisten ongelmien selvittäminen ja korjaaminen
uusien ominaisuuksien kehittäminen osaksi olemassa olevaa järjestelmää
integraatioiden, rajapintojen ja tietokantojen parissa työskentely
tarvittaessa frontend-muutosten toteuttamista
tuotantoympäristön ongelmatilanteiden selvittäminen
yhteistyö muiden kehittäjien ja koholaisten kanssa.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Etsimme ensisijaisesti kehittäjää, jolla on jo jonkin verran kokemusta ohjelmistokehityksestä ja valmiudet tarttua itsenäisesti käytännön kehitystehtäviin. AI-työkalut voivat olla osa työkalupakkiasi, mutta meille on tärkeää, että ymmärrät itse tuottamasi koodin, osaat arvioida ratkaisujen toimivuutta ja laatua sekä pystyt perustelemaan tekemäsi tekniset valinnat. Sinun ei kuitenkaan tarvitse välttämättä olla senioritason konkari. Tärkeintä on riittävä tekninen osaaminen, oppimiskyky ja motivaatio kehittyä.

Toivomme sinulta:
kokemusta backend-ohjelmistokehityksestä
osaamista Ruby on Railsista tai valmiutta ottaa se nopeasti haltuun
perustason osaamista frontend-teknologioista (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)
ymmärrystä tietokannoista ja rajapinnoista
hyvää ongelmanratkaisukykyä ja uteliasta otetta ongelmien selvittämiseen
huolellisuutta sekä kiinnostusta laadukkaaseen ja ylläpidettävään koodiin
kykyä työskennellä sekä itsenäisesti että yhdessä muiden kanssa
sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa.

Kuka viihtyy meillä?

Viihdyt tässä roolissa todennäköisesti hyvin, jos pidät käytännönläheisestä ohjelmistokehityksestä ja ongelmanratkaisusta. Sinua motivoi se, että pääset selvittämään erilaisia tilanteita, kehittämään olemassa olevaa järjestelmää ja tekemään siitä jatkuvasti toimivamman ja paremman.

Työskentelet mielelläsi pitkäikäisen SaaS-tuotteen parissa ja pidät vaihtelevasta tekemisestä: vastaan tulee niin pieniä korjauksia ja asiakastarpeita kuin laajempia kehityskokonaisuuksiakin. Arvostat työn konkreettisuutta ja sitä, että tekemäsi ratkaisut päätyvät oikeasti asiakkaiden käyttöön.

Asiakaslähtöisyys on meille tärkeää myös ohjelmistokehityksessä. Olet kiinnostunut siitä, kuka tekemääsi ratkaisua käyttää, mitä sillä halutaan saavuttaa ja miten se helpottaa asiakkaan arkea. Arvostat sitä, että teknisellä työlläsi on selkeä yhteys asiakkaan tarpeisiin ja käytännön tekemiseen.

Mitä tarjoamme?

Saat ympärillesi kokeneen ohjelmistokehitystiimin ja mahdollisuuden ottaa vastuuta oman osaamisesi mukaan. Työsi vaikutukset näkyvät konkreettisesti asiakkaidemme arjessa, ja joskus ratkaisemasi ongelma helpottaa asiakkaan työtä jo saman päivän aikana.

Meillä on matala organisaatio, rento työilmapiiri ja mahdollisuus vaikuttaa siihen, miten asioita tehdään. Työskentelemme hybridimallilla, ja toimistomme sijaitsee Helsingin Kalasatamassa.

Tarjoamme lisäksi muun muassa lounas- ja matkapuhelinedun, kattavan työterveyshuollon sekä hammasedun.

Kiinnostuitko?

Lähetä hakemuksesi palkkatoiveineen viimeistään  25.10.2026
 mennessä. Älä kuitenkaan jää odottelemaan viimeiseen hakupäivään, sillä täytämme paikan heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa rekrytoiva esihenkilö Jaakko Kuisma (0503501107) perjantaisin klo 12:00-13:00.

Job Description & Requirements

We are seeking a hands-on AI Application Engineer to help bridge the gap between rapid AI prototyping and production-grade software delivery. In this role, you will help establish a structured path to production for high-potential AI use cases—transforming initial prototypes into secure, scalable, and fully governed applications.

Key Responsibilities

Re-architect early-stage AI prototypes and experimental code into maintainable, production-ready software using clean architecture, secure authentication, and robust APIs.
Design and build end-to-end AI capabilities, including conversational interfaces, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, workflow agents, and enterprise automation tools.
Build and maintain scalable applications across front-end UI, back-end APIs, database integrations, authentication, logging, and monitoring systems.
Implement AI safety patterns, including retrieval grounding, prompt management, input/output filtering, audit logging, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
Develop standardized starter templates, reusable patterns, and engineering playbooks to accelerate AI delivery across multiple teams.
Build automated testing suites (functional, regression, prompt quality, and guardrail validation) and implement system monitoring for latency, token usage, cost, and error tracking.
Partner with platform engineers to deploy applications via modern CI/CD pipelines, containerization standards, and enterprise cloud infrastructure.
Maintain solution designs, standard operating procedures, and support guides to ensure long-term maintainability.

Required Qualifications

7+ years of hands-on software development experience building and supporting enterprise-grade or cloud-native applications.
Strong expertise in modern languages and frameworks such as React, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, .NET, or Java.
Hands-on experience integrating applications with major cloud AI services (e.g., Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure ML, or equivalent public cloud environments) and RESTful services.
Practical experience implementing LLMs, RAG patterns, prompt engineering, vector search, embeddings, and workflow orchestration.
Solid understanding of secure coding practices (secrets management, least-privilege access) and identity frameworks (OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, JWT, RBAC).
Experience using CI/CD platforms (e.g., GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps), containerization, deployment rollbacks, and environment management.
Firm grasp of AI-specific risks, including hallucinations, prompt injection, data leakage, and explainability limitations.

Preferred Experience

Experience with AI orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen) and vector databases (e.g., pgvector, Pinecone).
Exposure to AI evaluation, red teaming, and safety benchmarking.

**Woon je (in de buurt van) het vierkant Zwolle, Meppel, Emmeloord en Lelystad? Ben jij iemand die graag sleutelt aan techniek, energie krijgt van klantcontact én op zoek is naar een afwisselende buitendienstfunctie? Dan horen we dat natuurlijk graag!**

**Wat ga je doen?**

Als **Field Service Engineer** ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het leveren van **hoogwaardige service** en ondersteuning aan onze klanten. Tijdens reparaties en onderhoud stel je diagnoses en bied je **technische oplossingen** voor Domino\-apparatuur, accessoires en toepassingen. Je onderscheidt je door net dat extra stapje te zetten en actief mee te denken met de klant over mogelijke **verbeteringen** voor de toekomst.

**Taken en verantwoordelijkheden**

* Verrichten van preventieve onderhoudswerkzaamheden bij klanten
* Zelfstandig storingen oplossen
* Ondersteunen bij nieuwe installaties
* Adviseren van de klant over verbeteringen, uitbreidingen en innovaties
* Proactief acties initiëren indien nodig
* Dagelijks rapportages creëren

**Wij zoeken jou!**

Jij gaat technische uitdagingen niet uit de weg en hebt affiniteit met productieomgevingen, computers en netwerken. Daarnaast ben je oplossingsgericht, besluitvaardig en pak je problemen proactief aan. Binnen onze organisatie stimuleren we bold behaviours: je vereenvoudigt waar mogelijk, daagt uit wanneer nodig, durft te beslissen en zorgt dat er geleverd wordt. Je herkent jezelf in onze kernwaarden: samenwerken, luisteren, expertise, ambitie en verantwoordelijkheid.

En verder ben je....

* technisch onderlegd met minimaal een afgeronde technische MBO\-opleiding (niveau 3 of 4\) of werkervaring in dit vakgebied en heb je technisch EN mechanisch inzicht,
* communicatief sterk in Nederlands en Engels,
* in staat om jouw analytische vermogen in te zetten om tot de kern van het probleem te komen en de beste langetermijnoplossing te bieden aan de klanten van Domino,
* flexibel en klantgericht,
* een teamspeler.

**Wat bieden wij jou?**

Je komt te werken bij een mooi internationaal bedrijf, waar de lijnen kort zijn en er een fijne werksfeer is. Daarnaast bieden wij:

* Een afwisselende baan met veel zelfstandigheid
* Volop groeikansen binnen de organisatie, zowel nationaal als internationaal
* Een aantrekkelijk salaris en goede arbeidsvoorwaarden
* Bonusregeling
* Laptop, mobiele telefoon en een auto van de zaak, die ook privé gebruikt kan worden
* Toegang tot (interne) opleidingen, trainingen en professionele tools
* 25 vakantiedagen – mogelijkheid om 3 vakantiedagen te verdienen in een bonus\-/malusregeling en/of 5 dagen per jaar bij te kopen (naar rato)

**William van de Vrugt**.  
Tel: 030 \- 636 3333 (algemeen) of **06 200 356 82**

www.dominobenelux.com

*Over Ons*

*Je kent ons waarschijnlijk niet maar je ziet ons elke dag. Je hoeft maar een supermarkt in te lopen en wij liggen in elk schap. Als ik aan je vraag of je wel eens naar de houdbaarheidsdatum op een pak melk hebt gekeken, dan zeg je vast ja.*

### **Descriptions \& requirements**

Job description
**Overview of the job**  

This is a non\-operational instructional job in an establishment.  

**Summary**  

The job holder will be responsible for providing supervision, knowledge and skills to prisoners in a specialist workshop so they can improve their employment prospects on release with a view to reducing reoffending.The job holder will ensure that all services are provided to a high standard and that security and control is maintained at all times. The job holder will be able to teach prisoners towards achieving nationally recognised qualifications and may be supported by external organisations such as local colleges.

  

This job description is not for use by job holders in basic assembly/packing workshops, instead Production Instructor – Enterprises should be used. However, on an exceptional short term basis job holders can supervise prisoners in more basic workshops.
  

  

This is a non\-operational job in an establishment with no line management responsibilities. **Responsibilities, Activities and Duties**  

The job holder will be required to carry out the following responsibilities, activities and duties
  

* May participate in the selection process of prisoners for the workshop/area of work.
* Induct prisoners to the workshop/area of work and train them in aspects such as Health and Safety, Control of Substance Hazardous to Health (COSHH), machinery and tools usage.
* Provide support for prisoners w required; tailor learning and training requirements to individual needs.
* Set work schedules and manage targets/quality standards, maintaining delivery of contractual arrangements.
* Assess and evaluate skills of prisoners up to national qualification standards.
* Supervise and maintain discipline of prisoners within workshop/area of work, responsible for performance, motivation, discipline, appraisal and development of prisoners.
* Maintain regular communications via radio net in accordance with Local Security Strategy (LSS).
* Open and complete Assessment Care in Custody and Teamwork (ACCT) forms, Violence Reduction Incident Reports (VRIR) and Security Information Reports (SIRs) when required and contribute to Incentive Earned Privileges (IEP) reports.
* Will conduct a metal detector scan or rub down search of prisoners attending and leaving their own workshops.
* Provide quality assurance against product specification.
* Log attendance and approve prisoner hours worked and wages including recording piece work w appropriate.
* Carry out fabric and tool checks of workshops and maintain security of areas, logging any tool/equipment faults. Undertake planned maintenance programme on machinery.
* Contribute to prisoner reports including parole and sentence planning.
* Complete regime monitoring information and update prisoner training records.
* Contribute to Health and Safety risk assessments relating to the workshop/area of work and specialist areas.
* Request materials and estimate usage in order to meet work targets.
* Initiate product development reviews to maintain workshop/area of work output levels, and to provide variety of work and experience for prisoners.
* Participate in self\-audit and in achieving Service Delivery Indicators (SDIs).
* Complete administration activities to support the smooth running of the workshop.


  

The duties/responsibilities listed above describe the post as it is at present and is not intended to be exhaustive. The job holder is expected to accept reasonable alterations and additional tasks of a similar level that may be necessary. Significant adjustments may require re\-examination under the Job Evaluation Scheme and shall be discussed in the first instance with the job holder.  

  

An ability to fulfil all spoken aspects of the role with confidence through the medium of English or (w specified in Wales) Welsh.  

**Behaviours**  

* Making Effective Decisions
* Communicating and Influencing
* Working Together
* Managing a Quality Service
* Developing Self and Others

  

**Experience**  

* Must have relevant work experience in a production environment
* Preferable for candidate to have some supervisory experience
* Should have experience of using industrial standard machinery and equipment

 **Technical requirements**  

* Currently hold or be prepared to work towards Level 3 or equivalent in Engineering related production
* The ability to read, understand and work from technical drawings

 **Ability**  

* IT Skills
* Basic Maths
* Basic English

 **Hours of Work and Allowances**  

37 hour working week (standard).  

  

  

Additional Information
**Working Arrangements \& Further Information**


The MoJ offers Hybrid Working arrangements w business need allows. This is an informal, non\-contractual form of flexible working that blends working from your base location, different MoJ sites and / or from home (please be aware that this role can only be worked in the UK and not overseas). Some roles will not be suitable for Hybrid Working. Similarly, Hybrid Working will not suit everyone’s circumstances. Arrangements will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate(s) and subject to regular review.


For nationally advertised roles, the successful candidate(s) will be appointed to a MoJ office location, which may include their nearest Justice Collaboration Centre or Justice Satellite Office. This will be discussed and agreed on the completion of pre\-employment checks.


Some of MoJ’s terms and conditions of service are changing as part of Civil Service reform. The changes will apply to staff joining MoJ who are new to the Civil Service. Staff joining MoJ from other civil service employers will transfer onto the new MoJ terms if they are already on 'modernised' terms in their current post or onto 'unmodernised' MoJ terms if they are on 'unmodernised' terms at their current post. Details will be available if an offer is made.


Standard full time working hours are 37 hours per week excluding breaks which are unpaid. HMPPS welcomes part\-time, flexible and job\-sharing working patterns, w they meet the demands of the role and business needs. All applications for part\-time, flexible and job\-sharing working patterns will be considered in accordance with the HMPPS’ Flexible Working policy.


If you are a current NPS employee, this vacancy may be available on a Loan basis for up to 2 years. Applications are invited from suitable qualified staff.


The Loan/Secondment is subject to the approval of the selected candidate's Business Unit, which should be obtained before confirmation of appointment.

**Benefits**

**Annual Leave**

* The holiday year runs from 1 March. If you work a non standard work pattern your leave entitlement may be expressed in either hours or days as appropriate. Leave entitlement is calculated on a pro\-rata basis and you will be advised of your actual entitlement on appointment. If you were appointed internally and your leave was previously calculated in days, this will continue to be the case.

**Bank, Public and Privilege Holidays**

* You are entitled to 9 days (66 hours 36 minutes) in recognition of bank, public and privilege holidays. These hours are added to your annual leave allowance. T is a requirement to work some public and bank holidays subject to your shift pattern and the operational needs of the establishment

**Pension**

* The Civil Service offers a choice of two pension schemes, giving you the flexibility to choose the pension that suits you best.

HM Prison \& Probation Service (HMPPS) is keen to encourage alternative working arrangements. HMPPS offers flexible working subject to completion of a satisfactory probationary period and NVQ

**A Great Place to Work for Veterans**

jobs.title: Systems Engineering Graduate Programme
jobs.description:
**Location:**  

Rosyth, Dunfermline, Kirkcaldy, GB, KY11 2YD
  
  

**\#job\-location.job\-location\-inline { display:** inline; }
  
**Onsite or Hybrid:** Hybrid
  
  

Systems Engineering Graduate Programme
  
  

**Programme title:** Systems Engineering Graduate Programme
  
  

**Salary:** Minimum £35,000\. Salary is dependent on location, role and qualifications.
  
  

**Location:** Rosyth, Fife, Scotland
  
  

**Application closing date:** 20 October 2026
  
  

**Programme start date:** September 2027
  
  

**Role ID:** 74560
  
  

What will you do on the programme?
  
  

At Babcock, Systems Engineering is the glue that holds complex projects together. As a Graduate Systems Engineer, you’ll be at the centre of some of the UK’s most advanced engineering programmes \- applying systems principles to ensure that every component, process and stakeholder aligns to deliver safe, effective and sustainable solutions.
  
  

Your work will shape systems that matter. You could be involved in designing and integrating cutting\-edge submarines, converting military vehicles for new operational roles, refurbishing naval ships to extend their service life, infrastructure to support the refit of nuclear submarines, developing secure satellite communication systems, or advancing next\-generation nuclear power plants that support the UK’s net\-zero goals. Each project presents unique systems challenges – and opportunities to make a real impact.
  
  

You’ll support work across various stages of the engineering lifecycle – from technology innovation and concept design to production, commissioning, in\-service support, and decommissioning. You’ll help bring structure to complexity \- defining requirements, managing interfaces and supporting integration across multidisciplinary teams. Through practical experience and structured development, you’ll build the skills to engage with stakeholders, understand system needs, identify and mitigate risks, and ensure systems meet requirements and are ready for the real world.
  
  

How is the programme structured?
  
  

Over two years, you’ll rotate through placements every three to six months, giving you the opportunity to explore a broad range of projects and teams. These rotations offer opportunities to broaden your experience – and some may even take you to different locations – helping you build your professional network and deepen your understanding of how the business operates.
  
  

Along the way, you’ll collaborate with experienced professionals across a range of disciplines, which may include engineering design, software, mechanical, construction, and electrical engineering, as well as in project management, quality assurance, and supply chain.
  
  

This experience will help you build a strong foundation in systems engineering, while gradually taking on greater responsibilities, such as leading small teams and overseeing projects. As you progress, you'll have the chance to align your placements with your interests and career goals, helping you build relevant experience in areas that matter most to you.
  
  

How do we develop and support you?
  
  

From day one, you’ll receive structured support, personalised training, and dedicated mentorship to help you excel throughout your programme and beyond.
  
  

You’ll join our Graduate Development Programme, featuring expert\-led masterclasses on communication, personal branding, resilience, and wellbeing.
  
  

To support your journey toward Chartered or Incorporated Engineer status, we offer guidance and cover all associated fees.
  
  

What’s waiting for you after the programme?
  
  

Once you complete the programme, you’ll move into a permanent role within our Engineering Function, where you can continue applying and expanding the skills you've developed. You’ll also have the opportunity to build on your progress toward professional registration, a recognised benchmark of engineering competence, which can support your journey into more advanced roles, such as Senior Engineer.
  
  

As a global organisation, Babcock provides countless opportunities to enhance your skills and advance your career. To support your growth, we've introduced the Babcock Role Framework, which outlines roles, career pathways, and development opportunities. With every job mapped to these frameworks, you’ll have a transparent view of the steps needed to reach Senior Engineer and beyond.
  
  

What rewards and benefits will you get?
  
  

We want you to feel supported, valued and excited about what’s ahead. That’s why we offer a comprehensive package designed to support your development, your wellbeing and your life outside of work too.
  
  

In addition to a minimum starting salary of £35,000, you’ll benefit from:
  
  

A minimum of 25 days of holiday plus bank holidays
  
Generous pension and employee share schemes
  
Flexible benefits, including cycle to work scheme, discounts
  
Wellbeing support, covering mental, physical, financial, and social wellbeing, with services like our Employee Assistance Programme, digital GP service, and health checks.
  
  

You’ll also have the chance to get involved in our STEM outreach activities and volunteering opportunities.
  
  

What do you need to apply?
  
  

You'll need to have achieved, or be on track to achieve, a BEng, MEng, BSc, or MSc in a STEM discipline. We welcome applicants from a broad range of subjects, including Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, and emerging technology fields such as AI, Machine Learning, Robotics, and Cybernetics.
  
Many of our programmes are subject to Security Clearance and Trade Control restrictions which mean that your place of birth, nationality, citizenship, or residency you hold or have held may impact which programmes you are eligible for. For this programme, you must be able to achieve and maintain Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) and Security Check (SC) security clearance. For further details, visit GOV.UK and search ‘United Kingdom Security Vetting: clearance levels’.
  
  

Where will you be based?
  
  

Places on our Systems Engineering programme for September 2027 are available in Rosyth, Scotland.
  
  

Our 320\-acre Rosyth facility is home to one of the UK’s largest and most advanced waterside manufacturing and repair sites. As a graduate, you could be involved in supporting the full lifecycle of naval vessels or helping deliver complex, large\-scale marine build projects. Whether you're working on new\-build programmes or enhancing existing systems, your role will be vital in delivering dependable, mission\-ready solutions across the marine industry.
  
  

We offer agile working, giving you some flexibility, but you can expect to spend several days a week on\-site as part of your role and development. By your start date, you must be able to reliably commute to the site. This will normally require living within a reasonable commuting distance of Rosyth or relocating before you join us.
  
  

While you’ll join a specific business area and location, placements at different sites across the UK are possible. We encourage flexibility and openness to relocation throughout the programme and will consider your personal circumstances when arranging placements.

jobs.description:
**Företagsbeskrivning**  

På Bosch Thermoteknik AB i Tranås formar vi framtiden för hållbart boende. Som en  

nyckelaktör inom divisionen Bosch Home Comfort utvecklar och tillverkar vi värme\- och  

kyllösningar i världsklass.


Vi tillhör affärsenheten Electric Solutions (ES), som leder den globala energiomställningen  

genom utveckling av modern och innovativ värmepumpsteknik. För att våra högeffektiva system  

ska fungera optimalt förlitar sig vårt nätverk med över 1 000 servicetekniker runtom i Europa –  

liksom våra utvecklingslaboratorier – på pålitliga och moderna desktopapplikationer och  

mjukvaruverktyg.


Vi söker nu en engagerad **Mjukvaruutvecklare** till vårt team i Tranås. I den här rollen tar du  

ägarskap över centrala applikationer som vårt fältverktyg **SWDL (Software Download)** samt  

utvecklar skräddarsydda verktyg för loggning, datainsamling och diagnostik som underlättar  

vardagen för våra testingenjörer i labbet vid verifiering av värmepumpar.

 **Jobbeskrivning** **Utveckling av desktopapplikationer:** Designa, bygga och underhålla moderna Windowsapplikationer  

med C\# och .NET\-ekosystemet (.NET Framework / moderna .NET).

**Stötta labbingenjörer:** Utveckla intuitiva verktyg för dataloggning, monitorering och diagnostik som används av testingenjörer för att fånga och analysera systembeteenden i realtid vid labbtester.

**Flashing och mjukvaruuppdateringar:** Förvalta och förbättra stabila rutiner för mjukvarunedladdning och flashning av firmware, både för labbmiljöer och för serviceverksamhet i fält.

**Kommunikation med hårdvara och enheter:** Implementera och stödja robusta kommunikationsgränssnitt mellan desktopmjukvaran och inbyggda styrsystem eller testutrustning (till exempel seriell kommunikation och CAN\-bus).

**Tvärfunktionellt samarbete:** Arbeta nära utvecklare inom inbyggda system (firmware), hårdvaruspecialister och testingenjörer för att stämma av krav och verifiera nya versioner av verktygen.

**Användbarhet och ständiga förbättringar:** Förbättra UI/UX, automatisera datavisualisering och effektivisera arbetsflöden så att komplexa diagnostik\- och testprocesser blir enkla och driftsäkra.

 **Kvalifikationer** **Utbildning:** Högskole\- eller civilingenjörsexamen inom datateknik, elektroteknik,  

mjukvaruteknik eller motsvarande praktisk erfarenhet.

**God kompetens inom C\#:** Gedigen erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling för desktop med C\#  

och .NET.

**Förståelse för hårdvarukommunikation och diagnostik:** Erfarenhet av mjukvara som kommunicerar med hårdvara, enhetskommunikation (t.ex. CAN\-bus) samt diagnostik\- eller flashrutiner (som UDS och bootloaders).

**Kunskaper i Python (meriterande):** Erfarenhet av Python är ett stort plus för skriptning, testautomatisering, dataanalys och snabb framtagning av prototyper.

**Förståelse för inbyggda system (meriterande):** Kunskaper i C eller C\+\+ är meriterande och underlättar dialogen och samarbetet med utvecklarna som programmerar mikrokontrollerna.

**Erfarenhet av labbmiljö och mätverktyg:** Praktisk bakgrund inom testverktyg, dataloggers, telemetri eller testautomatisering är starkt meriterande.

**Analytisk problemlösare:** Ett strukturerat och metodiskt arbetssätt vid felsökning av mjukvarans interaktion med hårdvara och analys av kommunikationsloggar.

**Språkkunskaper:** Mycket goda kunskaper i engelska i tal och skrift är ett krav. Kunskaper i svenska är starkt meriterande för det dagliga samarbetet på plats i Tranås.

**Betydelsefull påverkan:** Direkt ägarskap över verktyg som är affärskritiska både för den dagliga forskningen och utvecklingen i våra labb och för servicetekniker runtom i Europa.  

**Flexibilitet:** Moderna möjligheter till hybridarbete och flexibla arbetstider som främjar en sund balans mellan arbete och fritid.  

**Hållbar teknik:** Möjligheten att vara en del av en organisation dedikerad till grön spetsteknik (elektrifiering, naturliga köldmedier såsom propan, och intelligent klimatstyrning).  

**Utveckling och kultur:** Breda utvecklingsmöjligheter för både personlig och professionell tillväxt inom den globala Bosch\-koncernen.

**About the Opportunity**
=========================


Job Type: Permanent
Application Deadline: 28 September 2026**Job Description**

  



**Title** AI Solutions Engineer

**Department** Asset Management Platforms

**Location**Dublin

**Reports To**Head of Portfolio Management Tooling, AMP

**Level** 6


We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together \- and supporting each other \- all over the world. So, join our team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.


Our clients come from all walks of life and so do we. We are proud of our inclusive culture and encourage applications from the widest mix of talent, whatever your age, gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender identity, social background and more.


As a flexible employer, we trust our people to perform their role in the way that works best for them, our clients and our business. We are a disability\-friendly company and would welcome a conversation with you if you feel you might benefit from any reasonable adjustments to perform to the best of your ability during the recruitment process and beyond.

**About your team**


Asset Management Platforms (AMP) is responsible for the design, engineering and delivery of technology solutions that support Fidelity's global Asset Management business. We partner with Investment Management, Asset Management Operations and Distribution teams across Europe and Asia to deliver modern platforms that enable investment professionals to make better investment decisions and improve client outcomes.


The Portfolio Management Tooling team develops and supports the technology ecosystem used by Portfolio Managers, Investment Directors, Quantitative Researchers and Investment Specialists across multiple investment capabilities, including Multi\-Asset, Systematic Investing, Fixed Income and Equities. Our platforms underpin critical investment processes including research, portfolio construction, analytics, order generation, execution management and investment risk.


As Artificial Intelligence continues to transform software engineering, we are investing in modern engineering practices that combine AI\-assisted development with robust engineering disciplines to improve productivity, quality and speed of delivery. The AI Solutions Engineer will play a key role in helping engineering teams adopt AI\-enabled development practices safely, effectively and responsibly across Asset Management Platforms.

**About your role**  

The AI Solutions Engineer is a hands\-on technical leader responsible for accelerating software engineering delivery through the effective adoption of Artificial Intelligence and modern engineering practices.


Working closely with Engineering Leads, Solution Architects, Product Owners and software engineering teams, you will identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity through AI\-assisted development while maintaining Fidelity's high standards for architecture, engineering governance, software quality and security.


You will combine strong software engineering expertise with practical knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI\-powered development tooling to establish best practices for AI\-assisted software engineering. This includes enabling engineering teams to make effective use of technologies such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and other AI coding assistants to improve software design, implementation, testing, documentation and operational support.


The role is equally focused on engineering excellence and innovation. You will champion modern software engineering practices, support architectural decision\-making, promote CI/CD and DevSecOps adoption, and help establish governance frameworks for the responsible use of AI within the software development lifecycle.


This is an exciting opportunity to shape how AI is adopted across Asset Management Platforms, helping engineering teams deliver high\-quality software faster while ensuring solutions remain secure, maintainable and aligned with Fidelity's engineering standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

**AI Engineering Enablement**

* Drive adoption of AI\-assisted software engineering practices across Asset Management Platforms.
* Evaluate emerging AI development tools and recommend practical use cases for engineering teams.
* Champion the effective use of Large Language Models to improve developer productivity and software quality.
* Develop reusable prompts, workflows, templates and engineering patterns for AI\-assisted software development.
* Coach and mentor engineering teams in the effective use of Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and other AI\-assisted development tools.
* Identify opportunities where AI can automate engineering activities including documentation, code generation, testing, code review, refactoring and technical analysis.
* Help establish engineering standards and governance for AI\-generated code.

**Software Engineering**

* Design and develop modern software solutions supporting Fidelity's investment management platforms.
* Promote engineering best practices across software design, development, testing and maintainability.
* Support engineering teams with complex technical design and implementation challenges.
* Encourage clean architecture, modular design and reusable software components.
* Participate in code reviews and engineering quality initiatives.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of engineering standards and practices.

**Engineering Excellence**

* Champion modern engineering practices including Continuous Integration, Continuous Delivery and DevSecOps.
* Improve engineering productivity through automation and tooling.
* Work with engineering teams to optimise software delivery pipelines.
* Promote test automation and engineering quality throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Support engineering governance while encouraging innovation and experimentation.

**Architecture \& Governance**

* Collaborate with Solution Architects and Engineering Leads to ensure solutions align with Fidelity's target architecture.
* Ensure AI\-assisted software development complies with engineering standards, security policies and regulatory requirements.
* Promote sound software engineering principles including maintainability, scalability, resilience and observability.
* Contribute to engineering roadmaps and technology strategy.
* Balance innovation with appropriate technology risk management and governance.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Build strong working relationships with Engineering Leads, Product Owners, Solution Architects and software engineering teams.
* Partner with investment technology stakeholders to understand engineering challenges and identify opportunities for AI\-enabled improvement.
* Establish and support communities of practice around AI\-assisted software engineering.
* Deliver demonstrations, technical workshops and knowledge\-sharing sessions with senior investment professionals.
* Stay informed on emerging AI technologies and assess their applicability within Fidelity's engineering environment.

**About you**


You are a hands\-on engineer with strong technical aptitude, curiosity and a passion for using AI to build useful software. You enjoy learning through experimentation, working with others and turning ideas into practical solutions in a fast\-moving environment.

**Experience**

* Practical experience using AI development tools to build or prototype solutions; this may come from professional experience, personal projects or independent experimentation.
* Good understanding of software engineering principles and experience working with code.
* Experience with AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor or similar.
* Understanding of prompt engineering and AI\-enabled software development workflows.
* Evidence of having built or delivered something practical, with an interest in progressing prototypes towards production.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the confidence to engage with business and technology colleagues.


Experience with some of the following would be useful; we do not expect candidates to have experience across all areas:

* Java, Python, C\#, TypeScript or similar languages
* AWS, Azure or GCP
* Docker and Kubernetes
* Git\-based development workflows
* REST APIs and event\-driven architectures
* Test automation and Infrastructure as Code
* Observability and monitoring tools


Experience in Asset Management, Investment Management or Financial Services is desirable but not essential.

**Personal Attributes**

* Curious, creative and enthusiastic about experimenting with AI.
* Strong aptitude and willingness to learn new technologies quickly.
* Pragmatic and comfortable learning from approaches that do not work.
* Collaborative, adaptable and comfortable working across business and technology teams.
* Delivery\-focused and motivated by turning ideas into useful outcomes.
* Comfortable working with some ambiguity while seeking guidance when needed.

**Behavioural Expectations**

**Brave**

* Prioritise learning and momentum over defending legacy commitments.
* Remove blockers and reset priorities when outcomes are at risk.
* Role model stopping or reshaping work that no longer delivers value.

**Bold**

* Set clear, outcome\-led direction and make decisive trade\-offs.
* Simplify processes and governance where possible.
* Empower teams through effective decision making.

**Curious**

* Drive continuous prioritisation based on outcomes, data and evidence.
* Challenge assumptions and encourage innovative thinking.
* Use delivery metrics and business outcomes to inform decision making.

**Compassionate**

* Act as a visible advocate for client and business outcomes.
* Foster collaboration, trust and psychological safety.
* Balance delivery pace with sustainable ways of working.

**Feel rewarded**


For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

Zie jij uitdaging in het ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en optimaliseren van softwareoplossingen? Bij Scholt Energy krijg je de kans om een belangrijke rol te spelen in de snel veranderende energiemarkt. Samen met een team van 10 tot 15 gedreven ontwikkelaars vertaal je strategische doelstellingen naar slimme informatievoorzieningen en systeemintegraties die risico's verminderen en de efficiëntie verhogen. Je vertaalt wensen naar softwareoplossingen en houdt daarbij rekening met technische en functionele eisen, waarborgt de kwaliteit en zorgt voor een actuele documentatie.

Bij Scholt Energy doe je meer dan alleen software onderhouden; door onze aanhoudende groei werk je actief mee aan het ontwikkelen en toevoegen van nieuwe functionaliteiten die ons én de energiemarkt naar een hoger niveau tillen!

Wat breng je mee:

Een bachelorsdiploma, bijvoorbeeld in informatica of een vergelijkbare richting, aangevuld met minimaal vijf jaar relevante werkervaring binnen softwareontwikkeling of integratie.
Sterke kennis van .NET C#, waarbij ervaring met TypeScript of JavaScript, SQL, Azure en het Microsoft Power Platform worden gezien als een pre.
Aantoonbare ervaring met het ontwerpen, initiëren en realiseren van softwareoplossingen binnen vastgestelde architectuur- en beveiligingsrichtlijnen.
Het vermogen om teams te ondersteunen bij de ontwikkeling en implementatie van informatievoorzieningsoplossingen en om de impact van proces- en systeemwijzigingen nauwkeurig te analyseren.
Ervaring met het bewaken van integraties, inclusief monitoring, root cause analyses en het verbeteren van prestaties en betrouwbaarheid.
Een nauwkeurige en gestructureerde manier van werken waardoor documentatie, rapportages en informatiestromen altijd volledig, duidelijk en actueel zijn.
Het vermogen om als intern en extern aanspreekpunt te fungeren voor de doorontwikkeling van software en integraties, inclusief technische advisering op het gebied van inrichting en maatwerk.
Ervaring in het opstellen en evalueren van businesscases.
Een vooruitdenkende instelling, gecombineerd met analytisch vermogen en uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden, waardoor je complexe vraagstukken helder weet over te brengen.

Wat wij jou bieden:

Een organisatie met een duidelijke visie: klimaat neutrale energie voor alle bedrijven. Wij ondersteunen onze klanten en partners in de energietransitie. We zijn ambitieus, maar tegelijkertijd realistisch over wat haalbaar is.
Een open, betrokken en professionele bedrijfscultuur: bij ons staat een persoonlijke aanpak voorop maar tegelijkertijd blijven we professioneel en gefocust. We vinden het belangrijk dat collega’s het naar hun zin hebben en met een eNPS (medewerkerstevredenheid) van maar liefst +37 weten we dit met z’n allen te bereiken.
Werkplezier als vast onderdeel van je baan. We vieren successen. Dit doen we door onder andere elke werkweek af te sluiten met een borrel, verschillende sportevents te organiseren, een jaarlijkse teamactiviteit en een internationaal bedrijfsuitje met collega’s uit al onze landen. Jij kiest wat je leuk vindt en waarbij je graag aansluit.
Een internationaal team dat jou verwelkomt. Gedreven collega’s uit verschillende landen die uitkijken naar jouw kennis, ideeën en energie.
Bij ons creëer jij zélf je kansen. Wie initiatief toont en wil groeien, kan bereiken wat hij of zij wil. Jij bepaalt het tempo én de richting; wij zorgen voor de mogelijkheden. Er is geen vast opleidingsbudget: iedere training, opleiding of cursus die jou sterker maakt in je rol én bijdraagt aan onze gezamenlijke ambities, ondersteunen we volledig. In 2025 stroomden maar liefst 102 collega’s intern door naar een nieuwe functie — simpelweg omdat ze hun kansen grepen en hun eigen pad vormgaven.
Aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden. Met waaronder vakantiegeld, een zorgeloos pensioen, een fietsplan en 28 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om tot 5 extra dagen bij te kopen bij een fulltime dienstverband.
Flexibel werken mét persoonlijke verbinding. Start je dag tussen 7.00 en 9.00 uur. Je werkt minimaal drie dagen per week op kantoor en de rest kan je (indien gewenst) werken vanuit thuis. Daarvoor ontvang je een thuiswerkvergoeding én €250 om jouw thuiswerkplek naar wens in te richten. Je ontvangt deze vergoeding ongeacht of jij jouw thuiswerkplek al hebt ingericht of niet.

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer (.NET) – Medior / Senior
jobs.description:
Bouw mee aan de digitale toekomst van Nederland

Wil jij als Full Stack Developer werken aan slimme digitale oplossingen die dagelijks impact hebben op de inrichting van de openbare ruimte en infrastructuur? Bij CROW krijg je de kans om moderne technologieën zoals .NET, React, Azure, Elasticsearch en AI in te zetten voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Je ontwikkelt niet alleen software, maar helpt ook mee aan de digitale transformatie van een organisatie die richting geeft aan de leefomgeving van Nederland. Of je nu een ervaren medior bent of een senior die graag technische koers bepaalt en collega's inspireert: bij CROW krijg je de ruimte om te bouwen, te vernieuwen en écht het verschil te maken.

Wat ga je doen?

Binnen het team Digitale Informatie is behoefte ontstaan om onze developmentcapaciteit op korte termijn uit te breiden. Daarom zijn wij op zoek naar een Full Stack Developer die zelfstandig werkt aan zowel backend- als frontendontwikkeling en een actieve bijdrage levert aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze digitale informatievoorziening.

Je vertaalt complexe vraagstukken naar praktische technische oplossingen en realiseert deze zelfstandig. Daarbij denk je actief mee over architectuur, schaalbaarheid, innovatie en de inzet van moderne technologieën.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

Het ontwikkelen en onderhouden van backend-applicaties in .NET/C#.
Het ontwerpen, bouwen en optimaliseren van API's en data access patterns.
Het ontwikkelen en verbeteren van frontendfunctionaliteiten met React of Angular binnen een MVC-context.
Het meedenken over softwarearchitectuur en technische verbeteringen.
Het werken met zoektechnologieën zoals Elasticsearch.
Het onderzoeken en implementeren van AI-toepassingen, waaronder Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
Het inrichten en onderhouden van cloud deployments en CI/CD-processen binnen een Azure- en GitHub-omgeving.
Het samenwerken met collega's, product owners en andere stakeholders om onze digitale dienstverlening continu te verbeteren.

Wat bieden we jou?

Een salaris tussen € 4.522,- en € 6.908,- bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur.
Een dienstverband van 32 tot 40 uur per week, bij voorkeur fulltime.
25 vakantiedagen en 12 adv-dagen.
Een persoonlijk keuzebudget bestaande uit 6 (van de 12) ADV dagen, eindejaarsuitkering en vakantiegeld.
Een premievrije pensioenopbouw.
Hybride werken, met een thuiswerk-, internet- en eenmalige werkplekvergoeding.
Een laptop en moderne tooling om optimaal te kunnen werken.
Een maandelijks vitaliteitsbudget en korting op je sportschoolabonnement via onze bedrijfsregeling.
Volop ruimte voor opleiding en ontwikkeling op het gebied van cloud, AI en moderne softwareontwikkeling.
Een uitgebreid introductie- en inwerkprogramma.
Een uitdagende functie binnen een ambitieuze organisatie met maatschappelijke impact.

Jij voelt je hier thuis als...

je energie krijgt van eigenaarschap en verantwoordelijkheid;
je zelfstandig kunt werken, maar ook graag samenwerkt met collega's;
je enthousiast wordt van een omgeving waarin technologie continu in ontwikkeling is;
je graag werkt aan innovatieve oplossingen en nieuwe technologieën;
je het leuk vindt om zowel backend als frontend op te pakken.

Jouw talent

Je kijkt verder dan individuele features en denkt vanuit het grotere geheel. Je begrijpt hoe systemen samenhangen, hebt oog voor technische verbeteringen en combineert analytisch vermogen met een pragmatische, hands-on instelling. Je schrijft onderhoudbare, testbare en goed gedocumenteerde code.

Wij zoeken een van de volgende profielen:

Medior Full Stack Developer

Circa 3 tot 5 jaar relevante werkervaring.
Een sterke basis in .NET/C# en MVC.
Ervaring met backendontwikkeling, API's en data access patterns.
Basiskennis van frontendontwikkeling met React of Angular.
Basiskennis van cloudtechnologie en CI/CD.
Interesse om je verder te ontwikkelen op het gebied van AI, RAG en Elasticsearch.

Senior Full Stack Developer

Minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring.
Een sterke basis in .NET/C# en MVC.
Ervaring met backendontwikkeling, API's en data access patterns.
Ervaring met React of Angular binnen een MVC-context.
Brede ervaring met Azure, GitHub, CI/CD en cloud deployment.
Ervaring met Elasticsearch en AI-oplossingen zoals Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
In staat om architectuurkeuzes te maken, richting te geven aan technische ontwikkelingen en collega's te coachen.

Verder

Heb je een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk..
Ben je woonachtig in Nederland zodat je ook op kantoor met collega’s kunt verbinden.

Over CROW

Zonder CROW zou Nederland er heel anders uit zien. Zodra je de deur uitgaat en om je heen kijkt, zie je een openbare ruimte en infrastructuur die is vormgegeven met behulp van onze richtlijnen, systematieken en praktische tools. CROW ontwikkelt deze breed gedragen collectieve richtlijnen en kennis samen met belangrijke partijen als opdrachtgevers, opdrachtnemers, adviseurs en toeleveranciers. Wij vervullen hierbij een belangrijke verbindende rol.

CROW faciliteert kennisdeling, bevordert kennistoepassing en duidt beschikbare informatie. CROW richt zich hierbij op de praktijk van vandaag en morgen. CROW bevindt zich in de overgangsfase van een traditioneel kennisbedrijf naar een kennisbedrijf wat zich ook op de digitalisering van deze kennis richt. Een belangrijk doel is om de gebruikers van de kennis van CROW (onze klanten) zo optimaal mogelijk te bedienen door de juiste content in de juiste vorm en juiste samenhang digitaal aan te bieden in het werkproces van de klant.

Wil je meer weten?

Voor meer informatie over deze vacature kun je contact opnemen met Rick Otterloo, Productowner via rick.otterloo@crow.nl.

jobs.description:
# QA (Automation) Engineer - End to End

## About the Role

Priva is seeking a **QA Automation Engineer** focused on **end-to-end testing of distributed software systems**. This role will establish a coherent, platform-level quality approach across the capabilities owned by **Team Mobius and Team Rangers**, bringing together existing integration and system-level testing approaches rather than creating another isolated test suite.

You will work across services and teams to identify dependencies, data flows, failure modes, and operational risks, then translate those risks into maintainable automated tests and stronger release evidence. You will collaborate with engineers, QA colleagues, Product, architects, application teams, and support specialists while helping teams take greater ownership of quality.

## Key Responsibilities

- Create and maintain a platform-level **end-to-end test strategy** covering critical customer and operational journeys across services.
- Map system boundaries, dependencies, data flows, and failure modes.
- Translate the highest operational risks into executable test scenarios.
- Build and maintain automated tests using real service interfaces and representative environments.
- Bring existing team-level test frameworks and suites into a coherent approach.
- Reuse effective testing capabilities and remove unnecessary duplication.
- Define patterns for test data, environments, identity, and dependency management to make cross-service tests repeatable and diagnosable.
- Integrate **smoke, regression, and end-to-end tests** into CI/CD pipelines.
- Provide useful test reporting and clear ownership of failures.
- Coordinate cross-team test preparation for changes affecting multiple services, consumers, or production environments.
- Use telemetry, logs, traces, and test evidence to diagnose failures.
- Distinguish product defects from environment or data issues.
- Assess release risk and communicate residual risk clearly.
- Help teams make evidence-based release decisions.
- Coach engineers and QA colleagues on testability, system-level thinking, and effective test automation.
- Enable teams to own quality rather than acting solely as a final testing gate.

## Required Qualifications

- Professional experience in **integration, system, or end-to-end testing of distributed software systems**.
- Strong **test automation** skills, including the ability to create maintainable frameworks, libraries, and workflows.
- Programming or scripting experience in at least one language commonly used for test automation, such as:
- C#
- Python
- TypeScript
- PowerShell
- Experience testing **REST APIs, asynchronous integrations, data flows, and service-to-service authentication**.
- Practical **CI/CD** experience, including automated test execution, result publishing, and failure investigation.
- Working knowledge of **cloud environments, containers, networking, configuration, and observability**.
- Ability to reason across team and service boundaries, identify hidden dependencies, and prioritize the highest operational risks.
- Collaborative approach focused on enabling teams to own quality.
- Strong communication, documentation, and stakeholder-alignment skills.

## Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with **Microsoft Azure**.
- Experience with **Azure DevOps or GitHub-based delivery workflows**.
- Experience with tools such as:
- Playwright
- Reqnroll or SpecFlow
- Robot Framework
- Pytest
- Pester
- xUnit
- Comparable test automation tooling
- Experience with **SQL**, data-platform testing, multi-tenant systems, or historical time-series data.
- Experience with **IoT Edge, gateways, MQTT, remote device communication**, or mixed cloud and edge solutions.
- Experience with performance, resilience, security, or compatibility testing of distributed systems.
- Experience in building automation, horticulture, operational technology, or systems with physical-world dependencies.

## Skills & Competencies

- End-to-end testing
- Integration testing
- System testing
- QA automation
- Test automation frameworks
- Automated test development
- REST API testing
- Asynchronous integration testing
- Data-flow testing
- Service-to-service authentication
- CI/CD
- Smoke testing
- Regression testing
- Distributed systems
- Cloud environments
- Containers
- Networking
- Configuration management
- Observability
- Telemetry, logs, and traces
- Failure investigation and root-cause analysis
- Release risk assessment
- Test data and environment management
- Cross-service dependency analysis
- Stakeholder communication
- Technical documentation
- Cross-functional collaboration
- Coaching and quality enablement

## Education & Experience

**Education**

- No specific education requirement is stated in the source job description.

- Professional experience in integration, system, or end-to-end testing of distributed software systems.
- Strong experience developing maintainable test automation frameworks, libraries, and workflows.

SOFTWARE DEVELOPER C++ & C# | MUNICH

24-Month Secure ANÜ Engagement — Up to €100,000 p.a. — 60% Home Office — 2 Positions

THE ROLE

Most C# work in Germany is line-of-business applications — CRUD screens, internal tooling, someone else's database. This is device and system software: the code that runs on the instruments themselves, in a company whose products are used to test and secure the communications infrastructure other companies depend on.

You would implement device and system software in C++ and C#, take requirements through analysis and conceptualisation yourself rather than receiving finished tickets, and integrate what you build into existing systems that are already in the field. Two positions are open, so this is a team being grown rather than a gap being filled.

YOU WILL
Implement device and system software in C++ and C# — the software that runs on the products, not the software that reports on them
Take requirements from analysis through to conceptualisation for software components, working out what needs building rather than being handed a specification
Integrate new software components into existing software systems already deployed with customers
Write automated component and system tests as part of delivery, so correctness is proven rather than assumed
Work inside an established agile team with Jira, alongside engineers who know the hardware as well as the code

ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS
Completed degree in computer science or a comparable field — this one is checked, not assumed
Excellent object-oriented development in C#, and ideally C++ alongside it. C# leads here; strong C# with credible C++ is in scope
Solid working knowledge of design patterns, applied on real systems rather than recognised from a book
PostgreSQL — you have designed against it and queried it, not just connected to it
Experience delivering inside an agile software team, ideally with Jira
Good German — this is a German engineering environment and the working language reflects that
Citizenship of an EU member state or an allied nation. This position is subject to export control regulations, so it is a hard requirement rather than a preference

ADVANTAGEOUS
Knowledge of mobile communication protocols — genuinely useful here rather than a nice line on a CV
Background in test and measurement, secure communications, broadcast or another instrumentation-led environment
Experience where the software ships on a device and cannot be patched weekly, so quality is designed in
Automated test frameworks at component and system level

WHY THIS ONE
Two positions on the same requisition, which is unusual — it means budget is signed off for a pair and there is no single-seat bottleneck holding it up.
60% home office on embedded-adjacent work is rare. Device and system software normally means the lab, five days a week. Here it is two days on site in Munich and the rest wherever you work best.

And the C# is real. Most engineers who want to work on instruments are told their C# is the wrong half of their CV. On this one it is the half that leads.

THE DETAILS
Location: Munich — 2 days per week on site, 60% home office
Contract: 24-Month Secure ANÜ Engagement
Hours: 35 hours per week
Salary: Up to €100,000 p.a.
Start: ASAP

jobs.title: AI Platform Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.location: Landau in der Pfalz, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
jobs.description:
Role Overview

So arbeiten wir – bitte aufmerksam lesen

Diese Stelle passt nicht zu jedem, und das ist Absicht. Damit du einschätzen kannst, ob sie zu dir passt:

Du baust die Schienen, nicht nur die Züge. Während die anderen KI-Rollen an konkreten Use-Cases arbeiten, verantwortest du das Querschnittliche: Infrastruktur, Frameworks, wiederverwendbare Bausteine, Guardrails. Deine Arbeit zahlt sich darin aus, dass andere schneller und sicherer liefern können.
Effizienz ist dein ständiger Maßstab. KI-Consumption – Token, Compute, API-Kosten – wächst schnell und unbemerkt. Du behältst sie im Blick, triffst fundierte Make-or-Buy-Entscheidungen (lokal vs. Cloud, selbst bauen vs. einkaufen) und kannst sie begründen.
Du wirst öfter "nein" sagen als "ja". Nicht jede schöne Idee braucht eigene Infrastruktur, und nicht jedes Modell muss selbst gehostet werden. Du erkennst, wann der pragmatische Weg der bessere ist – und vertrittst das auch gegenüber begeisterten Kolleginnen und Kollegen.
Jedes Teammitglied handelt sehr autonom. Du setzt dir deinen eigenen Maßstab und prüfst deine eigenen Ergebnisse kritisch, bevor jemand anderes es tut. Austausch und Feedback gibt es selbstverständlich – aber die Qualitätssicherung deiner Arbeit beginnt bei dir.
Du bist der Spezialist für dein Gebiet. Unser Team ist bewusst interdisziplinär aufgestellt, mit kaum Überlappungen zwischen den Disziplinen. Du hast Spezialisten für Frontend, Backend, UX und KI-Anwendungen an deiner Seite – aber Plattform, Betrieb und Effizienz sind dein Feld, und du verantwortest es fachlich selbst.
Wir entwickeln AI-gestützt – konsequent. Tools wie Claude Code oder Cursor sind bei uns Alltag, nicht Experiment. Das verschiebt den Schwerpunkt der Arbeit: weniger Code selbst tippen, mehr Architektur vorgeben und Ergebnisse kritisch prüfen. Du musst nicht jede Zeile selbst geschrieben haben – aber du stehst für jede Zeile gerade, die du ablieferst.
Wöchentliche Freiräume sind fest eingeplant – rund 10 % deiner Arbeitszeit. Zeit für fachliche Weiterentwicklung, eigene Ideen und kreativen Austausch ist bei uns Teil der Arbeitswoche – kein Nice-to-have, das im Tagesgeschäft verdampft.
Ergebnisgetrieben und prozessual schlank. Wir brauchen schnelle, pragmatische Lösungen, die im Alltag funktionieren – keine über Monate ausgefeilten 100%-Systeme. Die Plattform wächst mit den realen Bedürfnissen, nicht mit theoretischen.

Wenn du am produktivsten bist, wenn dir jemand eine fertige Architektur und ein abgestecktes Backlog vorlegt, wirst du bei uns nicht glücklich. Wenn dich reizt, ein Fundament aus dem Nichts zu bauen, auf dem andere aufbauen – dann lies weiter.

Unser Stack

Wir implementieren produktnah überwiegend in C# / .NET. Python nutzen wir, wo es sinnvoll ist – für Prototypen, KI-spezifische Werkzeuge, Datenarbeit und Tooling. Der Schwerpunkt liegt aber klar auf C#. Unsere Frontends bauen wir in React – für diese Rolle kein Muss, aber nützlich. Für KI-Betrieb und -Infrastruktur erwarten wir Vertrautheit mit gängigen Inferenz- und Orchestrierungs-Frameworks sowie mit Containerisierung.

Your Tasks

Die technische Plattform für unsere KI-Anwendungen konzipieren, aufbauen und betreiben: Modell-Hosting, Inferenz, API-Gateways/Routing, wiederverwendbare Bausteine
Lokale / self-hosted LLMs evaluieren, einrichten und betreiben – inklusive Quantisierung, GPU-Dimensionierung und Performance
KI-Consumption und -Kosten transparent machen und aktiv steuern; fundierte Make-or-Buy- und Lokal-vs.-Cloud-Entscheidungen treffen und begründen
Frameworks, Tools und Standards für das Team auswählen und etablieren – Guardrails, die KI-Entwicklung schneller und sicherer machen
Erfolgreiche Prototypen der anderen KI-Rollen in einen tragfähigen, betreibbaren Zustand bringen – bis hin zur Übergabe an R&D oder in den produktiven Betrieb
CI/CD, Monitoring und Betriebsthemen für KI-Lösungen verantworten
Ergebnisse und Empfehlungen gegenüber Fach- und Business-Teams präsentieren – auf dem jeweiligen technischen Niveau deines Gegenübers

Your Profile

Tiefes Veständnis und praktische Erfahrung im Betrieb von KI-/LLM-Anwendungen in einem Unternehmen: Inferenz-Frameworks (z. B. vLLM, Ollama, llama.cpp, TGI), API-Gateways/Routing (z. B. LiteLLM), RAG- und Embedding-Infrastruktur
Operative, im Unternehmenskontext angewandte Erfahrung mit lokalen Modellen / Self-Hosting von LLMs – inklusive Quantisierung und Ressourcendimensionierung
Mehrjährige, fundierte praktische Erfahrung innerhalb eines Unternehmens in der Entwicklung von Softwarelösungen, davon ein solider Teil in C# / .NET – mit erkennbarer technischer Tiefe
Erfahrung mit Containerisierung (Docker), CI/CD und Betriebsthemen
Ein waches Auge für Kosten und Effizienz – du kannst KI-Consumption messen, einordnen und optimieren
Gute Übersicht über aktuelle Trends, verfügbare Off-the-shelf-Lösungen und neue Entwicklungen im KI-Umfeld – du weißt, wann man baut und wann man kauft
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (Teamsprache ist Deutsch) und gute Englischkenntnisse
Überwiegende Arbeit im Homeoffice, Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen Reisen in unser HQ in Landau (ca. 5–10 % der Arbeitszeit)

Must have

Praktische Erfahrung innerhalb eines Unternehmens mit lokalen Modellen / Self-Hosting von LLMs – inklusive Quantisierung und Ressourcendimensionierung
Praktische Erfahrung innerhalb eines Unternehmens im Betrieb von KI-/LLM-Anwendungen: Inferenz-Frameworks (z. B. vLLM, Ollama, llama.cpp, TGI), API-Gateways/Routing (z. B. LiteLLM), RAG- und Embedding-Infrastruktur
Erfahrung mit Containerisierung (Docker), CI/CD und Betriebsthemen
Du kannst "nein" sagen, ohne Türen zu schließen und ein Scheitern eingestehen, auch wenn du schon Aufwand investiert hast

Nice to have

Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung oder Anleitung von Entwicklern
Gute Python-Kenntnisse für Tooling und Prototyping
Erfahrung mit Datenaufbereitung und -pipelines (ETL/ELT)
React / moderne Web-Frontends
Erfahrung mit GPU-Infrastruktur und Kostenoptimierung im Cloud-Umfeld

That sounds like you?

Du denkst in Systemen und Fundamenten, nicht nur in einzelnen Lösungen – und baust so, dass andere darauf aufbauen können.
Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Verhältnismäßigkeit – du baust die Infrastruktur, die das Problem braucht, nicht die größtmögliche. Und du erkennst, wann der pragmatische Weg der richtige ist.
Du kannst "nein" sagen, ohne Türen zu schließen – und ein Scheitern eingestehen, auch wenn du schon Aufwand investiert hast.
Du prüfst deine eigenen Ergebnisse kritisch, bevor jemand anderes es tut.
Ein offenes Auge für Defizite und Potenziale, technisch wie organisatorisch

Reasons to become part of AMDT

Transformative Möglichkeiten und integrative Kultur: Werde Teil eines dynamischen, sich weiterentwickelnden Unternehmens, in dem Wachstum gefördert wird, deine Beiträge geschätzt werden und du in einer vielfältigen, unterstützenden Gemeinschaft zusammenarbeiten und dich entfalten kannst.
Flexible Arbeitsmöglichkeiten: Arbeite so, wie es für dich am besten ist – remote, hybrid oder in unserem hochmodernen Büro.
Zukunftssicherheit: Wir investieren in deine Zukunft und leisten einen Beitrag von 20 % zu einem umfassenden betrieblichen Alterversversongung.
Zusätzliche Krankenversicherung: Genieße zusätzliche Sicherheit mit einer Krankenzusatzversicherung, die dein Wohlbefinden über das Grundlegende hinaus unterstützt.
Unternehmensvorteile: Profitiere von exklusiven Rabatten auf ausgewählte Marken, um deinen Alltag zu bereichern.
Kontinuierliches Lernen: Nutze Preply für einfaches Sprachenlernen und unterstütze so deine persönliche und berufliche Entwicklung.
Meilensteine feiern: Freue dich über Geschenke zu wichtigen Lebensereignissen wie Heirat, Geburt eines Kindes oder deinem Jubiläum bei uns.

Contact us

Wenn Du Fragen zu der Stelle haben solltest, wende Dich bitte an unser Recruiting-Team (Chiara & Dirk) unter hiring@amdt.com mit Verweis auf den Titel der Stelle

About Us

AMDT is the global market and technology leader for versioning and backup solutions in industrial automation. With its octoplant software platform, the company secures the automation of production processes through strong end-point management, where it consistently records and monitors changes to configurations, programming and project statuses in production. This minimizes downtime, increases efficiency, quality and safety standards, and saves costs as well as resources. As a modular solution, octoplant can be linked to different automation technologies and devices, regardless of the manufacturer.

AMDT was formed in 2022 from the merger of the two established market leaders AUVESY GmbH and MDT Software Inc. The company is headquartered in Landau, Pfalz, Germany, with additional locations in the USA and China. The company works with more than 100 partners on all continents and serves over 3,000 customers worldwide

More information at: amdt.com
