jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer | Language Products | Full-Stack
jobs.description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.

Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What Sets Us Apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication
. We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 100 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally.

You will join the Language Products Track
. This is the heart of DeepL. You will be building and expanding our flagship translation products, the core engines that power everything from our consumer web translator to our Enterprise Customization Hub (Glossaries, Translation Memory, and Style Rules) and complex multimedia localization flows.

We are shifting gears from "Software-First" to "Product-First." We don't hire engineers just to implement UI tickets or optimize algorithms in isolation. We hire product-obsessed
people who care deeply about the user experience and the business impact of their code . You will build the interfaces and backend systems that allow a global enterprise to maintain their brand voice across 100+ languages effortlessly, while keeping the experience simple enough for a casual user.

Your Responsibilities

Own the Core Experience End-to-End: You will architect and build complex, user-facing features across our primary translation products . Whether you are building the UI for the translation flow, engineering the backend logic to parse and translate complex document formats (PDF, Word, PowerPoint) without losing formatting, or integrating DeepL directly into enterprise workflows, you own the outcome.
Build for "Consumer-Grade" Enterprise: You will solve a unique product challenge: building an interface that feels instant and magical for a B2C user, but is powerful enough to handle the complex, multi-party collaboration and localization workflows required by enterprise teams.
Architect for Ambiguity: You will make high-stakes technical decisions regarding state management, API integrations, and performance. You don't wait for perfect requirements; you prototype, measure user friction, and iterate fast .
Bridge the Gap: You are bilingual in "Engineering" and "Business." You will collaborate closely with Research, Product, and Design teams to translate complex AI constraints into an intuitive UX . You will help win market trust by building transparency and performance metrics directly into the product.

Qualities we look for

A "Product-First" Mindset: You care deeply about who uses your software. You ask "Why are we building this?" before writing a line of code. You measure success by user adoption and reduced friction, not just pull requests merged.
Front-end Heavy Full-Stack Fluency: You are a strong Front End engineer who is comfortable traversing the stack to deliver a feature. You can build a highly interactive, performant UI in React and design the supporting backend logic in Python and C#/.NET Core, with the support of agentic tooling.
High Agency & Bias for Action: You don't wait for permission. If you see a performance bottleneck in the translation flow, you profile it. If the documentation for a new API is missing, you write it . You are comfortable unblocking yourself and your team.
A "System Thinker" for UI/UX: You understand that a simple UI often hides massive backend complexity. You can design systems that handle large document states, manage complex terminology rules (Glossaries), and maintain high performance in the browser.

What We Offer

Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.
Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.
Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.
Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.
Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.
Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.
30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.
Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

jobs.description:
What’s the role?

Gen II is building out its Data & Integration Platform — the central integration backbone connecting 40+ systems across our fund administration technology estate. At the heart of DIP is an AI-assisted integration factory: a structured, repeatable delivery engine for building, testing, and deploying integration adapters at pace.

We are looking for a Senior Integration Engineer to join the DIP team and take direct ownership of integration delivery — combining deep Azure integration expertise with an embedded AI-assisted development practice. This is not a role for someone who is learning how to use AI tooling; we want someone who already works this way and can help us push the factory model further.

You will be expected to come in, get up to speed quickly, and drive forward integration workstreams with minimal oversight. We need a self-starter who can take a requirement, own it end-to-end, and deliver at pace and quality. You will report to and work closely with the Associate Director of Data Engineering.

What You’ll Be Doing

Integration Factory & AI-Assisted Delivery

Building and extending reusable system wrappers (Python) for applications and systems across the Gen II technology estate
Using AI tooling (LLMs, codegen, Claude) across all integration development — scaffolding Function Apps, generating Logic Apps workflows, producing APIM policies, building test cases, generating IaC, and automating documentation; AI assistance is the default mode of working, not a selective shortcut
Contributing to the factory’s pattern library — standardising error handling, retry logic, logging, and payload structures across all integration components
Driving CI/CD pipeline integration for adapter delivery — automated test execution, linting, and deployment gates

Azure Integration Engineering

Designing and building integration adapters using Azure Function Apps (Python) — the primary execution pattern across DIP
Developing Logic Apps Standard workflows, including WDL authoring, scope actions, error handling, and retry patterns — with AI-assisted workflow generation embedded in the build process
Configuring Azure API Management — inbound/outbound policies, managed identity auth, versioning, and throttling — leveraging AI to draft, validate, and document policies
Working with Azure Service Bus for event-driven and async messaging patterns
Contributing to IaC outputs (Bicep) for per-adapter infrastructure — using AI to scaffold and maintain templates

Delivery & Collaboration

Taking integration workstreams from requirement to production with minimal hand-holding
Writing clean, well-tested Python with pytest-based test suites aligned to DIP QA standards
Working closely with the Associate Director of Data Engineering, DIP Architect, BAs, and QA — raising blockers early and documenting decisions clearly
Collaborating with data engineers to ensure ingress and egress integration outputs land cleanly in / out of Snowflake

The ideal background for this role:

5+ years of hands-on integration engineering experience — evidenced in role history, not just a skills list
Deep practical experience with Azure Function Apps, Logic Apps Standard, Service Bus, and API Management — you have written the workflows and configured the policies yourself
Strong Python development — clean, production-quality code with proper error handling, logging, and test coverage
Demonstrable experience building or contributing to an integration factory — reusable adapter patterns, scaffolding, CI/CD automation
Active use of AI-assisted development in integration delivery — pattern generation, code scaffolding, IaC templating, documentation automation; this should be embedded in how you work, not aspirational
Ability to own workstreams independently and drive delivery without close management
Experience writing system wrapper libraries — encapsulating authentication, API interaction, and error handling for third-party platforms (desirable)
Snowflake experience — querying, schema patterns, and structuring integration payloads for downstream consumption (desirable)
Exposure to fund administration or broader financial services environments (desirable)
Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate across technical and business teams

Role Location/Hybrid Schedule

This role is based in our Southampton office. Although the nature of most of the roles within Gen II cannot be classed as totally flexible, there is scope in some cases for a form of Agile Working. The different ways in which Agile Working can be undertaken is dependent on the demands and needs of the business, the office space available and the individual’s preferences and circumstances.

We find, support and collaborate with our Fellows to help scale their solutions across nations and continents and work with a wide range of partners to create an "Everyone a Changemaker" world, one in which we all can find and develop our power to create meaningful change for the good of all.

For more information, please visit www.ashoka.org

Job Description

Ashoka is looking for senior-level professionals in Web Design and Development who can provide our Fellows with professional consults and project based support. We are creating an elite team of 10-15 members from different world regions (to reflect cultural contexts and language) in this field and in nine others of similarly high-value skillsets. We are calling these members Ashoka Professional Support Partners (PSPs) rather than "volunteers" to reflect the expertise and commitment to impact they will bring to our global community.

As an Ashoka Support Partner your expertise will be promoted to Fellows over the course of two to three months. If there is a need that meets your interests and availability, an introduction will be made so that you can learn more details about the support partnership and ways that you can contribute. Until that time your name and contact details will be held confidentially to protect your privacy.

As a Member Of The Web Design And Development Team You Will Be Working At The Intersection Of Digital Craft, Social-enterprise Literacy, And Capacity-building. Our Ashoka Fellows Are Leading Social Entrepreneurs Running Organizations That Often Need Stronger Digital Foundations To Scale Their Impact. A Senior Web Professional On This Team Would Help To

Build or rebuild Fellow and Fellow-led organizations' websites — from strategy and information architecture through design, development, and launch — so Fellows can credibly tell their story, recruit supporters, and raise funds online.
Design brand-aligned digital experiences — visual identity, UI/UX, landing pages, donation/fundraising flows, and campaign microsites that reflect each Fellow's mission and audience.
Modernize and maintain existing sites — auditing, migrating, and upgrading legacy platforms applying rigor to Fellows' sites.
Integrate essential nonprofit tooling — connecting sites to CRM/donor systems, email platforms, payment/donation processors, analytics, and multilingual/localization support for Fellows working across regions.
Coach and build Fellow capacity — transferring skills to Fellows and their teams so they can update content, run campaigns, and sustain their digital presence independently rather than depending on outside help indefinitely.

Please let us know today if you'd like to join this small but mighty team!

Volunteer Logistics

Estimated hours required per week: 5-10

The estimated duration of the project is: 1-3 months

This position is Virtual (Remote)

Language Requirements

English

Desired Skills And Experience

8+ years of progressively responsible web design and development experience, including at least 2-3 years in a senior or lead role (leading builds, mentoring, or owning architecture decisions).
A demonstrated portfolio of live websites spanning design through deployment, ideally including nonprofit, multilingual, or multi-site/multi-region projects.
Proven experience working remotely in distributed, cross-cultural teams.
Strong command of user-centered design, information architecture, and visual/brand design principles.
Proficiency in design tools (Figma, Adobe Creative Suite) and prototyping.
Understanding of accessibility, responsive/mobile-first design, and performance. Development skills Front-end: HTML5, CSS3, modern JavaScript, and a framework such as React.
Back-end and CMS fluency — especially Drupal and/or WordPress, with experience in theming, custom modules, and migrations.
Experience integrating third-party systems (Salesforce/CRM, donation platforms, email tools) and working with APIs.
Familiarity with cloud hosting and DevOps basics and basic SEO/analytics setup.
Literacy in social entrepreneurship and systems-change work, so digital solutions serve mission and scale rather than just looking polished.
Experience with budget-conscious, resource-light environments typical of early-stage Fellow organizations.
Intercultural fluency to work across countries and multilingual contexts, with strong English (additional languages a plus).
A coaching, capacity-strengthening mindset — willingness to teach and document, not just deliver.

jobs.description:
AI Engineer / Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)

Build technology that solves real business problems
We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer / Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
to work at the intersection of technology, data, AI and the business.

This is not a traditional software engineering role. You will work directly with our investment, operations and distribution teams, spending time with the people who use our technology to understand their workflows, identify meaningful problems and build solutions that make a measurable difference.

You will have the autonomy to take ideas from problem definition through to production, often moving from prototype to a working solution in days or weeks rather than months.

The role
As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will:
Work directly with business teams to understand their workflows, challenges and opportunities.
Identify high-impact problems where software, automation, data or AI can improve how we operate.
Rapidly prototype solutions, test them with users and iterate based on real-world feedback.
Take successful prototypes through to production, building secure, reliable and maintainable services.
Work across the full technology stack, including backend services, APIs, data pipelines and user-facing applications.
Integrate data and systems across APIs, databases, files and message queues, turning complex and fragmented data into useful products and services.
Apply modern AI and LLM capabilities to accelerate delivery and create new ways of working.
Partner closely with engineering, data and platform teams to align with architecture, security and technology standards.
Maintain a strong focus on security, governance, data protection and operational resilience, particularly where solutions interact with client assets and regulated activity.

About you
You are a hands-on engineer and pragmatic problem solver who enjoys being close to the people you build for.
You are comfortable operating in environments where the problem is not always clearly defined. You can ask the right questions, challenge assumptions, make sensible trade-offs and move quickly from an idea to something users can actually work with.
You are equally comfortable discussing architecture with engineers, mapping a business process with a subject matter expert, or explaining a technical trade-off to a senior stakeholder.
Most importantly, you care about building the right thing, not simply building things right.

Experience needed for the role:
4+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of delivering and supporting production systems.
Experience taking projects end to end, from problem definition and design through development, deployment and ongoing improvement.
Experience working directly with users, clients or business stakeholders is highly desirable.
Strong experience integrating APIs, databases, files and messaging systems, and working with complex or imperfect real-world data.
Experience in financial services, investment management, asset management or another regulated, data-intensive environment is highly desirable.
Experience using modern AI/LLM technologies, or a demonstrated ability and enthusiasm to adopt them quickly.

Technical skills
We are looking for strong engineering fundamentals rather than a specific technology background. Experience with one or more of the following is valuable:
Programming: Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, C# or Go.
Full stack development: backend services, APIs and modern web applications.
Data: SQL, PostgreSQL, Azure SQL, data modelling, cloud storage and graph technologies, including GraphRAG.
Cloud and infrastructure: Azure, containers, CI/CD and infrastructure as code.
Security: authentication, authorisation, data isolation, input validation and secure handling of sensitive information.
AI: LLMs, AI-assisted development, intelligent automation and emerging AI application patterns.

If you are an engineer who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, working directly with users and turning ideas into production technology, we would like to hear from you.

As strategies, technologies, and innovation collide, we create opportunity from complexity.

Our teams of interdisciplinary experts combine innovative thinking and breakthrough technologies to progress further, faster. Our clients adapt and transform, and together we achieve enduring results.

Our teams operate globally from offices across the UK, Ireland, US, Nordics, and Netherlands.

PA. Bringing Ingenuity to Life.

Job Description

We believe in the power of ingenuity to build a positive human future. We challenge where it matters and own the outcome. We combine strategic thinking, customer-centric service design, and agile engineering practices to accelerate innovation in a tech-driven world.

Why consider joining our Digital & Data community? 🤔

Join our Digital & Data team working alongside product, design and a wide range of other experts and cross-disciplinary teams to bring ideas to life through innovative software solutions.
Grow a flexible and unique career within a trust-based, inclusive environment that values excellence, innovation, and curiosity. You have the option to progress with us on a technical career track. No need to go onto the Partner career track if this doesn’t align with what you want to do.
Hybrid working - our approach is to be in the office or on client site minimum of 2 days per week.
Work on a broad variety of projects and tech stacks for clients across seven sectors - no project is ever the same
Join other experts within our supportive and collaborative tech community through knowledge-sharing and peer-level support, coaching and mentoring
Deepen your expertise through our a culture of learning and growth – you’ll have budget to take courses (technical and non-technical training), plus gain certifications

Our tech stack 🚀

While we advocate for using the right tech for the right task, you can expect to work with the following technologies to ensure scalable, high-performance applications:

Cloud platforms: AWS, Azure, GCP
Architecture frameworks: TOGAF, Zachmann, MODAF
Agile methodologies: SAFe, Scrum, Kanban
Modeling tools: UML, ArchiMate, Ardoq

What You Can Expect 🌱

Create and assure key architecture artefacts (e.g., Key Design Decision, Technical Options Paper, High Level Design)
Collaborate closely with Engineering teams, often taking a lead SME role to define vision and establish Architectural Guardrails.
Support senior leaders in shaping their case for change, leading on cost estimation and detailed planning.
Work to agile best practices and cross-functionally with multiple teams and stakeholders. You’ll be using your technical skills to problem solve with our clients, as well as working on internal projects
Hybrid working with the team on client site or in our office a minimum of two days per week. However, the actual time you spend and where you spend it will vary by role or assignment, including up to 5 days per week on a client site.
An environment that deeply cares about its values

Qualifications

Essential requirements
✅

Even if you don’t meet every requirement below, feel free to still apply as we are often hiring for similar roles which your background might be better suited to.

Hands-on Software Engineering background with experience leading engineering teams to deliver applications and services.
Clear understanding and practical application of architecture and delivery methodologies.
Operate confidently across all architectural domains with a specialism in at least one: Business, Data, Application, Technology, and Security.
Commitment to continuous improvement and professional development.
You thrive in problem-solving and analytical thinking
You enjoy collaborating with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced environment
Certifications in appropriate methodologies and cloud technologies are advantageous.

We’re technology agnostic, using the right tools for the job at hand, and you’ll have access to our strong partnerships with AWS, Azure and GCP. We’re interested to hear from Solution Architects with experience across the majority of leading vendors including Azure, AWS, Google Cloud Platform, Oracle, IBM, Salesforce and more.

Additional Information

Assessment process ⚖️

Quick video call with one of our Tech Recruiters – to discuss your application, the role and PA
Round 1: Either a competency or technical interview (60 mins)
Round 2: Either a competency or technical interview, whichever you didn’t do at first round (60 mins)
Final round 🎉: Meeting with a PA leader - a discussion around your client-centricity (45 mins)

Life At PA encompasses our peoples' experience at PA. It's about how we enrich peoples’ working lives by giving them access to unique people and growth opportunities and purpose led meaningful work.

Our purpose guides how we work with our clients and our teams, and support our communities, to deliver insight and impact, solving the world’s most complex challenges. We're focused on building a workplace that values human difference and diverse mindsets, and a culture of inclusion and equality that unlocks the potential in our people so everyone can be their best self.

Find out more about Life at PA here.

We are dedicated to supporting the physical, emotional, social and financial well-being of our people. Check out some of our extensive benefits:

Health and lifestyle perks accompanying private healthcare for you and your family
25 days annual leave (plus a bonus half day on Christmas Eve) with the opportunity to buy 5 additional days
Generous company pension scheme
Opportunity to get involved with community and charity-based initiatives
Annual performance-based bonus
PA share ownership
Tax efficient benefits (cycle to work, give as you earn)

jobs.description:
About Us

At Netwrix, our mission is to revolutionize data security by placing identity at the core - providing unparalleled visibility and control. Engineered and supported by over 900 highly talented, motivated employees and hundreds of trusted partners in nearly every geography, Netwrix solutions are relied upon daily by security professionals across more than 13,500 organizations in over 100 countries around the world.

Over the past two decades, Netwrix has expanded its market presence through innovation, organic growth, and strategic acquisitions, and are proud to be backed by renowned private equity firms, TA Associates and Centerbridge Partners. Netwrix maintains a global presence, fostering a remote-first work environment while encouraging and facilitating frequent face-to-face interaction with colleagues, customers, and partners.

Position Overview 

We are building a cutting-edge Platform that will transform the way our customers identify, protect and govern their data. This will revolutionize how customers secure their data by placing identity at the core — providing unparalleled visibility and control.

We are seeking a Senior Backend Engineer to design, build, and operate the services powering our enterprise SaaS security platform. You will work across a microservices architecture spanning ASP.NET Core APIs, Azure Functions, SQL Server, and Azure CosmosDB — shipping capabilities that serve Fortune 500 customers in hybrid cloud and on-prem environments at high scale.

This is a hands-on engineering role where strong technical execution, distributed-systems fluency, and a security-first mindset are essential. You will independently own features and services end-to-end, collaborating closely with product, architecture, and fellow engineers to deliver scalable, multi-tenant solutions that meet enterprise and regulatory standards.

This is a hybrid role with visits to our Kraków office.

Key Responsibilities 

Backend Service Development

Design and implement backend features end-to-end: from ASP.NET Core REST APIs and Azure Functions through to SQL Server and CosmosDB data layers.
Develop and extend .NET services within a microservices architecture composed of independently scalable, per-service function hosts.
Write and maintain Azure Functions for asynchronous processing workloads.
Build resilient, idempotent message-driven workflows using Azure Service Bus.

Data & Cloud Engineering

Work with SQL Server and Azure CosmosDB to implement performant, secure data access patterns at scale.
Own data access patterns that respect multi-tenant isolation boundaries and comply with security and privacy requirements, including RLS policy management.
Leverage Azure platform services including Service Bus, Blob Storage, Azure App Configuration, Application Insights, and Entra ID integration.

Quality & DevOps

Write comprehensive backend tests: xUnit, Moq, and FluentAssertions for unit and integration coverage.
Participate in CI/CD pipeline maintenance using GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps.
Contribute to infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and containerized local development (Docker Compose, Azurite).
Proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, security vulnerabilities, and technical debt across services.

Collaboration & Growth

Independently break down and deliver complex backend work, owning full project lifecycles from design through production.
Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, and technical design decisions; enforce best practices across the codebase.
Partner with product managers and frontend/full-stack engineers to define clean, well-documented API contracts.
Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through pairing, code review, and knowledge sharing.
Champion the use of AI-driven approaches within the development process to enhance quality, speed, and innovation.

Qualifications  

6-8 years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong backend/distributed-systems focus.
Strong proficiency in **C# / .NET 8/10** (ASP.NET Core APIs, Azure Functions, isolated worker model).
Hands-on experience with **SQL Server** (T-SQL, Entity Framework Core, relational modelling, Row-Level Security) and at least one NoSQL database (CosmosDB preferred).
Experience building and operating **Azure-hosted** services (Functions, Service Bus, Blob Storage, App Configuration, Application Insights).
Solid understanding of **authentication and authorization** patterns (OAuth 2.0, JWT, Auth0 or similar identity providers).
Experience with **multi-tenant SaaS** architectures and the data isolation patterns they require.
Comfortable designing and debugging **asynchronous, message-driven systems** (queues, event-driven processing, idempotency, retries).
Familiarity with **CI/CD pipelines** (GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform).
Familiarity with **Docker and Kubernetes**.
Strong testing discipline (unit, integration) using xUnit/Moq/FluentAssertions or equivalent.
Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team.

Preferred Qualifications 

Exposure to enterprise security domains (identity security, data security posture management, compliance).
Experience with **Azure CosmosDB** (SQL API and/or Gremlin graph API), including partitioning and throughput tuning.
Experience designing service boundaries in a **microservices architecture** with independent scaling and deployment.
Experience building compliance-ready products (e.g., SOC 2, FedRAMP, HIPAA, ISO 27001).

Our Values

At Netwrix, Our Values Guide Every Action

Next-Level Customer Focus -Customers first, always. We listen, protect, and go the extra mile— because their success is our mission.
Excellence - We set high standards and take pride in delivering exceptional results. We celebrate wins, seek constant improvement, and address shortcomings professionally.
Transparent Ownership - We celebrate our successes, own up to our mistakes, communicate openly, and face challenges head-on with a genuine commitment to doing the right thing.
Winning with Clear Thinking - We value clarity, find straightforward solutions to complex problems, and make swift, effective decisions.
Relentless Innovation - We continually seek better ways to serve our customers and stay ahead. We foster creative thinking, and we embrace new approaches.
Industry-Leading Expertise - We take pride in our expertise and continuously seek to learn and share knowledge, striving to be the trusted experts our customers rely on.
eXceptional Together - We believe in the power of collaboration and diverse perspectives. By valuing each other’s strengths, we achieve outcomes that surpass individual contributions.

Join us in a culture where integrity, respect, and hard work are foundational. Be part of a team dedicated to making a lasting impact.

Why You’ll Love Working at Netwrix

Competitive Health Benefits
Continuous Learning and Development Opportunities
Team-Oriented, Collaborative, and Innovative Work Environment
Regular Company Town Halls to Keep You Informed
Opportunities for Career Growth and Advancement

We pride ourselves on a culture that truly values employee input across various backgrounds and experiences. We look forward to welcoming new talent who can help us further our mission.

Netwrix Corporation and its wholly owned subsidiaries are Equal Opportunity Employers (EEO) and welcome all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

Join our dynamic team as a Software Developer in the GCO EN D&S PMO, where you will play a pivotal role in enhancing our COMOS engineering platform. Your ability to manage complex projects and translate engineering requirements into robust software solutions will be key to your success. Get ready to immerse yourself in a collaborative environment where your contributions will drive innovation and excellence!

How You’ll Make An Impact

Design and develop tailored software solutions on the COMOS Aries engineering platform to fulfill specific R&D and customer project needs.
Create and maintain detailed technical documentation for solution designs, data models, and system integrations.
Lead the evaluation and selection of technologies and methodologies to enhance the engineering tool ecosystem’s functionality and performance.
Implement and manage system configurations, customizations, and integrations based on approved architectural designs.
Perform advanced troubleshooting and debugging to resolve complex technical issues within the application and its interfaces.
Manage source code and deployment packages using version control and CI/CD pipelines.
Collaborate with project managers, engineers, and customers to define technical scope, deliverables, and timelines.

What You Bring

Proven experience with C#, .NET Framework, WPF, and GIT.
Demonstrated ability to manage large, complex software projects or processes with minimal oversight.
Experience in developing custom solutions within an existing framework of a third-party application.

Experience with web API integrations and asynchronous programming.
Excellent communication and presentation skills.
An open mindset that values new ideas, positive thinking, and problem-solving.
A structured approach to continuous improvement in work processes.
Interest in collaborating with individuals from diverse backgrounds and cultures.

A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

You will be part of the SE D GCO EN D&S PMO management team, which consists of three specialized teams: Project Management, Engineering Systems, and Technical Information Systems. jobs.title: Microsoft Azure Cloud Architect
jobs.description:
Är du en erfaren konsult som brinner för att skapa välfungerande och optimerade molnlösningar? Vill du vara med och skapa framtidens digitalisering med hjälp av Cloud? Hos oss på Accigo får du vara med och stärka cloudaffären samtidigt som du utvecklar ditt självledarskap genom frihet under ansvar.

Vem är du?

Vi vill jobba med dig som vill vara med och bygga branschens starkaste affär och team inom Azure cloud consulting. Du drivs av teknisk utveckling samtidigt som du är en stjärna på att kommunicera på ett enkelt språk med kunder och kollegor. Du är lyhörd för kundens nuvarande behov och vågar samtidigt utmana befintliga arbetssätt och lösningar.

Vi söker dig som har

Flerårig erfarenhet av design och implementation av lösningar i Azure, inklusive god kännedom om Microsoft well architected framework & Cloud adoption framework.
Du har jobbat med on premises- eller hybrida system.
Du är bevandrad inom agilt arbetssätt och har stor kunskap av DevOps.
Kompetens inom Infrastructure as code (IaC) & PowerShell/CLI
Du har viss erfarenhet av att designa nätverk och tillhörande komponenter, i Azure och OnPrem.
Du har erfarenhet inom kravinsamling och presale-arbete
Mycket god kommunikationsförmåga och förmågan att leda ditt projekt och dig själv.
Gedigen erfarenhet som konsult där du jobbat med medelstora och stora bolag.

Ett plus om du har

Du har erfarenhet att vårda kundrelationer och driva säljprocesser
Erfarenhet av andra publika molntjänster
Microsoft Certifikat: AZ-104, AZ-305 och AZ-400
IT-Arkitektcertifiering från Dataföreningen eller liknade instans.
Erfarenhet av Cisco och Ubiquitinätverkstekniker

Detta kommer du att göra

Vi arbetar med att möjliggöra våra kunders digitalseringsresor genom att vara djupt tekniska specialister på kundens teknikplattformar, med utgångspunkt i Microsofts ekosystem. Du kommer jobba med kunder som behöver hjälp att flytta upp sina On Premis miljöer till Azure. Du kommer att designa lösningarna utifrån kundens krav och Microsoft well architected framework. Samt hjälpa till att implementera lösningarna.

Vi lägger stor vikt på gemensamma teamleveranser och vi samarbetar ofta med andra team på Accigo. Därför är det viktigt att du trivs med att jobba tillsammans med andra och samtidigt tar ansvar för din egen leverans.

I din roll som Cloud-arkitekt kommer du att agera lösningsarkitekt i våra kunduppdrag, hjälpa till med införsäljning, genomföra externa och interna kompetensutvecklingsinitiativ, design och uppsättning av Azurelösningar, samt hands-on och problemlösning. Du förväntas driva uppdrag och ta stort eget ansvar i dina projekt. Du kommer med din kompetens och branscherfarenhet vara en mycket viktig länk mellan affärsverksamhet och IT-infrastrukturen i Azure.

Vårt team

Vi är ett nyfiket och samarbetsvilligt team, med ett gemensamt brinnande intresse för teknik och digitalisering. Vi ser oss som Sveriges vassaste (och gladaste) team inom våra fokusområden, och har en långsiktig strategi att växa och bli fler. Vi arbetar dagligen med varandra, både i kundleveranser och med erbjudandeutveckling och att driva våra fokusområden.

Förutom att arbeta tillsammans bjuder vi även in till frukostar där vi delar med oss av pinsamheter och udda fakta, kompetensspridning, veckovisa team-träffar och spontana fikastunder. Vi strävar efter att skapa en vardag fylld med spännande projekt och möjligheter hos kund, samt glädje, energi och gemenskap i teamet där dina idéer får ta plats.

Kompensation och förmåner

Vår förmånspolicy är utvecklad för att möta både dina professionella och personliga behov. I vårt omfattande förmånspaket ingår friskvårdsbidrag, tjänstepension och frivillig sjukvårdsförsäkring. Vår ersättningsmodell består av en konkurrenskraftig fast del och en rörlig del som ger dig möjlighet att påverka din lön baserat på din prestation och ambition. Vi erbjuder både professionell och personlig utveckling.

Har du några frågor eller är du bara nyfiken? Vi berättar gärna mer om oss över en kaffe: tyra.drakenberg@accigo.se

Accigo är ett konsultbolag som hjälper företag och organisationer med digital affärs- och verksamhetsutveckling med tekniken som möjliggörare. För oss handlar digitalisering till 90% om människor och 10% om teknik. Det är när samspelet mellan människa och teknik fungerar som digitaliseringens fulla styrka visar sig.

För många handlar digitalisering mest om teknik. För oss är det så otroligt mycket större. Digitalisering kan få både människor och organisationer att våga sikta högre, följa sina drömmar och öppna dörrar som de inte ens visste fanns. Och när man ser igenom tekniken och börjar skönja vilka möjligheter som gömmer sig där bakom. Då ser man att framtiden kan vara en fantastisk plats – fylld av mänsklig energi och värme – och digitalisering är inget annat än vår superkraft för att komma dit.

Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and Twitter (X).

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced software developer to help us develop desktop applications that enable our customers to evaluate and configure our products. This role is ideal for an individual who can communicate effectively with the team to identify solutions and then implement those solutions independently. The role includes everything from working with USB devices via an API or Hardware Abstraction Layer (HAL), architecting and implementing business logic as well as implementing the UI using the Model View ViewModel (MVVM) paradigm.

Key Responsibilities

Build new functionality that enables configuration of new hardware for customers and internal engineers
Contribute to the development of our modern cross-platform desktop evaluation environment, through 1.0 release and beyond
Partner with domain experts to develop hardware-specific plug-ins and support a collaborative plug-in ecosystem built on core framework capabilities
Identify problems with the team, design solutions, and implement them with quality and maintainability in mind
Work across architecture, business logic, and UI implementation to deliver reliable, polished user experiences

Required Qualifications

5+ years of professional experience developing products using C# (or equivalent object-oriented language with substantial C# proficiency)
Experience implementing MVVM using modern UI frameworks such as WPF, Avalonia, or MAUI (cross-platform experience is a bonus)
Strong knowledge of Git, including common merge strategies and practical debugging skills
Ability to communicate clearly, collaborate effectively, and deliver independently with a high level of ownership

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with some or all the following:

ReactiveExtensions and/or ReactiveUI
CI/CD using GitHub Actions
Development on Mac or Linux, including packaging/deployment to Mac or Linux environments
Working with hardware connectivity patterns (USB APIs, HALs) and related troubleshooting

As a member of our team, you will have a direct impact on the success of our customers and of the company. You will have a strong support structure of dedicated, motivated and talented software developers, but will also have ownership of significant elements of the software. Tech Consulting on digitaalisen suunnittelun ja ohjelmistokehityksen yksikkö, jossa autamme asiakkaitamme kasvamaan yhdistämällä liiketoimintamuotoilun, teknologisen osaamisen ja modernin ohjelmistokehityksen parhaat käytännöt.

Tässä roolissa yrittäjähenkisyys ja oma-aloitteisuus ovat avainasemassa. Vahva osaaminen Power Platformista (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, Power Pages, Copilot Studio)

Hyvät viestintätaidot ja kyky selittää teknisiä ratkaisuja ei-teknisille sidosryhmille

Tiedolla rakennamme teknologiaa, joka toimii ihmisten hyväksi. Tech Consultingissa työskentelet teknologian, innovaation ja yhteiskunnallisen vaikuttavuuden rajapinnassa.

Merkityksellistä työtä yhteiskunnallisesti kriittisten digitaalisten ratkaisujen parissa
Pohjoismaisen, vastuullisen ja luottamukseen perustuvan työyhteisön

Joustavat työskentelytavat, hyvinvointia tukevat edut sekä inhimillisen työkulttuurin

Je zult deel uitmaken van 1 van onze engineering teams, en verantwoordelijk zijn voor het ontwerpen en helpen implementeren van 1 of meerdere functionele domeinen binnen onze producten. Als Application Architect zorg je ook voor de groei en goede werking van het team, je volgt de developers op, helpt met coachen en persoonlijke ontwikkeling, en helpt het team efficiënt werken. Daarnaast maak je deel uit van het Architectuur Team, dat over de teams heen zorgt voor een consistente aanpak en waar de overkoepelende architectuur beslissingen worden genomen.

Technisch Leiderschap: Geef strategische richting voor het ontwerp, de ontwikkeling en implementatie van features, waarbij hoge beschikbaarheid, schaalbaarheid en beveiliging worden gegarandeerd.
Coach en begeleid ontwikkelaars binnen je team om ervoor te zorgen dat ze allemaal naar dezelfde doelen toewerken.
People Management: je bent verantwoordelijk voor de opvolging, groei en evaluaties van de ontwikkelaars binnen jouw team
Evaluatie van de Technologie Stack: Selecteer en evalueer technologieën, frameworks en tools om ervoor te zorgen dat ze in lijn zijn met de behoeften van het product, de technische doelen en de best practices binnen de industrie.
Hands-on development: Werk binnen een engineering team om de code architectuur, kwaliteit en design te bewaken. Lead by example: je ontwikkelt actief mee aan features en coached de rest van het team
Deployment Architecture: Ontwerp de applicatie-implementatie architectuur voor services, APIs en integraties, waardoor een modulaire en losgekoppelde architectuur wordt mogelijk gemaakt die hergebruik en snelle implementatie bevordert.
Security and Compliance: Implementeer beveiliging volgens de security by design-principes, waarbij wordt gegarandeerd dat het platform voldoet aan industriestandaarden zoals GDPR, SOC 2 en andere compliance vereisten.
Performance Optimization: Zorg ervoor dat de architectuur hoge beschikbaarheid, lage latentie en efficiënt gebruik van middelen ondersteunt, en streef naar continue verbetering.
Documentatie en normen: Zorg ervoor dat architecturale documentatie geschreven en up-to-date gehouden wordt en stel normen op voor ontwikkelingsteams om consistentie en kwaliteit te waarborgen.
Innovatie en Toekomstige Groei: Identificeer en evalueer opkomende technologieën en praktijken die de architectuur van het platform kunnen verbeteren en toekomstige zakelijke behoeften kunnen ondersteunen.

Wat breng jij mee?

Opleiding: Bachelor- of masterdiploma in Computer Science, Software Engineering of een gerelateerd vakgebied.
Minimaal 8 jaar ervaring in softwareontwikkeling, met ten minste 4 jaar in een software architect-rol gericht op SaaS-producten.
Bewezen ervaring in de architectuur van cloudgebaseerde oplossingen met platforms zoals GCP, AWS of Azure.
Sterk begrip van contract-first en event-driven architecturen, containerisatie (Docker, Kubernetes), micro-services en serverless technologieën.
Ervaring in de gezondheidszorg wordt als een pluspunt beschouwd.
Expertise in moderne programmeertalen zoals Java en idealiter Golang. Ervaring met Java en Spring Boot, en ervaring met Golang wordt als een groot pluspunt beschouwd.
Diepgaand begrip van databases (SQL/NoSQL), gedistribueerde systemen en event-driven architectuur.
Ervaring met CI/CD pipelines, DevSecOps-praktijken en infrastructure as code (IaC).
Sterke kennis van security best practices en compliance-normen in SaaS-omgevingen.
Uitstekende probleemoplossende vaardigheden en het vermogen om in een samenwerkende omgeving te werken.
Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden, met het vermogen om complexe technische concepten uit te leggen aan zowel technische als niet-technische belanghebbenden.
A can-do mentality: Je stelt oplossingen voor in plaats van problemen aan te kaarten en je kan actief mee in de code duiken
Je hebt ervaring binnen grotere omgevingen, waar er meerdere teams samen werken aan hetzelfde product.

Wat hebben wij jou te bieden?

Maatschappelijk Relevant Werk: Werk bij ons biedt de unieke kans om de gezondheidszorg te verbeteren en de levens van patiënten wereldwijd positief te beïnvloeden.
Uitgebreid salarispakket met Extralegale Voordelen: Een aantrekkelijk loon aangevuld met de keuze tussen een elektrische wagen met laadpas of een mobiliteitsbudget, maaltijdcheques, ecocheques, een uitgebreide groeps- en hospitalisatieverzekering, een gsm-abonnement, een forfaitaire onkostenvergoeding en de flexibiliteit om je salarispakket aan te passen met ons Flex Reward Plan.
Carrièreboost: Neem je eigen professionele groei met vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid in handen.
Skills Upgrade: We investeren in jouw training en talentontwikkeling om je vaardigheden naar een hoger niveau te tillen.

Work-Life Balance: We hechten waarde aan een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé en bieden flexibele werkuren om dit te ondersteunen.
Inspirerende Cultuur: Ontdek onze open, inclusieve bedrijfscultuur die innovatie verwelkomt en jouw ideeën waardeert.
Teamspirit: Bij ons ben je niet alleen een collega, maar een gewaardeerd lid van een hecht team. We organiseren regelmatig teambuilding-activiteiten en evenementen om de samenwerking te bevorderen.
Fun@work: Werk is leuk bij ons! Geniet van maandelijkse happy hours, spannende team-events en legendarische bedrijfsfeesten.

You’ll be part of the HID Identity Technologies Lab, helping to shape Seos technology inside smart devices and across global ecosystems.

Who are we?

HID powers the trusted identities of the world’s people, places, and things, allowing people to transact safely, work productively and travel freely.

We are a high-tech software company headquartered in Austin, TX, with over 4,500 worldwide employees. Check us out here: www.hidglobal.com and https://youtu.be/23km5H4K9Eo

Test case architecture, specification, and implementation
Interest in test automation (Jenkins, scripting languages)
Align and develop a common test framework, common libraries, code coverage tools, reporting UI frameworks
Eager to learn DevOps skills and common frameworks/tools
Understanding of low-level hardware communication protocols
ISTQB certification or other test certification (can be acquired online)
Experience with Secure Elements, RFID, NFC, HCE or BLE technologies
Working knowledge of cryptography and security practices

What we can offer you:

Competitive salary and rewards package
Competitive benefits and annual leave offering, allowing for work-life balance
A vibrant, welcoming & inclusive culture
Extensive career development opportunities and resources to maximize your potential
To be a part of a global organization that is pioneering the hardware, software and services that allow people to confidently navigate the physical and digital worlds

Empowerment: You’ll work as part of a global team in a flexible work environment, learning and enhancing your expertise. Integrity: You are results-orientated, reliable, and straightforward and value being treated accordingly. We want all our employees to be themselves, to feel appreciated and accepted

As a Senior Software Engineer at Diligent, you’ll be hands-on in shaping the future of our platform by designing and delivering secure, scalable, and high-performing microservices that power our SaaS solutions. You’ll have the full power of AWS at your disposal and will work primarily in C#/.Net Core and Angular to build serverless solutions, either from the ground up or by modernizing existing services.

In this role, you’ll lead by example, owning services end-to-end from development to deployment and monitoring, driving architectural discussions, and mentoring others across the team. You’ll be a key voice in evolving our engineering practices and will actively champion the use of AI-powered tools to streamline development, improve quality, and boost team productivity.

We’re looking for someone who is not only passionate about building great software but also excited to explore how AI can unlock better ways of working for themselves and their teammates.

Key Responsibilities:

Design and own secure, scalable services, guiding technical decisions and evaluating trade-offs (including AI-driven components) to meet reliability, performance, and cost goals.
Leverage AI tools to accelerate coding, debugging, testing, and prototyping, while rigorously validating outputs to ensure quality and safety.
Advise on appropriate AI use (model concepts, prompt patterns, ethical/privacy considerations), embed monitoring and compliance checks into workflows, and document residual risks and mitigations.
Coach peers on engineering best practices and AI-augmented approaches; partner with Product, Security, DevOps, and other teams to align on features, deployment, and compliance.
Scout and pilot emerging tools or frameworks (including AI toolchains), integrate automated governance checks into pipelines, and enhance observability and incident response with an eye on productivity, cost, and resilience.

Required Experience/Skills

5-7 years of professional software engineering in an agile environment, delivering secure, scalable services.
Understands high-level LLM concepts (e.g., hallucinations, prompt sensitivity) and safe vs. unsafe AI use cases.
Experienced in using AI tools to accelerate coding, debugging, testing, and prototyping, with critical review of outputs.
Skilled in prompt engineering—designing reusable prompts and coaching peers.
Familiar with ethical/cost risks (bias, privacy, vendor lock-in) and embeds basic compliance checks into workflows.
Proficient in C#, .Net for RESTful APIs (OpenAPI), and hands-on AWS serverless patterns.
Comfortable with infrastructure as code (CDK/Terraform), containerization (Docker), CI/CD pipelines, and monitoring tools.
Experience with SQL (PostgreSQL) and/or NoSQL databases; able to design and optimize schemas for performance.
Applies security best practices in code and deployments (e.g., IAM, secrets management) and reviews AI-assisted suggestions for safety.
Strong communication of technical and AI-related concepts to diverse stakeholders.
Proven ability to mentor or guide peers on engineering best practices and AI-augmented workflows.
Familiarity with Angular to collaborate effectively on end-to-end features.
Degree in Computer Science/Engineering/related field or equivalent hands-on experience.

About Us

Diligent is the AI leader in governance, risk and compliance (GRC) SaaS solutions, helping more than 1 million users and 700,000 board members to clarify risk and elevate governance. The Diligent One Platform gives practitioners, the C-Suite and the board a consolidated view of their entire GRC practice so they can more effectively manage risk, build greater resilience and make better decisions, faster.

Curiosity is in our DNA, we look for individuals willing to ask the big questions and experiment fearlessly - those who embrace change not as a challenge, but as an opportunity. The future belongs to those who keep learning, and we are building it together. At Diligent, you’re not just building the future - you’re an agent of positive change, joining a global community on a mission to make an impact.

Learn more at diligent.com or follow us on LinkedIn and Facebook

Creativity is ingrained in our culture. We are innovative collaborators by nature. We thrive in exploring how things can be differently both in our internal processes and to help our clients
We care about our people. Diligent offers a flexible work environment, global days of service, comprehensive health benefits, meeting free days, generous time off policy and wellness programs to name a few
We have teams all over the world. We may be headquartered in New York City, but we have office hubs in Washington D.C., Vancouver, London, Galway, Budapest, Munich, Bengaluru, Singapore, and Sydney.
Diversity is important to us. Growing, maintaining and promoting a diverse team is a top priority for us. We foster and encourage diversity through our Employee Resource Groups and provide access to resources and education to support the education of our team, facilitate dialogue, and foster understanding.

Diligent created the modern governance movement. Our world-changing idea is to empower leaders with the technology, insights and connections they need to drive greater impact and accountability – to lead with purpose. Our employees are passionate, smart, and creative people who not only want to help build the software company of the future, but who want to make the world a more sustainable, equitable and better place.

Networking, Firewall & WAF

Container Platform — AKS / Kubernetes

Support and guide migrations from existing container platforms onto AKS.

Logging, Monitoring & SIEM
Architect the observability stack using Azure Monitor and Log Analytics, including workspace architecture, retention and cost management.
Define SLO/SLI-based monitoring and alerting for critical services.

Deliver infrastructure through automated CI/CD pipelines.
Establish IaC and policy-as-code standards using technologies such as Azure Policy, Checkov and tfsec.
Automate operational processes using PowerShell, Bash or Python.

Resilience & Technical Leadership
Architect HA and DR across infrastructure, databases and middleware.
Lead periodic DR exercises, L3 incident escalations and root-cause analysis.
Review project architectures against platform standards and provide architecture sign-off.
Mentor infrastructure, cloud and DevOps engineers.

Essential Skills & Experience

12+ years of experience across infrastructure and/or cloud architecture, including 5+ years designing and operating Azure at enterprise scale.
Strong combination of architecture and hands-on engineering experience
— candidates should have personally designed, built, configured and operated Azure environments.

jobs.title: Fullstack Developer
jobs.description:
Werk jij graag met moderne front-end technologie en wil je bijdragen aan een grote migratie van een Sitecore- naar een headless ContentStack-omgeving? Word Fullstack Developer bij Loyalis, onderdeel van a.s.r. in Heerlen.

Als Fullstack Developer bij Loyalis, een belangrijke inkomensverzekeraar in het zuiden van Nederland, werk je aan de vernieuwing van een belangrijk digitaal platform voor klanten en collega's. Je speelt een centrale rol in de migratie van de bestaande Sitecore-omgeving naar een moderne headless ContentStack-omgeving en helpt mee om het platform klaar te maken voor de toekomst. Daarbij ligt de nadruk op front-endontwikkeling met Vue.js, Nuxt en TypeScript, terwijl je ook betrokken bent bij API's en de verdere modernisering van de back-end. Je werkt samen met ontwikkelaars, testers, een businessanalist en de product owner aan oplossingen die dagelijks worden gebruikt. Bovendien krijg je ruimte om je verder te ontwikkelen richting back-enddevelopment en mee te denken over de technische koers van het platform. Wil jij bouwen aan een nieuw digitaal platform binnen een betrokken team dat volop in ontwikkeling is? Solliciteer dan nu als Fullstack Developer bij Loyalis, onderdeel van a.s.r.!

Dit ga je doen als Fullstack Developer bij a.s.r.
je ontwikkelt en verbetert de front-end van het nieuwe digitale platform met Vue.js, Nuxt en TypeScript

je vertaalt ontwerpen naar toegankelijke, schaalbare en onderhoudsvriendelijke front-endoplossingen
je koppelt front-endcomponenten aan API's en ContentStack

je werkt mee aan de migratie van technisch complexe functionaliteit naar nieuwe API's en services

je draagt bij aan het ontwikkelen en onderhouden van API's in .NET, inclusief documentatie via Swagger

Dit bieden we je
een bruto salaris van € 4.100 - € 5.800 op basis van 38 uur per week, een 13e maand en 8% vakantievergoeding. Een thuiswerkvergoeding en korting op verzekeringen
een goede pensioenregeling met veel flexibiliteit en een hoge bijdrage van de werkgever
een NS-Business Card met vrij reizen (ook privé) of een kilometervergoeding
veel aandacht voor je ontwikkeling, je inzetbaarheid en je gezondheid
hybride werken: gemiddeld 60% vanuit huis en 40% op kantoor en veel ruimte om je eigen werktijden te bepalen
werk waarmee je een positieve invloed hebt op de samenleving van morgen; samen stropen we onze mouwen op voor een eerlijkere en duurzamere toekomst

Deze vacature is echt iets voor jou, want jij
hebt ervaring met Vue.js, Nuxt en TypeScript of vergelijkbare moderne front-end frameworks
hebt ervaring met contentmanagementsystemen; ervaring met een migratietraject is een pré (bijvoorbeeld Sitecore of een headless CMS zoals ContentStack)

hebt affiniteit met back-endontwikkeling en API-integraties

hebt bij voorkeur ervaring met businessanalyse, requirementsanalyse en technische analyse
communiceert gemakkelijk met collega’s en werkt graag samen binnen een scrumteam

Hier ga je werken als Fullstack Developer in Heerlen
Je gaat aan de slag in Team Apollo binnen Loyalis. Samen met ongeveer 7 DevOps-engineers, een product owner en een scrum master werk je aan de Loyalis-website en de verwerking van nieuwe polisaanvragen. Daarbij krijg je te maken met verschillende technologieën, zoals Sitecore en ContentStack, Vue en Nuxt, .NET-services en OutSystems. De komende periode staat in het teken van belangrijke vernieuwingen, waardoor je volop kunt meebouwen aan de toekomst van het platform. Het team werkt in sprints van 3 weken en komt 2 keer per week samen op kantoor voor overleg, samenwerking en kennisdeling. De overige dagen kun je vanuit huis werken. Loyalis, een merk van a.s.r., is dé verzekeraar voor inkomen en zekerheid binnen de sectoren overheid, onderwijs, zorg, vervoer, bouw en nutsbedrijven. We bieden producten en diensten op het gebied van arbeidsongeschiktheid en helpen onze klanten om uitval te voorkomen. Werken bij Loyalis heeft nog méér voordelen: een fijne werksfeer, een uitstekende werk-privébalans, alle ruimte om je verder te ontwikkelen én de mogelijkheid om thuis te werken! jobs.title: Software Engineer (AI-Native)
jobs.description:
Despre noi

Suntem un start-up care sprijină SOLOprenorii în drumul lor spre succes. Peste 30.000 de freelanceri, medici, IT-iști și antreprenori români au ales în ultimii 5 ani să își gestioneze PFA-ul cu SOLO — și asta ne face și mai ambițioși. Vrem să ajungem cât mai curând la 100.000 de clienți activi. Misiunea noastră este să transformăm birocrația într-un sistem simplu, digital și automatizat.

Despre ce este rolul?

SOLO este o companie de tehnologie care construiește produse folosite zilnic de zeci de mii de antreprenori din România.

Suntem într-o etapă în care AI-ul devine o componentă centrală în modul în care dezvoltăm produsul. Căutăm un inginer care vede AI-ul nu ca pe un tool auxiliar, ci ca pe o componentă de bază în construcția sistemelor.

Vei lucra la probleme reale, cu impact direct în produs, și vei contribui la modul în care integrăm AI în procesele noastre de dezvoltare în următorii ani.

Este un rol dificil, dar cu impact major asupra direcției tehnice a companiei.

Misiunea ta în acest rol

Vei construi și livra funcționalități care ajung rapid în producție și sunt folosite de un număr mare de utilizatori.
Vei folosi AI pentru a automatiza fluxuri existente și pentru a construi sisteme noi — de la procese interne până la funcționalități direct în produs.
Vei contribui la decizii de arhitectură și la definirea modului în care folosim AI în dezvoltare. Nu există încă un playbook clar — o parte din rol este să îl construim.
Vei lucra direct cu fondatorii, CTO-ul și cu o echipă care pune accent pe simplitate, viteză de execuție și calitate.

Ce ne dorim de la tine

Ai experiență solidă ca software engineer (focus pe .NET) și poți livra constant într-un mediu cu ritm rapid.

Poți transforma probleme neclare în soluții funcționale, fără să depinzi de specificații perfecte.

Ești un power user real de AI. Scrii prompturi ca pe specificații tehnice. Ai construit sau cel puțin ai încercat să construiești un agent autonom, chiar și ca proiect personal de weekend.

Ai instincte bune despre când AI-ul e soluția și când nu e. Ești genul care citește release notes-urile OpenAI și Anthropic în ziua în care apar.

Comunici bine, colaborezi ușor și îți asumi responsabilitatea pentru ceea ce construiești.

Cultura noastră este orientată către performanță, energie și disciplină. Ne dorim colegi care împărtășesc un stil de viață sănătos, iar acest lucru nu este compatibil cu fumatul.

Ce oferim

Salariu competitiv (14.000 - 20.000 RON net, în funcție de nivel)
Zile nelimitate de concediu (pe care le și folosim)
Program flexibil
Abonament premium la clinicile medicale Regina Maria;
Abonament Bookster;
Acces la tool-uri AI (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, etc) și buget de utilizare.
Lucrăm de la biroul nostru din București (Aviatorilor/Ch de Gaulle), pentru viteză și colaborare

Despre cum lucrăm în general

Modul În Care Lucrăm Este Influențat De Valorile În Care Credem Și Pe Care Ne Propunem Să Le Aplicăm În Tot Ce Facem

Creșterea continuă și accelerată e ceva fundamental - ne așteptăm de la fiecare coleg să își dorească să se dezvolte și să profite pe deplin de toate resursele pe care le punem la dispoziție pentru învățare. Apoi, ne așteptăm ca fiecare coleg să fie interesat mai ales de rezultat, nu doar de efort în sine.

Clientul este în centrul activității noastre: îi înțelegem nevoia reală, îl tratăm cu empatie și alegem soluții simple și clare pentru el. Facem toate acestea în timp ce ne comportăm cu bunăvoință unii față de alții, oferim și acceptăm feedback și menținem și consolidăm un spirit de echipă în care să ne regăsim cu toții.

Fiind un start-up, ne dorim alături oameni energici, curajosi, autonomi, cu o gândire dincolo de tipare, cu simțul umorului și cu o mare flexibilitate mentală, pentru că adesea realitatea din jur și activitățile noastre de zi cu zi se schimbă din mers în timp ce direcția rămâne clară: suntem aici pentru a sprijini SOLOprenorii.

In this role, you will join our software development department of 35 professionals covering analysis, development, and testing. The team is highly autonomous and works closely with Product Owners to build in house, business driven applications.

Our architecture is Angular, API first, cloud native, and centered around Microsoft Azure, with Apigee for API management and Okta for identity and access management. Knowledge of WEB design is highly valued.

To be successful as a WEB developer, you are analytical, technically strong, and comfortable translating business requirements into robust, secure, and scalable software solutions.

What will you do?

As a WEB Developer, you will:

Develop and maintain scalable web applications using modern front end (Angular) and back end (Dotnet) technologies within Azure
Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code following best practices and coding standards
Collaborate with UI/UX designers to implement responsive and intuitive user interfaces
Optimize applications for maximum speed and scalability
Implement security and data protection measures
Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to team members
Write and maintain technical documentation

What do we expect from you?

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in an Informatics or IT related field
Proven experience as a WEB developer
Strong proficiency in front end technologies: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), and modern frameworks (Angular preferred, React or Vue.js)
Experience with Agile development methodologies

Throughout September and October, we will review and shortlist potential candidates. Shortlisted candidates will be invited for onsite interviews in October.

With great pride, we can say that Hillebrand Gori is the largest beverages logistics company in the world. Founded in 1844, we are active in over 90 countries. jobs.description:
Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Solution Architect Expert

Onafhankelijke Ziekenfondsen

Bij de Onafhankelijke Ziekenfondsen geloven we in een toekomst waarin zorg menselijker, slimmer en efficiënter is. En daar werken we elke dag met veel goesting
aan.

Onze Landsbond telt meer dan 1.000 gemotiveerde medewerkers die samen één doel delen: de gezondheidszorg van morgen vormgeven. Drie ziekenfondsen maken deel uit van onze groep: Partenamut, Helan en de Freie Krankenkasse. Samen staan we paraat voor meer dan 2,3 miljoen leden.

Bij ons krijg je geen gewone job, maar een ZINvolle uitdaging.
We zetten complexe vraagstukken om in concrete, haalbare en slimme oplossingen. Vrij en onafhankelijk van politieke of religieuze banden streven we elke dag weer naar de beste service voor onze leden.

Onze medewerkers bruisen van talent, kennis en initiatief.
Ze nemen hun carrière in eigen handen en denken mee over hoe het beter kan. Die gedrevenheid en flexibiliteit maken ons sterk.

Respect, ondernemerschap en resultaatgerichtheid vormen de basis van onze cultuur. We geloven in flexibel werken, in tijd én in ruimte. Moderne kantoren en een open sfeer maken het plaatje compleet.

Klaar om je talenten in te zetten voor zorg die mensen vooruithelpt? Ontdek onze vacatures en groei met ons mee.

Ontdek onze vacatures op www.mloz.be

Functieomschrijving

Als Solution Architect draag je bij aan het ontwerpen van het IT-landschap van de organisatie op basis van de business-strategie. Je fungeert als de belangrijkste schakel tussen de business en IT voor strategische initiatieven en bent ook de technische leider van een transversale squad die verantwoordelijk is voor een portfolio van kritieke businesstoepassingen.

Je komt bij een team dat momenteel bestaat uit een product owner, een scrum master, een analist en een ontwikkelaar. In deze rol leg je de technische visie vast, stuur je architecturale beslissingen aan, mentor je teamleden en waarborg je de duurzaamheid op lange termijn van de oplossingen die onder jouw verantwoordelijkheid vallen.

Een bijzondere uitdaging van deze positie is dat de squad meer dan 40 kritieke businesstoepassingen beheert, inclusief verschillende legacy systemen en moderne, op Azure gebaseerde, oplossingen. Je moet in staat zijn om aan meerdere projecten tegelijkertijd te werken en daarbij de operationele stabiliteit waarborgen en de lopende transformatie-initiatieven ondersteunen.

Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Betrokkenheid bij de ontwikkeling van projecten

Helpen businessbehoeften en -vereisten in kaart brengen tijdens workshops en ontdekkingssessies.
Verschillende oplossingsopties evalueren en de meest geschikte architectuur aanbevelen op basis van de business-strategie, architecturale principes, kosten, risico’s en overgangsplannen.
Oplossingsarchitecturen definiëren, documenteren en communiceren aan belanghebbenden uit zowel de business als de IT, en de bijbehorende architecturale modellen en documentatie opstellen en bijhouden.
De gevolgen en onderlinge afhankelijkheden tussen bestaande toepassingen, lopende projecten en toekomstige initiatieven identificeren, en prioritering binnen de roadmap van de organisatie ondersteunen.
Businessvereisten omzetten in haalbare technische oplossingen en implementeringsroadmaps.
Bijdragen aan discussies over technisch ontwerp, en ontwikkelingsstandaarden en beste praktijken vaststellen.
Ondersteuning bieden bij financiële prognoses, het inschatten van de benodigde inspanningen, het identificeren van risico’s en het opstellen van plannen voor risicobeperking.

Technische Leiderschap

Optreden als de technische leider van de squad en advies geven over architecturale en technische beslissingen.
Ontwikkelaars en andere teamleden coachen, mentoren en ondersteunen in het versterken van hun technische expertise.
Beste praktijken voor software engineering, codekwaliteit, beveiliging, onderhoudbaarheid en schaalbaarheid bevorderen.
Technische reviews leiden en ervoor zorgen dat de architecturale standaarden worden nageleefd.
Het oplossen en verhelpen van complexe technische kwesties in het volledige toepassingenlandschap ondersteunen.
Initiatieven voor voortdurende verbetering binnen het team aansturen.

Profiel kandidaat

Ervaring en opleiding

Masterdiploma in computerwetenschappen of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
Minstens 5 jaar ervaring als Solution Architect, Technical Lead, Senior ontwikkelaar, of een gelijkaardige rol, idealiter in complexe bedrijfsomgevingen.
Ervaring met agile en SAFe-omgevingen; ervaring in de verzekeringssector, gezondheidszorg of andere sterk gereguleerde sectoren is een grote troef.
Frans of Nederlands is vereist, met een zeer goed begrip van de andere taal, alsook een uitstekende beheersing van het Engels.

Technische Vaardigheden

Uitstekende kennis van oplossings- en integratiearchitectuur, met een sterke achtergrond in softwareontwikkeling en levenscyclusbeheer van toepassingen.
Sterke ervaring met .NET/C# en uitgebreide kennis van JavaScript/TypeScript, inclusief Angular en Single Page Applications (SPA).
Hoge bekwaamheid in Microsoft SQL Server, Azure SQL en T-SQL.
Hands-on ervaring met Microsoft Azure-diensten, cloud-native architecturen en REST API’s; ervaring met Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Event-driven Architecture of Azure PaaS is een groot voordeel.
Ervaring met het implementeren van DevOps-praktijken en CI/CD-pipelines, met een sterk begrip van Git; vertrouwdheid met Infrastructure as Code, Azure DevOps Pipelines, Docker en containerisatie is een pluspunt.
Kennis van ArchiMate, BPMN en UML (certificering is een troef).
Ervaring met kostenramingen, risicobeheer en technische governance.

Niet-technische profielvereisten

Sterke analytische en probleemoplossende vaardigheden, met een gestructureerde en georganiseerde aanpak.
Het vermogen om verschillende projecten en prioriteiten tegelijkertijd te beheren, en om zelfstandig te werken met beperkt toezicht.
Een resultaat- en klantgerichte instelling, met een groot verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel en een sterke teamgeest.
Uitstekende vaardigheden op het gebied van interpersoonlijke communicatie en het omgaan met stakeholders, met het vermogen om complexe technische concepten over te brengen aan zowel technische als niet-technische doelgroepen.

Geboden wordt

Een topjob in een zinvolle sector
Een solidaire organisatie waar het fijn werken is
Een moderne werkomgeving, in een toegankelijke groene omgeving, ongeacht je favoriete vervoerswijze
Een goed evenwicht tussen privéleven en werk, met flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid om tot 3 dagen per week thuis te werken
Initiatieven die het welzijn bevorderen en de onderlinge band versterken: yoga, padel, inspirerende workshops, filmavonden, seizoensgebonden drinks, rondetafelgesprekken in het Nederlands of Frans, …
Een plek waar iedereen zichzelf kan zijn en gelijke kansen krijgt om zich te ontwikkelen
Een aantrekkelijk loonpakket
Een contract van onbepaalde duur
Toegang tot het Flexible Income Plan waarmee je zelf je loonpakket kan beheren in functie van je behoeften en je situatie
Talrijke extralegale voordelen, zoals aansluiting bij Dentalia Up en Hospitalia Plus, maaltijdcheques, ecocheques, groepsverzekering en een gsm
Een bedrijfswagen of een mobiliteitsbudget
37 dagen verlof per jaar
Een grondige opleiding over de ziekenfondssector bij aankomst en regelmatig opleidingen in de loop van je carrière

Meer informatie

Voor meer informatie bekijk onze bedrijfspagina (klik op ons logo bovenaan de vacature).

Solliciteren?

Solliciteer direct via bovenstaande button.

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld .
