jobs.description:
Because we strive to put people first.

Culture, our way.

Technology at Primark

What’s a career at Primark all about? The positive impact you’re making, the experiences you’re having and the people you’re with. You’re our inspiration. Embrace what sets you apart, own your career and develop in ways you never expected. Leave your mark. And do it your way.

Our technology team is actively seeking for Data Ops Analyst to join its Data Platform & Engineering team, supporting the reliability and performance of its Databricks-based enterprise data platform. The role focuses on monitoring data pipelines, managing incidents, coordinating releases and production handovers, and ensuring data products are well-governed, scalable, and operationally ready. Working closely with Data Engineering and Platform teams, you'll play a key role in delivering trusted data solutions while driving operational excellence and continuous improvement.

What You’ll Get

This role is a hybrid opportunity, offering 2-3 days Working from office.

People are at the heart of what we do here, so it’s essential we provide you with the right environment to perform at your very best.

Let’s talk lifestyle: Healthcare, pension and potential bonus. 27 days of leave, plus bank holidays and if you want, you can buy 5 more. Because Primark is all about tailoring to you we offer Tax Saver Tickets, fitness centre and a subsidised cafeteria.

What You’ll Do as
Data Ops Analyst

In your role, you’ll collaborate with different people across a range of skillsets. Here’s a flavour of your day-to-day:

Support the operation and reliability of Primark’s modern data platform helping manage Databricks, dbt Cloud and Azure data services while ensuring data products are production-ready, supportable and aligned with engineering standards.
Monitor and maintain critical data pipelines and platform services proactively identifying failures, delays, data quality issues and operational risks while coordinating incident triage, escalation and resolution to minimise business impact.
Coordinate releases, deployments and production handovers managing environment readiness, promotion activities, change governance, operational checklists, release schedules and service readiness documentation to ensure smooth delivery.
Drive operational excellence through governance and documentation maintaining runbooks, support guides, monitoring dashboards, service catalogues and reporting on platform health, SLA performance, deployment activity and support trends.
Collaborate with Data Engineering, Platform, Cloud, Security, BAU and SIAM teams supporting access management, environment support, platform issue resolution, service reviews and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance reliability and supportability.
Contribute to Primark’s data platform modernisation journey supporting the migration from Teradata to Databricks, validating production readiness, improving monitoring and automation capabilities and helping embed modern DataOps practices across deployment, observability and support processes.

What You’ll Bring

Here at Primark, we want everyone to feel valued – so please bring your authentic self to work, of course with some other key experience and abilities for this role in particular:

2-4 years’ experience in Data Operations, Application Support, Platform Support, Data Engineering Support or a similar operational role supporting business-critical systems and data platforms in a fast-paced environment.
Strong understanding of modern data platforms and DataOps practices with exposure to Azure DevOps, Databricks, dbt Cloud, Azure data services, SQL, Python, ETL/ELT processes, job scheduling, monitoring, observability and deployment automation.
Experience supporting production environments and service operations including monitoring, alerting, incident management, ticketing systems, release management, environment management, change governance and enterprise support processes.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate incidents methodically, identify root causes, assess business impact and drive issues through to resolution while maintaining high operational standards.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, Security, Governance, SIAM, Analytics and business teams while clearly communicating technical issues and recommended actions.
Proactive, detail-oriented and continuous improvement focused with experience maintaining operational documentation, runbooks, handover materials and support processes while identifying opportunities to improve reliability, reduce recurring issues, increase automation and enhance overall platform supportability.

Does this sound like you? Great, because we can’t wait to see what you’ll bring. You’ll be supported within a team of equally capable people, celebrating who you are and aiding you reach your potential. At Primark, we’re excited about our future - and we’re excited to develop yours.

About Primark

At Primark, people matter. They’re the beating heart of our business and the reason we’ve grown from our first store in Dublin in 1969 to over 80,000 colleagues and over 480 stores in 18 countries today and growing.

So, what’s a career at Primark all about? The positive impact you’re making, the experiences you’re having and the people you’re with. It’s that feeling that turns a job into something more. Celebrating the wins, working at pace, and pulling through the challenging times with passion, courage, and your team by your side. It’s what drives us every day.

You’re our driving force. Embrace what sets you apart, own your career and develop in ways you never expected. Leave your mark. And do it your way.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Senior AI Cloud Architect (AI Platform)- Public 360°- Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)

Tietoevry Public 360 - building secure, scalable digital services for the public sector across the Nordics.

About The Role

Public 360 integrates cloud-based AI capabilities into standard enterprise software. We are building solutions for 600+ public organizations in the Nordics, and our AI platform runs customer deployments at scale and is evolving fast with GenAI and agentic AI.

As Senior AI Cloud Architect, you own the cloud architecture for our AI platform and shared services. You will define reference architectures, make key technology choices (Microsoft-first, but open), and ensure security, reliability, and automation as we scale.

What You Will Do

Design and evolve the target architecture for a public-cloud-first AI platform (Azure preferred).
Exploration of alternative deployment strategies for high-security customers
Build secure, compliant foundations: landing zones, identity, networking, encryption, secrets, logging, and policy-as-code.
Architect for scale and automation: infrastructure as code, CI/CD, GitOps, self-service environments, and operational runbooks.
Own platform reliability: observability, SLOs, incident patterns, performance, and cost optimization (FinOps).
Define patterns for AI product integration: APIs, event-driven processing, data pipelines, and multi-tenant considerations.
Partner with AI engineers/data scientists on MLOps and LLMOps: model delivery pipelines, feature stores, evaluation, and monitoring.
Drive security and Trustworthy AI practices together with security, privacy, and product teams (GDPR and data residency aware).
Support solutioning and pre-sales when needed, and mentor architects/engineers across product teams.

What You Bring

Senior – 8-10+ years of relevant experience, including service or solution architecture in complex product environments. More junior profiles will be considered in case of relevant experience – not the time but the type of experience and responsibility is important to us.
Strong public cloud architecture skills (Azure: AKS/Container Apps, Functions, App Service, API Management, Event Hubs/Service Bus, Storage, SQL/Cosmos DB, Key Vault, Entra ID).
Experience with multiple deployment scenarios and high security requirements is a plus
Hands-on experience with automation: Terraform and/or Bicep, CI/CD (Azure DevOps/GitHub), and modern deployment practices.
Proven security architecture skills: threat modeling, zero trust, network segmentation, secrets management, vulnerability management, and audit readiness.
Experience building or operating AI/ML platforms: Azure ML/MLflow, model serving, data pipelines, and LLM integration patterns.
Ability to translate business needs into pragmatic architectures and communicate clearly with both engineers and stakeholders.

Nice to have

Experience with GenAI platforms (e.g., Azure OpenAI) and guardrails: content filters, prompt injection defense, red teaming, and evaluation.
Knowledge of data engineering components: Databricks/Spark, Delta Lake, data streaming, and search/vector databases.
Certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure Security Engineer, or similar.

Impact you will have

Own the reference architecture for our cloud-first AI platform supporting AI capabilities for public organizations in the Nordics.
Raise the security and compliance baseline with zero-trust patterns, policy-as-code, and audit-ready controls.
Increase delivery speed and consistency through automation: self-service environments.
Improve reliability and cost efficiency with SLO-driven operations, observability, and FinOps practices.

Tech we use

Azure-first and automation-driven: containers/Kubernetes, serverless, messaging, IaC (Terraform/Bicep), CI/CD (Azure DevOps/GitHub), observability, and cloud security tooling. We are open to AWS/GCP experience.

What Success Looks Like In 6 Months

A clear platform roadmap indicating the next steps for our data and ai platform as baseline for our product teams, supporting our vision of AI-first and agentic-first software offerings in the public sector domain.
Review and implementation of defined improvements of automation framework and pipelines in place for core platform services.
Operational excellence established: dashboards, SLOs, alerting, and incident playbooks used in day-to-day operations.
Security and Trustworthy AI governance embedded: threat models, risk assessments, and guardrail patterns for GenAI use cases.

Why join us

Build technology that improves citizen services - with real-world scale and meaningful impact.
A highly skilled, collaborative environment with room to influence architecture decisions end-to-end.
Modern cloud-first stack, strong focus on security and responsible AI, and freedom to explore new approaches (including agentic AI).
Professional growth, international collaboration, and a culture built on trust, transparency, and ownership.

Practicalities

Location and work setup: flexible/hybrid, ideally near one of our development hubs in Scandinavia (Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen or Espoo). Fluent English required; Nordic language skills are a plus.

Are you our new colleague?

We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today. If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring manager Geir Are Bjørnsrud (geirare.bjornsrud@tietoevry.com)

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

jobs.description:
Senior Principal Software Engineer

What Makes Us, Us

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

You will be joining an innovative application development team within SimCorp's Product Division. We provide a cloud native SaaS product built on Azure using modern development principles, technologies and practices.

The product, Digital Engagement Platform (DEP) has been operational for 3 years and based in client feedback and our own experience we have begun to lift the product to the next level, modernizing architecture and tech stack so we can scale DEP for a much larger audience than we can today.

This is why we need you - to help design and build a new DEP 2.0 that can support the biggest clients, asset managers, across the globe.

What You Will Be Responsible For

Feature development
DevOps discussions and implementations.
Design and Architecture: Work together with other software engineers and architect to define and refine the product architecture and roadmap
Guide and support other team mates to ensure the spread of knowledge and experience.
Keep up to date with the latest technologies and find ways to improve the existing software
Participate in support activities and client communication

To be successful in this job you are a very experienced developer. You have deep expertise in backend development and DevOps, and you are familiar with frontend development. You are a hands-on developer who loves to create high-quality code, and you can offer technical direction and leadership and collaboration with colleagues - architect and teammates - when creating an architecture, a design or just troubleshooting.

What We Value

You properly have a degree in computer science and 10+ years of experience in development. However, how you gained your skills is of lesser importance – even though we do expect you to be highly experienced in:

Backend development – C# and .NET
DevOps and CI/CD practices and tools
Azure and Azure DevOps
Application architecture and design, holistic view across, front, back and data
Agile development methodologies and collaboration

The bullets above will be your primary focus areas, but in order to be successful you will collaborate with teammates that are specialized in:

Frontend development in Angular and TypeScript
Data engineering with Snowflake, dbt and Airflow

Should these areas have your interest, it will be possible to expand your expertise and learn and understand more about these areas.

As a person, you have the following traits:

You collaborate with team members to work towards common goals.
Solid problem-solving skills and comfortable questioning assumptions and as-is.
Clear communicator who speaks up when needed.
Exhibits a consistent approach and a creative mindset.
Thrives in a collaborative environment and values teamwork
Like to have fun at work and positivity comes easily to you

Benefits

Attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work-life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model. Simcorp follows a global hybrid policy, asking employees to work from the office two days each week while allowing remote work on other days.

Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

For any questions you are welcome to contact Aditya.gurijala@simcorp.com
. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.  

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

Who We Are

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds. 

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

jobs.description:
Are you motivated by optimizing production equipment and processes in a high-tech production? Do you thrive at the intersection of software development, production technology, and continuous improvement? Are you ready to take ownership of solutions that support automated production and make a tangible impact on daily operations in an international organization?

Here Is What The Job Entails

As our Software Developer you will be responsible for the development of manufacturing software solutions that are essential to our automated production. You will help ensure scalability, reliability, and continuous improvement across multiple production technologies. Furthermore, you will manage and contribute to robust software solutions that support our high-tech production by working across the full development lifecycle.

More specifically, you will be:

Designing, developing, and maintaining manufacturing software solutions for automated production lines
Participating in specification, implementation, testing, deployment, and monitoring of software applications
Collaborating with stakeholders to translate business needs into robust technical solutions
Supporting continuous improvement initiatives across production equipment, processes, and technologies

We offer a position where you will have significant influence on software solutions that are central to our production. You will join a highly skilled environment with broad exposure to production technology, automation, and software development, while being empowered to take ownership and drive improvements from idea to implementation.

Meet your future team

With direct reference to our Senior Manager, PT & MSW, H/C SC, you will be a part of our Production Technology and Manufacturing Software team, consisting of 9 colleagues. Together, we work on implementing new technologies and optimizing production processes across our Heat/Cooling production to ensure high product quality, uptime, and delivery performance. You will become part of a highly skilled team characterized by challenging tasks, close cross-functional collaboration, and an informal working environment.

Less About Us, More About You

We are looking for an experienced Software Developer who is motivated by developing reliable and scalable software solutions while working closely with colleagues and stakeholders across production and technology. You naturally take responsibility for driving software solutions from design to deployment, ensuring they are both technically robust and aligned with business needs.

In order to succeed we imagine that you:

Have 5-10 years of professional software development experience, preferably from manufacturing, industrial automation, supply chain or product development.
Have worked with business-critical systems in production, logistics, supply chain or industrial environments
Bring experience with object-oriented development in C#/.NET or similar technologies, including integration with hardware, instruments or actual production lines
Are comfortable engaging directly with stakeholders and translating business needs into technical solutions

We are more than an ordinary workplace

We cherish the good colleagueship which we all contribute to, the only limit is your engagement. As we are a big organization you are bound to find one or more colleagues who share the same interest as you. This might be in our board game club, on our cycling team, during our yearly summer festival, or on the padel court. For example, our Team lead, Service Delivery is also our volunteer padel instructor while one of our Software Test Engineers run weekly spinning classes.

Besides the best colleagues you could imagine, we also offer:

Work life balance through flexible working hours
Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic
An active employee association that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community
Beneficial health care and insurance package

Do you want to be a part of Kamstrup?

Please submit your application by using the link below. Please note that, due to the summer holiday period, applications will be processed and reviewed starting in Week 32.

The job will be located at Kamstrup's headquarters in Stilling, between Aarhus and Skanderborg.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Senior Manager, PT & MSW, H/C SC, Frederik Dirach Lauritzen on phone: +45 89 93 10 00.

Get to know us

At Kamstrup, you'll become part of a close-knit community that genuinely cares about one another, fostering connections both in and out of the workplace. Our team comprises innovators, dreamers, and doers, united by an unyielding passion to challenge the status quo, find better solutions, and constantly push the boundaries of what's possible by being driving by our purpose: We Make What You Measure Matter. With an unwavering commitment to growth, we offer opportunities for you to leverage your skills and drive our business to new heights, empowering you to leave your mark on our future and grow with us.

SYSTRA Danmark løser rådgiverprojekter inden for transport, it, miljø og byudvikling. Vi er med fra de helt tidlige planlægningsfaser på mange af tidens samfundsvigtige projekter.

Context

Lige nu søger vi en praktikant i afdelingen GIS & Digital for foråret 2027.

Vi Forestiller Os, At Du Har Gåpåmod Og Lyst Til At Lære i Et Stærkt Fagligt Og Socialt Fællesskab Og Ikke Mindst At Du Har Interesse Og Nysgerrighed Inden For Et Eller Flere Af De Følgende Områder

Kodning i C# .NET, samt evt. JavaScript/TypeScript eller Python
Teknologier som Docker, Blazor, Azure DevOps / GitLab, React, Angular, etc.

Er det noget for dig?

Hvis SYSTRA lyder som et praktiksted for dig, så send os en kort ansøgning og dit cv.

SYSTRA er en international konsulentvirksomhed, der er førende inden for design, planlægning og udførelse af infrastrukturløsninger. Vi arbejder med jernbaner, veje, letbaner, metroer samt forsyning, miljø og vand. SYSTRA blev grundlagt i Frankrig i 1957 og har i dag omkring 11.000 medarbejdere i 80 lande.

jobs.title: Senior Associate/Assistant Vice President, Full Stack Agentic AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Temasek is a global investment company headquartered in Singapore, with a net portfolio value of S$518 billion (US$401b, €350b, £304b, RMB2.77t) as at 31 March 2026. Our Purpose “ So Every Generation Prospers ” guides us to make a difference for today’s and future generations. We seek to build a resilient and forward-looking portfolio that will deliver good sustainable returns over the long term.    

We have 13 offices in 9 countries around the world: Beijing, Hanoi, Mumbai, Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Singapore in Asia; and Brussels, London, Mexico City, New York, Paris, San Francisco, and Washington, DC outside Asia. 

For more information on Temasek, please visit www.temasek.com.sg    
For Temasek Review 2026, please visit www.temasekreview.com.sg
For Sustainability Report 2026, please visit www.temasek.com.sg/SR2026

Introduction
Agentic AI engineering is a frontier discipline that requires both deep AI system knowledge and the full-stack engineering rigour to ship production-grade systems that operate reliably at enterprise scale. Building an agent that works in a notebook is table stakes; building one that handles edge cases gracefully, integrates securely with enterprise systems, and can be monitored and maintained by a team is the real engineering challenge. 

The Full Stack Agentic AI Engineer at Temasek is a hands-on builder responsible for designing, building, and operating AI-powered products and agent workflows across Temasek's investment and operations functions. You will work end-to-end — from LLM integration and agent orchestration through to front-end interfaces, API integrations, and production monitoring — with a relentless focus on reliability, observability, and user experience. You will be building systems that investment professionals and operations teams depend on for real decisions, not demos.

Responsibilities
Agentic AI system engineering

Design and implement multi-step agentic AI workflows: agent orchestration (single-agent and multi-agent coordination), tool-calling architectures, memory and state management, and planning and reasoning loops using frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, or custom orchestration.
Build production-grade RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines: document ingestion and chunking strategies, embedding generation and management, vector store integration (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, or equivalent), semantic search, and hybrid retrieval architectures.
Implement robust tool and API integration layers that allow AI agents to safely interact with enterprise systems — including investment data platforms, portfolio management systems, market data APIs, and internal knowledge bases — with appropriate access controls, rate limiting, and error handling.
Engineer agent prompting and context management systems: system prompt architecture, dynamic context construction, prompt versioning, and evaluation-driven prompt optimisation using automated and human evaluation frameworks.
Contribute to the design and extension of Temasek's MCP (Model Context Protocol) server ecosystem — building new tool connectors and extending the platform's tool library with reusable, well-documented integrations.

Full-stack product engineering

Build the full application stack for AI products: React or equivalent front-end interfaces designed for professional user workflows; Python or Node.js back-end services; RESTful and streaming API layers; and enterprise integration middleware.
Design and implement real-time AI interaction patterns: streaming LLM responses, progressive disclosure of agent reasoning steps, asynchronous long-running agent task management, and WebSocket-based live update interfaces.
Own API design and documentation for AI product services — ensuring clean contracts, versioning discipline, and integration documentation that enables downstream consumers (other internal systems, citizen developer tools) to build reliably on your services.
Collaborate with data engineers to design the data access layer for AI products: query optimisation for AI-readable data, structured data extraction from unstructured sources, and data pipeline integrations that keep AI product knowledge bases current.

Production engineering and reliability

Instrument all AI systems with comprehensive observability: structured logging of agent actions, LLM call tracing (latency, token usage, model version), error rate monitoring, and alerting calibrated to the failure modes specific to agentic systems.
Design for graceful degradation: ensure AI systems fail safely, fall back to human escalation paths when uncertain, and communicate their limitations clearly to users — critical in a financial services context where AI failures have real consequences.
Implement testing strategies appropriate for non-deterministic AI systems: unit tests for deterministic components, evaluation suites for LLM behaviour (using frameworks such as LangSmith Evals, RAGAS, or custom evaluation pipelines), regression testing for prompt changes, and integration testing across the full agent workflow.
Participate actively in code review, architecture discussions, and production incident response — with a culture of collective ownership over system reliability and continuous improvement.

Requirements
Experience and background

Strong AI Engineering experience with proven expertise in designing, building, deploying, and operating production-grade AI systems. Candidates should have 5-8 years of engineering experience, including at least 2 years focused on AI/ML engineering and hands-on delivery of LLM-powered products in production.
Hands-on experience with modern agentic AI frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or equivalent; strong familiarity with the Anthropic and OpenAI SDKs and their tool-calling and streaming APIs.
Demonstrated experience shipping production AI systems with real users — not research experiments, but deployed products with monitoring, incident response, and continuous improvement cycles.
Experience in financial services, fintech, or data-intensive regulated industries is advantageous.

Technical capabilities

Languages and frameworks: Python (primary, including FastAPI, asyncio, Pydantic), TypeScript/JavaScript (React, Next.js, Node.js); comfortable across the stack without deep specialisation limiting your ability to contribute end-to-end.
AI/ML stack: LLM integration (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT-4o, Google Gemini), embedding models, vector databases, RAG pipeline components, evaluation frameworks (LangSmith, RAGAS, custom), and observability tooling (Helicone, LangFuse, or equivalent).
Infrastructure and DevOps: containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes), cloud deployment (AWS, Azure, or GCP), CI/CD pipelines, secrets management, and basic security hygiene for AI systems (input sanitisation, output validation, access-scoped tool permissions).
Data engineering basics: SQL proficiency, familiarity with data pipeline tooling (dbt, Airflow, or equivalent), and ability to design data access patterns optimised for AI consumption.

jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD100450

Position Overview

Autodesk is looking for a Software Quality Assurance Engineer / Software Engineer in Test
to join the Autodesk Revit Cloud Worksharing team.

Autodesk Revit is world-leading Building Information Modeling (BIM) software used by architects, engineers, and building industry professionals to design everything from homes and businesses to airports, skyscrapers, and major landmarks.

In this role, you will help ensure that the software and cloud services our customers depend on are reliable, usable, and high quality. You will work as part of a collaborative, cross-functional Agile team alongside software developers, quality engineers, product managers, and other engineering partners.

This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career engineer who is interested in both software quality assurance and test automation
. You will develop skills across exploratory and functional testing, automated testing, cloud technologies, troubleshooting, and software development practices while contributing directly to the quality of Autodesk Revit and Revit Cloud Worksharing.

You will report to a Software Engineering Manager and work with teammates distributed across multiple regions and time zones. The team collaborates globally, so your working hours should provide meaningful overlap with the US Eastern time zone.

Responsibilities

Participate in Agile/Scrum team activities and contribute to discussions about product quality, test strategy, and release readiness
Work with developers, QA engineers, and Software Engineers in Test to understand new features and identify appropriate testing approaches
Create clear, well-structured test plans and test cases based on product requirements and real-world customer workflows
Perform functional, exploratory, integration, regression, and system testing across desktop and cloud-based components
Identify, reproduce, document, and help troubleshoot software defects
Learn to use logs, debugging tools, telemetry, and other diagnostic information to help isolate problems and identify potential root causes
Develop and maintain automated tests with guidance from more experienced engineers
Contribute automated tests to Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment pipelines
Review automated and manually collected test results and help identify failures, trends, and areas of risk
Help evaluate where automation can improve test coverage, reliability, and engineering efficiency
Simulate real-world customer workflows and provide feedback to developers and product designers about usability and product quality
Collaborate with Product Support and engineering teams to understand customer-reported issues and improve the post-release customer experience
Learn Revit, Revit Cloud Worksharing, and related Autodesk workflows and technologies
Participate in team and cross-team quality initiatives and share knowledge with teammates
Continuously develop your skills in software testing, automation, cloud technologies, and quality engineering practices

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Engineering, Architecture, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
Up to 2 years of professional, internship, co-op, academic, or project experience related to software development, software testing, engineering, or a similar technical discipline
Basic understanding of software testing concepts such as test cases, test plans, defect reporting, and debugging
Experience with or coursework in at least one programming or scripting language such as Python, C#, JavaScript, Java, or similar
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with an interest in investigating how software works and why it fails
Ability and willingness to learn new applications, technologies, and development processes
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Ability to collaborate effectively within a diverse, globally distributed team
Curiosity, attention to detail, and a commitment to delivering a high-quality customer experience

Preferred Qualifications

Internship, academic, or professional experience with software quality assurance or automated testing
Familiarity with one or more automated testing tools or frameworks
Exposure to Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment concepts or tools
Familiarity with cloud platforms or cloud-based applications such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
Experience working in Windows and/or Linux environments
Familiarity with Agile or Scrum software development practices
Knowledge of the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) industry
Experience with Autodesk Revit or other Autodesk/AEC software
Experience designing buildings, working with BIM models, or using engineering or architecture software
Interest in learning both customer-focused quality assurance and software engineering approaches to automated testing
Basic experience using AI-assisted development tools to help write, understand, debug, or improve code and automated tests
Familiarity with using generative AI tools to assist with tasks such as creating test cases, generating test data, troubleshooting failures, or documenting technical work
An interest in learning how AI can be applied responsibly to improve software development, test automation, and quality engineering workflows

You do not need to meet every preferred qualification. We are looking for someone with a strong learning mindset who is excited to develop skills across software quality, test engineering, automation, and emerging AI-assisted development practices

What Will Help You Succeed

You will thrive in this role if:

You are curious and enjoy understanding how complex systems work
You approach problems from the customer’s point of view
You enjoy finding problems—and are equally interested in helping prevent them
You want to learn how automation can make software testing more reliable and efficient
You are comfortable asking questions, gathering feedback, and collaborating across disciplines
You use data and evidence to help make decisions
You see unexpected failures as opportunities to learn and improve
You take ownership of your work while seeking guidance when needed
You care about earning and maintaining our customers’ trust

Learn More

About Autodesk

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

Salary transparency

Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. For Romania based roles, we expect a starting base salary between 126,000 RON and 184,800 RON. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location, and may exceed this range. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Belonging

We take pride in cultivating a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive. Learn more here: https://www.autodesk.com/company/global-belonging

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer - Digital Business
jobs.description:
Digitale innovatie vraagt om teams die bouwen, automatiseren en continu verbeteren. Als DevOps Engineer binnen Digital Business speel jij een sleutelrol in het ontwerpen en beheren van moderne cloudplatformen die onze klanten helpen sneller en slimmer te werken. Samen met een hecht team van experts zet je innovatie om in betrouwbare oplossingen met impact. Klaar om mee de digitale toekomst vorm te geven?

Je zet technische analyses en proof-of-concepts op tijdens de foundation phase.
Je bouwt mee aan een schaalbare en beheerbare cloud-native platformomgeving.
Je denkt mee over containerisatie en migratie van applicaties naar AKS/ACA.
Je ondersteunt bij het selecteren en implementeren van Software Development Lifecycle tooling.
Je werkt samen met development- en infra teams om een future-proof platform te realiseren.

Wat breng jij mee?

Je hebt een sterke ervaring met Azure en .NET Core.
Je beschikt over ervaring met containerisatie (AKS/ACA/Docker).
Je hebt kennis van Cloud Native ecosystemen (service mesh, GitOps, CI/CD).
Ervaring met applicatie modernisering, replatforming en het opzetten van Software Development Lifecycle pipelines zijn een plus.
Je bent een proactieve, constructieve teamspeler die zowel kan bouwen als challengen.
De agile omgeving waarin je terechtkomt zoek echte teamplayers.
Kwaliteit primeert over kwantiteit bij jou.
Je spreekt en schrijft vlot Nederlans en Engels.
Je werkt 1 à 2 dagen/week bij de klant in Brussel (vlak aan Centraal station) en van thuis.

We vragen heel wat (talenten) van jou. Gelukkig krijg je er ook heel wat voor terug! Competenties en karakter zijn voor ons essentieel, naast ervaring en ambities. Cegeka investeert voortdurend in talent management opdat alle medewerkers hun potentieel kunnen realiseren.
Cegeka bewijst jaar na jaar in het Whitelane Research dat we een betrouwbare en toonaangevende partner zijn op vlak van IT-dienstverlening, met een eerste plaats in 2026 voor Security Services (vierde jaar op rij), een gedeelde tweede plaats voor Cloud & Infrastructure Services en Network & Connectivity.
Je start bij een Top Employer!
Wij hanteren een framework met het oog op eerlijke verloning, waarbij medewerkers worden verloond op basis van hun functie, ervaring en prestaties, onafhankelijk van gender of andere niet-werkgerelateerde kenmerken.
Een elektrische wagen met laadpas of een mobiliteitsbudget, maaltijdcheques, ecocheques, een interessante groeps- en hospitalisatieverzekering, een gsm-abonnement, een forfaitaire onkostenvergoeding, een krachtige laptop en de mogelijkheid om je salarispakket een eigen accent te geven dankzij ons Flex Reward Plan.
Flexibele werkuren én een mooie work/life balans.

jobs.title: Senior MES Engineer / Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced and customer-facing Senior MES Engineer / Solutions Architect
with 8+ years of hands-on expertise in Manufacturing Execution Systems to join our team. This is a hybrid role that combines deep technical leadership with significant pre-sales engagement: you will design end-to-end MES architectures for our industrial clients while playing a key role in shaping winning proposals, leading workshops, and acting as the trusted technical advisor during the sales cycle. The ideal candidate has delivered MES projects across discrete, batch, or process industries, is comfortable conversing with C-level stakeholders and shop-floor engineers alike, and thrives at the intersection of business strategy, technology, and customer engagement. Strong knowledge of leading MES platforms, ISA-95, and Industry 4.0 reference architectures is essential.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the design of end-to-end MES and Manufacturing Operations Management (MOM) solution architectures, including integration with ERP, PLC/SCADA, historians, LIMS, and emerging Unified Namespace / IIoT platforms.
Act as the lead technical contributor in pre-sales activities: discovery workshops, requirement gathering, solution shaping, demos, proofs-of-concept, and proposal writing.
Translate customer business needs into compelling, well-scoped, and competitively priced technical solutions, working closely with sales, delivery, and partner teams.
Respond to RFI/RFP documents, prepare effort estimates, define delivery roadmaps, and validate commercial assumptions.
Present solution architectures and value propositions to senior client stakeholders, both technical and executive.
Provide architectural governance during project delivery, ensuring that solutions are implemented in line with the design and adapt cleanly to evolving requirements.
Build and maintain reference architectures, accelerators, and reusable assets that strengthen our MES practice and shorten time-to-proposal.
Maintain deep expertise in leading MES platforms (e.g., Siemens Opcenter, TrakSYS, Rockwell FactoryTalk PharmaSuite/ProductionCentre, AVEVA MES, Werum PAS-X, Apriso, Critical Manufacturing, Tulip) and partner ecosystems.
Mentor junior MES engineers and consultants, sharing knowledge through coaching, internal training, and design reviews.
Stay current with industry trends — ISA-95/88, B2MML, OPC UA, Industry 4.0, Smart Manufacturing, UNS, cloud-native MES, AI in operations — and translate them into client-relevant value propositions.

Required Skills & Experience

A background in Industrial / Automation / Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
8+ years of experience designing, implementing, and deploying MES/MOM solutions in real industrial environments (pharma, chemical, food & beverage, automotive, semiconductor, or similar).
Demonstrated track record as a Solutions Architect on at least 2–3 full-lifecycle MES programs, with end-to-end responsibility for the technical design.
Significant prior experience in pre-sales or technical consulting roles: leading workshops, scoping engagements, building proposals, and presenting to customers.
Hands-on expertise with at least one major MES platform (Siemens Opcenter, Rockwell, AVEVA, Werum PAS-X, Apriso, GE Proficy, Critical Manufacturing, Tulip, iBASEt, or comparable).
Strong working knowledge of ISA-95, ISA-88 (batch), B2MML, and MES integration patterns with SAP (PP/PI/QM) and OT layers.
Solid understanding of industrial protocols and integration mechanisms: OPC UA, MQTT, REST/SOAP APIs, message brokers, Unified Namespace concepts.
Experience designing solutions across on-prem, hybrid, and cloud-native deployment models (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
Familiarity with adjacent technologies: historians (Aspen IP.21, OSIsoft PI, Canary), SCADA/HMI (Ignition, WinCC, FactoryTalk), LIMS, and analytics platforms.
Comfort articulating commercial implications: effort estimation, TCO, licensing models, and delivery risk.

Key Skills

Deep architectural thinking with the ability to balance technical excellence, business value, and delivery feasibility.
Strong customer-facing communication and presentation skills, with the gravitas to engage at executive level.
Excellent commercial acumen and the ability to translate technical decisions into business outcomes.
Skilled at facilitating workshops and synthesizing complex client requirements into a clear solution narrative.
Proven leadership in shaping winning proposals and influencing buying decisions.
Ability to operate independently across multiple parallel opportunities while maintaining quality and pace.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a structured approach to ambiguity.
Excellent written communication for proposals, statements of work, and architecture documentation.

Additional Considerations

Prior experience in regulated industries (pharma GxP, food safety) is a strong advantage.
Experience working in a consultancy, systems integrator, or vendor pre-sales environment is highly valued.
Familiarity with Industry 4.0, IIoT, AI/ML in manufacturing, and emerging UNS-based architectures will set strong candidates apart.
Willingness to travel periodically to client sites across the region.
Dutch written and spoken is required.

This is an outstanding opportunity for a senior MES professional to combine deep technical leadership with a high-impact pre-sales role, shaping the digital transformation journeys of leading industrial clients. If you are energized by solving complex manufacturing challenges, designing elegant architectures, and winning the trust of customers from the very first conversation, we would love to hear from you.

Join AG Solution Where Talent Shapes Industry 4.0

At AG Solution, we build intelligent solutions for the process industry, combining automation, process control, data management, and MES/MOM systems to help manufacturers reach operational excellence.

Now part of the Quariq Group, we are one of Europe’s leading Industry 4.0 partners
, with more than 400 engineers and consultants working across Europe, the UK, and the US.

Driven by People. Powered by Technology.

Our success starts with our people
. We invest in growth through continuous learning, mentorship, and our AG Academy, ensuring every colleague has the opportunity to develop their skills and career. AG Solution is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We believe that innovation happens when people feel trusted, connected, and inspired.

A Global Team with a Human Touch

With offices in over 15 cities worldwide
, we bring together diverse expertise and perspectives — from Antwerp to Barcelona, Rotterdam to Lyon, and New York to Krakow.

At AG Solution, you’ll work on meaningful projects that drive efficiency, sustainability, and digital transformation for leading manufacturers worldwide.

Built to Scale. Driven by Talent.

Ready to shape the future of industry?

Explore our opportunities and grow with a team that’s redefining what’s possible.

Brief Description

4G Clinical delivers randomization and trial supply technology built for complex clinical trials. As a Software Engineer you will be part of the dedicated team who work on Prancer RTSM® 4G Clinical's proprietary software which supports clinical trial studies from early phase through large, multi-country programs, with configuration flexibility aligned to protocol complexity and evolving trial demands.

Within this role you will;

Write reusable, testable, and efficient code; unit-test and document implemented features.
Design and implementation of low-latency, high-availability, and performant applications.
Implementation of server-side models and algorithms.
Implementation of web service APIs (REST).
Implementation of client-side logic, including UX design, HTML layouts and templates, Angular logic, and styling.
Implementation of security and data protection.
Integration of data storage solutions.

Requirements

The position requires between 1-10 years’ experience as a Software Engineer in asn agile environment working with a web-based application. The skills listed below are those of a full-stack software engineer, with the understanding that each software engineer has their own “spikes” or specialty areas.

Back-end

ORM (Object Relational Mapping).
Modern application frameworks such as Django or Ruby on Rails.
Object Oriented Programming.
Micro-services / loosely coupled applications using multiple data sources and interfaces.
Functional programming / higher order functions is a plus.

Front-end

Modern frontend technologies such as Angular, JavaScript, Typescript/Coffee Script, HTML5, SCSS/CSS.
Responsive design applications (e.g. Material Design).
Higher-order functions (e.g. Lodash).

General

Understanding of accessibility and security compliance.
Knowledge of user authentication and authorization between multiple systems, servers, and environments.
Understanding of fundamental design principles behind a scalable application.
Strong unit test and debugging skills.
Proficient understanding of modern development environment tools such as Git. JIRA or other issue tracking systems, Jenkins or other CI software.
Cloud-based applications and virtualization is a plus (Docker, EC2, S3).

Education And/or Certification Requirements

The candidate must possess a bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering or equivalent field is required, with preference towards master’s degree or higher. Equivalent work experience will be considered.

Summary

4G Clinical is honored to be part of Fast Company's 2020 Best Workplaces for Innovators list, citing businesses and organizations that demonstrate a deep commitment to encouraging innovation at all levels. 4G Clinical came in at #8 for its dedication to building a culture that fuels innovation, curiosity, and the spirit of experimentation in all facets of the business from product development and brand to services and staffing. We were also voted one of the 2018 Best Places in Health Care & Biopharma by Great Place to Work® and FORTUNE.

4G Clinical is a global leader in randomization and trial supply management (RTSM) and supply forecasting optimization software for the life sciences industry, offering the only fully cloud-based, 100% configurable and flexible solutions utilizing natural language processing (NLP) to accelerate clinical trials. 4G Clinical is headquartered in the Boston Biotech corridor of Wellesley, MA, with offices in Europe and Asia.

We offer compelling benefits to our international and US-based employees. Benefits vary by region and should be discussed with a 4G Talent Acquisition or HR representative.

4G Clinical is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, and it is foundational to how we recruit and hire our talented team. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer Internship
jobs.description:
About ENTSO-E

ENTSO-E is the European Network of Transmission System Operators for Electricity. We coordinate the cross-border system operations, system development and electricity market activities of the 40 electricity transmission system operators (TSOs) which cover 36 countries. The ENTSO-E Secretariat in Brussels provides support on technical, market and policy developments for all European TSOs in their cooperation with each other, in their joint fulfilment of their legal mandates, and in the intensive interactions with EU decision-makers, regulatory agencies, associations representing network users and other stakeholders.

We are a dynamic European association working on important and exciting projects of the electricity sector with the commitment to support the efforts towards a carbon-neutral power system. At ENTSO-E, you will contribute to building the world’s largest integrated electricity market – impacting not only those in the energy sector but also Europe’s overall economy, today and in the future!

Job Description

We are looking for a motivated student with a background in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field to join the Internal Services
team of the ICT
Section of ENTSO-E. The intern will enhance and apply her/his knowledge by contributing to the development and maintenance of full-stack web applications and supporting DevOps activities, including application deployment, automation, and CI/CD processes.

Preferred starting date is early September 2026, for a duration of 6 months
.

Your Responsibilities

With a supervision of a manager:
Contribute to the design, development, testing, and maintenance of full-stack web applications.
Support the implementation of new features across frontend and backend systems.
Collaborate with software developers and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality, user-focused solutions.
Participate in debugging, testing, and code reviews while applying software engineering best practices.
Gain hands-on experience with modern web technologies, development tools, DevOps practices, and Agile methodologies.

Specific responsibilities may be finetuned together with the student.

Your profile

We are looking for a motivated professional with the following skills and qualifications:
Be a full time student in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and/or TypeScript.
Familiarity with at least one modern frontend framework (e.g. React, Angular, or Vue).
Basic knowledge of backend development using technologies such as Node.js, Java, Python, C#, or similar.
Understanding of RESTful APIs, databases (SQL and/or NoSQL), and Git version control.
Basic understanding of DevOps concepts, such as CI/CD pipelines, containerization (e.g. Docker), or cloud platforms, is an asset.
Knowledge of software development principles and object-oriented programming.
Ability to organise own work and establish priorities.

Requirements
Set up an internship agreement between the university & ENTSO-E.
Agree on exact length of the internship and schedule (full time or part time).
Be eligible to travel and stay in Belgium for the duration of the traineeship.
Provide proof of health insurance coverage by university
Excellent command of English (written and oral).
Motivation to work in a multinational and multicultural environment.

Our offer

We offer an internship position fully integrated in our team where the student will have the opportunity to:
Enhance technical skills and apply them in truly exciting projects.
Contribute to building the world’s largest integrated electricity market – impacting not only those in the energy sector but also Europe’s overall economy, today and in the future.
Gain valuable experience in a truly multi-cultural environment.
Build and expand their professional network.
Receive to 700€ / month cost reimbursement for living & commuting expenses.

Interested?

Apply no later than 31 July
, by submitting your CV and motivational letter in English via the ENTSO-E career site. All applications will be treated in the strictest confidence.

ENTSO-E is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and are committed to fostering a workplace where diversity and inclusion are valued.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organisations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to

models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The newComputational Sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness this transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and transformative medicines for patients Worldwide.

Within the CoE organisation, the Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) organisation drives the modernisation of our computational and data ecosystems and integration of digital technologies across Research and Early Development to enable our stakeholders, power data-driven science and accelerate decision-making.

As a senior lab automation software engineer, you will be the essential link to the automation scientists in the lab. Using your background in both software development and hardware integration, you will work with a team of software-focused engineers to build, test and do what is needed to bring the software and hardware layers into production.

The Opportunity

To excel in this role, you will bridge the gap between complex software engineering and laboratory research in drug discovery through the following responsibilities:

Design, program and troubleshoot high-throughput lab workflows
Build orchestration systems, hardware abstraction layers, and instrument drivers that manage retries and allow unattended operation
Implement logging, metrics, and alerts across hardware and software to identify failures. Fix root causes using software or vision models instead of relying on manual workarounds or vendor support
Build systems to maintain a digital representation of the lab, including sample identity, instrument state, and resource availability. Connect instruments via APIs and integrate with LIMS and ELNs
Manage hardware requirements, site constraints, reagent selection, and work cell integration from initial design to deployment
Work directly with software engineers, automation scientists, and hardware engineers to turn scientific processes into technical architectures

Who You Are

You have 5+ years of experience in software engineering and hardware integration
Experienced in programming commercial liquid-handling or laboratory automation platforms and integrating robotic manipulators
Proficient in C# or Python for building software and integration frameworks
Familiar with molecular biology, biochemistry, or wet lab workflows to help translate scientific needs into engineering solutions
Prototyping design experience, including CNC milling, laser cutting, and CAD
A clear communicator who collaborates with scientists and multidisciplinary teams to build complete solutions
Skilled at using APIs and SDKs to interact with complex laboratory software ecosystems
Experienced in designing workflow orchestration or scheduling systems that manage shared resources, dependencies, and priorities

Preferred Skills And Experience

Skilled with computer vision models (such as OpenCV, YOLO, or SAM) for automated error handling and object or anomaly detection
Experienced in training, evaluating, or adopting AI/ML models, including reinforcement or imitation learning for robotics
Capable of building and evaluating AI-enabled systems, defining evals, establishing guardrails for determinism versus nondeterminism, and measuring reliability
Knowledgeable about sensors, microcontrollers, and task-and-motion planning
Familiar with cloud infrastructure and digital twin simulation

A cover letter is not necessary, you will be required to fill a questionnaire.

Ready to take the next step? We'd love to hear from you. Apply now to explore this exciting opportunity! #ComputationCoE

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Basel. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

jobs.title: (Senior) Cloud Solution Architect – Microsoft Azure (all genders)
jobs.description:
Bei uns kommen AI-Kompetenz, Engineering-Exzellenz und fundiertes Branchenverständnis zusammen – getragen von Menschen, die gemeinsam etwas bewegen wollen. So entstehen zukunftsfähige Lösungen, die im Alltag unserer Kunden wirklich einen Unterschied machen. Das gelingt durch Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Chancen erkennen und technologische Möglichkeiten in greifbare Ergebnisse verwandeln. Dafür schaffen wir ein Umfeld, das von gegenseitiger Unterstützung geprägt ist: Raum für fachliche Weiterentwicklung, offene Communities, in denen Wissen gerne geteilt wird, Peer Groups und Trainingsangebote, die sich an dir orientieren. Vertrauen, Wertschätzung und gemeinsam gefeierte Erfolge prägen dabei unser Miteinander und machen Entwicklung zu etwas, das bei uns einfach dazugehört.

DAS KANNST DU BEWEGEN

Azure Architektur: Du entwickelst moderne, sichere und skalierbare Azure-Architekturen und erstellst die Architekturplanung für die zu implementierende Lösung.
Cloud Foundation & Landing Zones: Du konzipierst Azure Landing Zones und gestaltest die technische Basis für Cloud-Transformationen – inklusive Management Groups, Subscriptions, Networking, Identity, Governance und Security.
Azure Migration & Modernisierung: Du begleitest unsere Kunden bei der Analyse, Planung und Umsetzung von Migrationen nach Azure und entwickelst bestehende IT-Landschaften gezielt weiter.
Hybrid Cloud & Networking: Du konzipierst hybride Architekturen und verbindest bestehende On-Premises-Umgebungen sicher mit Azure – beispielsweise mit Azure Virtual Network, ExpressRoute, VPN Gateway, Private Endpoints und Azure DNS.
Security & Identity: Du integrierst Security von Beginn an in deine Architektur und arbeitest unter anderem mit Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Key Vault, Azure Policy und Microsoft Defender for Cloud.
Automation & Infrastructure as Code: Du automatisierst den Aufbau von Cloud-Infrastrukturen mit Technologien wie Terraform oder Bicep und integrierst diese in moderne CI/CD-Prozesse mit GitHub oder Azure DevOps.
Cloud-native Lösungen: Du berätst unsere Kunden auch beim Einsatz moderner Azure Services wie Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps oder Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
Integration & APIs: Du kennst die Möglichkeiten von Azure API Management, Service Bus und Event Grid und kannst diese sinnvoll in moderne Lösungsarchitekturen integrieren.
Betrieb & Resilienz: Du berücksichtigst Monitoring, Verfügbarkeit, Backup und Disaster Recovery bereits im Lösungsdesign und nutzt dafür beispielsweise Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Azure Backup und Azure Site Recovery.
Governance & Kosten: Du unterstützt unsere Kunden dabei, ihre Azure-Umgebung kontrollierbar und wirtschaftlich zu betreiben und berücksichtigst dabei Governance- und FinOps-Prinzipien.
Kundenberatung & Workshops: Du diskutierst Anforderungen auf Augenhöhe mit IT-Verantwortlichen und Architekten, moderierst Architektur- und Cloud-Workshops und übersetzt Anforderungen in konkrete technische Lösungen.
PreSales & Angebote: Gemeinsam mit unserem Sales- und Microsoft-Team entwickelst du Lösungsansätze für neue Kundenprojekte und unterstützt bei Architekturkonzepten, Aufwandsschätzungen, Angeboten sowie Präsentationen.
Microsoft Ecosystem: Du arbeitest eng mit Microsoft und unseren internen Spezialistinnen und Spezialisten zusammen und bringst neue Azure-Technologien und Best Practices aktiv in unsere Kundenprojekte ein.
Teamarbeit: Du gibst dein Wissen weiter, unterstützt Kolleginnen und Kollegen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns unser Microsoft Azure Portfolio weiter.

WIE DIR DAS GELINGT

Azure-Erfahrung: Du bringst mehrere Jahre praktische Erfahrung mit Microsoft Azure und der Konzeption sowie Umsetzung von Azure-basierten Kundenlösungen mit.
Infrastructure Know-how: Du verstehst klassische und moderne IT-Infrastrukturen und kennst dich insbesondere mit Cloud Networking, Compute, Storage, Identity, Security und hybriden Architekturen aus.
Architekturkompetenz: Du kannst komplexe Anforderungen analysieren, technische Optionen bewerten und daraus verständliche, sichere und skalierbare Lösungsarchitekturen entwickeln.
Azure Best Practices: Konzepte wie Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework, Azure Landing Zones und Azure Well-Architected Framework sind dir vertraut.
Infrastructure as Code: Du hast praktische Erfahrung mit Terraform und/oder Bicep sowie mit Automatisierungs- und Deployment-Prozessen.
Security: Zero Trust, Identity & Access Management, Network Security, Governance und Cloud Security sind für dich integraler Bestandteil einer Architektur und keine nachgelagerten Themen.
Modernisierung: Idealerweise hast du bereits Erfahrung mit Azure Migrate sowie mit PaaS-, Container- oder Kubernetes-basierten Architekturen gesammelt.
DevOps: GitHub, GitHub Actions oder Azure DevOps sowie CI/CD-Konzepte sind dir vertraut.
Beratungskompetenz: Du kannst komplexe technische Sachverhalte verständlich erklären, trittst beim Kunden sicher auf und entwickelst Lösungen gemeinsam mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern.
Eigenverantwortung: Du übernimmst gerne technische Verantwortung und möchtest Lösungen nicht nur konzipieren, sondern deren Umsetzung aktiv begleiten.
Zertifizierungen: Microsoft Azure Zertifizierungen wie Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305) sind ein Plus – oder du bist bereit, entsprechende Zertifizierungen bei uns zu erlangen.
KI-Kompetenz: Du verfügst über vertiefte KI-Expertise, gestaltest deren verantwortungsvollen Einsatz in deinem Verantwortungsbereich aktiv mit und fungierst als Enabler für Kunden sowie intern bei adesso.
Sprachen: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.
Reisebereitschaft & Flexibilität: Du bist bereit, projektbezogen zu reisen, und arbeitest gern in agilen Teams.

CHANCENGEBER - WAS ADESSO AUSMACHT

Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, gemeinschaftlich und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi.

Lerne und wachse mit uns: Mit über 400 Trainingsangeboten und unserer digitalen Lernplattform unterstützen wir deine kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung.
Erlebe echten Teamgeist: Gemeinsame Events (z.B. Sport-Weekend und die jährliche Fortbildungsreise eduCamp), Welcome Days, Firmenläufe stärken unseren Zusammenhalt und lassen dich von Anfang an Teil des Teams sein.
Engagement, das belohnt wird: Dein Einsatz zahlt sich aus – mit Prämien für Empfehlungen, Vorträge, die Betreuung von Abschlussarbeiten sowie attraktiven Vergünstigungen über unser Corporate-Benefits-Portal.

Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns – auch im Home-Office. Arbeiten in Teilzeit ist nach Absprache möglich (80-100%). Zum wiederholten Mal wurden wir zu einem der besten Arbeitgeber der Schweiz gekürt! Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

We are seeking a highly skilled full stack Software Engineer
with deep expertise in .NET development and data-driven applications
to join our engineering team. In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain enterprise solutions that support Agilent's scientific instruments, laboratory management systems, and business intelligence initiatives.

The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience working with large and complex datasets. You will leverage modern data platforms, cloud technologies, and analytics tools to build scalable applications, data pipelines, and dashboards that drive informed business decisions and deliver value to customers.

Qualifications

Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.

jobs.description:
We’re hiring a Technical Architect
to lead the design and delivery of scalable,
secure embedded services across Sage’s platform. You’ll sit at the intersection of
engineering, architecture, and strategy - working with product, platform, and
partner teams to define solutions that are technically robust, cloud-native, and
aligned with our long-term vision.

💻/🏡 This is a hybrid role working 3 days a week in our Barcelona office.

You’ll be instrumental in helping Sage embed services into diverse ecosystems
by championing API-first thinking, cloud architecture best practices, and
scalable service design. This is a hands-on role ideal for someone who enjoys
both deep system-level work and strategic architectural leadership.

Meet the Team

You’ll report to a senior technology leader and work closely with solution
designers, product managers, cloud infrastructure specialists, and full-stack
engineering teams (primarily working in C# and React). You’ll also engage with
Sage Partners to ensure seamless third-party integrations.

How Success Will Be Measured

Delivery of scalable, secure, and maintainable service architectures
Alignment of solution designs with Sage’s enterprise architecture standards
Influence across engineering teams through architectural mentorship
Improvement in developer experience, service performance, and integration quality

Skills You’ll Gain

End-to-end architecture ownership in a large-scale cloud platform
Exposure to embedded services at enterprise level, used by external partners and internal teams
Broader impact through mentorship, code review, and technical leadership
Strategic engagement with senior stakeholders, balancing delivery and long-term vision

Snapshot of Your Day-to-Day

You’ll design core components of the Embedded Services Platform, guide
architecture decisions, write and review code (primarily in C#), and ensure
implementation quality across development teams. You’ll lead discussions with
product teams, participate in partner enablement, and champion architecture
governance while keeping a hands-on role.

Qualifications

5+ years of experience in a Technical Architecture role, designing large-scale cloud-native enterprise systems
Proven ability to turn complex business needs into scalable technical solutions
Expertise in modern architectural styles: distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architecture, CQRS, Event Sourcing, CDC, etc.
Hands-on experience with C#, Java or a similar backend language
Strong background in designing REST APIs and data schemas at scale
Familiarity with public cloud services (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including container orchestration (e.g. Kubernetes, ECS, AKS, EKS)
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including influencing across tech and non-tech teams
Experience providing mentorship and architectural guidance in agile product delivery settings
Fluency in English (Spanish is a plus)

Tech Stack You’ll Work With

Languages & Frameworks: C# (primary), .NET Core
Architectural Patterns: Event-Driven Architecture, CQRS, Clean
Architecture, API-first, Distributed Systems
Integration: REST APIs, Publish/Subscribe, Distributed Tracing
DevOps & Tooling: Git, CI/CD pipelines, code reviews, observability tooling

💚 At Sage, we offer you an environment where you can grow professionally without compromising your personal well-being.
Our benefits package is designed to provide stability, flexibility, and balance:
Medical and dental insurance: Fully funded medical and dental insurance.
Flexible benefits: Exchange part of your salary and make tax savings on meal and transport vouchers, childcare, and training.
Well-being: Free access to the Calm app (for up to 5 users), 24/7 counselling, and emotional support from our Healthy Mind Coaches. We also offer self-care and parenting resources through the Cleo app.
Flexible working: flexibility of working one hour in, one hour out, shortened workdays on Fridays and during the summer, and the opportunity to work from over 40 countries for up to 10 weeks per year through our Work Away program.
Annual leave: 23 working days of vacation, 5 paid days per year for volunteering.
Extended leave: 7 extra days of maternity leave and 5 extra days of paternity leave, on top of the legal allowance, available after one year of service.
Financial support: Life and disability insurance, salary advances of up to 3.5 times your net monthly pay, a €300 net marriage bonus, and access to Sage's employee stock purchase plan at a discounted rate.
Learning and development: Free premium subscription to external learning platforms
